t1: And the disbelievers said to their Messengers: ‘We will banish you by all means from our country, or you will have to return to our faith.’ Their Lord then revealed to them: ‘We shall certainly destroy the unjust people,
t2: The unbelievers said to their Messengers, ’We will assuredly expel you from our land, or you will surely return into our creed.’ Then did their Lord reveal unto them: ’We will surely destroy the evildoers,
t3: And those who disbelieved said unto their messengers: Verily we will drive you out from our land, unless ye return to our religion. Then their Lord inspired them, (saying): Verily we shall destroy the wrong- doers,

ar: وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِى وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ
en: and make you reside in the land after them. This is for whoever is in awe of standing before Me and fears My warning.”
t1: And We shall certainly settle you in the (same) land after them. This (covenant) is for every such person that fears standing before My presence and dreads My promise (of torment).’
t2: and We will surely make you to dwell in the land after them -- that, for him who fears My station and fears My threat.’
t3: And verily We shall make you to dwell in the land after them. This is for him who feareth My Majesty and feareth My threats.

ar: وَٱسْتَفْتَحُوا۟ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
en: And both sides called for judgment, so every stubborn tyrant was doomed.
t1: And (ultimately) the Messengers sought victory (from Allah), and every obstinate rebel met defeat and came to nothing.
t2: They sought a judgment; then was disappointed every froward tyrant --
t3: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;

ar: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٍۢ صَدِيدٍۢ
en: Awaiting them is Hell, and they will be left to drink oozing pus,
t1: Beyond this (devastation) is Hell (again). And he will be served with fetid water of oozing pus,
t2: beyond him Gehenna, and he is given to drink of oozing pus,
t3: Hell is before him, and he is made to drink a festering water,

ar: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍۢ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍۢ ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌۭ
en: which they will sip with difficulty, and can hardly swallow. Death will overwhelm them from every side, yet they will not ˹be able to˺ die. Awaiting them still is harsher torment.
t1: Which he will take sip by sip with great difficulty, and will not be able to gulp it down the throat. And death will assail him from all sides, and he will not be able (even) to die. And that (again) will be followed by (one more) extremely grievous torment.
t2: the which he gulps, and can scarce swallow, and death comes upon him from every side, yet he cannot die; and still beyond him is a harsh chastisement.
t3: Which he sippeth but can hardly swallow, and death cometh unto him from every side while yet he cannot die, and before him is a harsh doom.

ar: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ
en: The parable of the deeds of those who disbelieve in their Lord is that of ashes fiercely blown away by wind on a stormy day. They will gain nothing from what they have earned. That is ˹truly˺ the farthest one can stray.
t1: The example of those who have rejected faith in their Lord is that their works are like ashes on which blows the strong wind on a stormy day—they are unable to grasp anything of the (works) that they earned. This is straying far into error.
t2: The likeness of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are as ashes, whereon the wind blows strong upon a tempestuous day; they have no power over that they have earned - that is the far error!
t3: A similitude of those who disbelieve in their Lord: Their works are as ashes which the wind bloweth hard upon a stormy day. They have no control of aught that they have earned. That is the extreme failure.

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
en: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth for a reason? If He wills, He can eliminate you and produce a new creation.
t1: (O listener!) Have you not seen that Allah has created the heavens and the earth in accordance with (a strategy based on) the truth? He can annihilate you if He so wills and bring new creation (in your place).
t2: Hast thou not seen that God created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He will, He can put you away and bring a new creation;
t3: Hast thou not seen that Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth ? If He will, He can remove you and bring (in) some new creation;

ar: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ
en: And that is not difficult for Allah ˹at all˺.
t1: And this is not (in the least) difficult for Allah (to execute).
t2: that is surely no great matter for God.
t3: And that is no great matter for Allah.

ar: وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًۭا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيْنَٰكُمْ ۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَجَزِعْنَآ أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍۢ
en: They will all appear before Allah, and the lowly ˹followers˺ will appeal to the arrogant ˹leaders˺, “We were your ˹dedicated˺ followers, so will you ˹then˺ protect us from Allah’s torment in any way?” They will reply, “Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you. ˹Now˺ it is all the same for us whether we suffer patiently or impatiently, there is no escape for us.”
t1: And (on the Day of Grand Assembly) all (the higher and the lower ranks) will appear before Allah. The weak ones (the followers) will ask the (powerful) arrogant ones: ‘We obeyed you (the whole life). So can you now manage for us some degree of rescue from Allah’s torment?’ Those (affluent ones) will reply (to their poor followers): ‘Had Allah guided us, we would also have shown you the path of guidance (i.e., we were ourselves misguided so we misguided you too). It is all the same (Today) whether we sigh and wail or forbear. We have no way to escape.’
t2: They sally forth unto God, all together; then say the weak to those who waxed proud, ’We were your followers; will you avail us against the chastisement of God anything?’ They say, ’If God had guided us, we would have guided you. Alike it is for us whether we cannot endure, or whether we are patient; we have no asylum.’
t3: They all come forth unto their Lord. Then those who were despised say unto those who were scornful: We were unto you a following, can ye then avert from us aught of Allah’s doom ? They say: Had Allah guided us, we should have guided you. Whether we rage or patiently endure is (now) all one for us; we have no place of refuge.

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
en: And Satan will say ˹to his followers˺ after the judgment has been passed, “Indeed, Allah has made you a true promise. I too made you a promise, but I failed you. I did not have any authority over you. I only called you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; blame yourselves. I cannot save you, nor can you save me. Indeed, I denounce your previous association of me with Allah ˹in loyalty˺. Surely the wrongdoers will suffer a painful punishment.”
t1: And when the decision will have been given, Satan will say: ‘Indeed, Allah gave you a true promise; and I (also) promised you something, so I have violated the promise. And I had no authority over you (in the world) except that I called you (towards falsehood), so you accepted my call (for your own interest). Now do not blame me but blame your (own) selves. I can do nothing (Today) to help you out, nor can you extend any help to me. Before this you have been associating me as a partner (with Allah). Surely, I deny that (Today).’ Undoubtedly, there is a painful punishment for the wrongdoers.
t2: And Satan says, when the issue is decided, ’God surely promised you a true promise; and I promised you, then I failed you, for I had no authority over you, but that I called you, and you answered me. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves; I cannot aid you, neither can you aid me. I disbelieved in your associating me with God aforetime.’ As for the evildoers, for them awaits a painful chastisement;
t3: And Satan saith, when the matter hath been decided: Lo! Allah promised you a promise of truth; and I promised you, then failed you. And I had no power over you save that I called unto you and ye obeyed me. So blame not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can ye help me, Lo! I disbelieved in that which ye before ascribed to me. Lo! for wrong- doers is a painful doom.

ar: وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ
en: Those who believe and do good will be admitted into Gardens, under which rivers flow—to stay there forever by the Will of their Lord—where they will be greeted with “Peace!”
t1: And those who believe and stick to pious deeds will be admitted to the Gardens with streams flowing under them. They will live there forever by the command of Allah. Their greeting word there (at the time of meeting) will be: ‘Peace.’
t2: but as for those who believe, and do deeds of righteousness, they shall be admitted to gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein dwelling forever, by the leave of their Lord, their greeting therein: ’Peace!’
t3: And those who believed and did good works are made to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein abiding by permission of their Lord, their greeting therein: Peace!

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا كَلِمَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ كَشَجَرَةٍۢ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌۭ وَفَرْعُهَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
en: Do you not see how Allah compares a good word to a good tree? Its root is firm and its branches reach the sky,
t1: Have you not seen how Allah sets forth an example: a good word is like a good tree? Its root is firm (in the earth) and its branches reach into the sky.
t2: Hast thou not seen how God has struck a similitude? A good word is as a good tree -- its roots are firm, and its branches are in heaven;
t3: Seest thou not how Allah coineth a similitude: A goodly saying, as a goodly tree, its root set firm, its branches reaching into heaven,

ar: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
en: ˹always˺ yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord. This is how Allah sets forth parables for the people, so perhaps they will be mindful.
t1: (That tree) yields fruit at all times by the command of its Lord, and Allah illustrates examples for the people so that they may take advice.
t2: it gives its produce every season by the leave of its Lord. So God strikes similitudes for men; haply they will remember.
t3: Giving its fruit at every season by permission of its Lord ? Allah coineth the similitudes for mankind in order that they may reflect.

ar: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍۢ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍۢ
en: And the parable of an evil word is that of an evil tree, uprooted from the earth, having no stability.
t1: And the example of an evil word is like that of an evil tree, which is uprooted from the surface of the earth (and) which has no chance to get firm (in the soil and survive).
t2: And the likeness of a corrupt word is as a corrupt tree -- uprooted from the earth, having no stablishment.
t3: And the similitude of a bad saying is as a bad tree, uprooted from upon the earth, possessing no stability.

ar: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْقَوْلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ۚ وَيَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ
en: Allah makes the believers steadfast with the firm Word ˹of faith˺ in this worldly life and the Hereafter. And Allah leaves the wrongdoers to stray. For Allah does what He wills.
t1: Allah keeps the believers firm-footed in the life of this world as well as in the Hereafter with (the blessing) of this Firm Word, but Allah holds the wrongdoers astray. And Allah puts into action whatever He wills.
t2: God confirms those who believe with the firm word, in the present life and in the world to come; and God leads astray the evildoers; and God does what He will.
t3: Allah confirmeth those who believe by a firm saying in the life of the world and in the Hereafter, and Allah sendeth wrong-doers astray. And Allah doeth what He will.

ar: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفْرًۭا وَأَحَلُّوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ ٱلْبَوَارِ
en: Have you not seen those ˹disbelievers˺ who meet Allah’s favours with ingratitude and lead their own people to their doom?
t1: Have you not seen those who have exchanged Allah’s favour (of belief) for disbelief and have lowered their people into the house of destruction?
t2: Hast thou not seen those who exchanged the bounty of God with unthankfulness, and caused their people to dwell in the abode of ruin? --
t3: Hast thou not seen those who gave the grace of Allah in exchange for thanklessness and led their people down to the Abode of Loss,

ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
en: In Hell they will burn. What an evil place for settlement.
t1: (That) is Hell into which they will be thrown headlong, and that is an evil abode.
t2: Gehenna, wherein they are roasted; an evil stablishment!
t3: (Even to) hell ? They are exposed thereto. A hapless end!

ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
en: They set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy yourselves! Surely your destination is the Fire.”
t1: And they set up partners with Allah so that they may turn (the people) away from His path. Say: ‘Benefit (a few days’) gain; surely, you will end up in the Fire.’
t2: And they set up compeers to God, that they might lead astray from His way. Say: ’Take your joy! Your homecoming shall be -- the Fire!’
t3: And they set up rivals to Allah that they may mislead (men) from His way. Say: Enjoy life (while ye may) for lo! your journey’s end will be the Fire.

ar: قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا بَيْعٌۭ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ
en: Tell My believing servants to establish prayer and donate from what We have provided for them—openly and secretly—before the arrival of a Day in which there will be no ransom or friendly connections.
t1: Say to My servants who have believed that they must establish Prayer and spend (in Our way) both secretly and openly of the provision that We have granted them before the dawn of the Day when neither any transaction will take place, nor any (worldly) friendship (will profit).
t2: Say to My servants who believe, that they perform the prayer, and expend of that We have provided them, secretly and in public, before a day comes wherein shall be neither bargaining nor befriending.
t3: Tell My bondmen who believe to establish worship and spend of that which We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a day cometh wherein there will be neither traffick nor befriending.

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ
en: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and sends down rain from the sky, causing fruits to grow as a provision for you. He has subjected the ships for your service, sailing through the sea by His command, and has subjected the rivers for you.
t1: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth and poured down water from the sky and then by means of this water produced fruits for you as provision. And He has made vessels subservient to you so that they may sail in the sea by Allah’s command, and He has (also) put rivers under your control.
t2: It is God who created the heavens and the earth, and sent down out of heaven water wherewith He brought forth fruits to be your sustenance. And He subjected to you the ships to run upon the sea at His commandment; and He subjected to you the rivers
t3: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and causeth water to descend from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you, and maketh the ships to be of service unto you, that they may run upon the sea at His command, and hath made of service unto you the rivers;

ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
en: He has ˹also˺ subjected for you the sun and the moon, both constantly orbiting, and has subjected the day and night for you.
t1: And for your benefit, He has subjected the sun and the moon (to a regular system); they keep rotating (in their respective orbits). And He has also subdued the night and the day (to a system) for your (system of life).
t2: and He subjected to you the sun and moon constant upon their courses, and He subjected to you the night and day,
t3: And maketh the sun and the moon, constant in their courses, to be of service unto you, and hath made of service unto you the night and the day.

ar: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
en: And He has granted you all that you asked Him for. If you tried to count Allah’s blessings, you would never be able to number them. Indeed humankind is truly unfair, ˹totally˺ ungrateful.
t1: And He has given you everything that you asked Him for, and if you seek to number the favours of Allah, you will not be able to count them all. Indeed, man is highly unjust and extremely ungrateful.
t2: and gave you of all you asked Him. If you count God’s blessing, you will never number it; surely man is sinful, unthankful!
t3: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًۭا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ
en: ˹Remember˺ when Abraham prayed, “My Lord! Make this city ˹of Mecca˺ secure, and keep me and my children away from the worship of idols.
t1: And (recall) when Ibrahim (Abraham) submitted: ‘O my Lord, make this city (Mecca) a land of peace and keep me and my children from idol-worship.
t2: And when Abraham said, ’My Lord, make this land secure, and turn me and my sons away from serving idols;
t3: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.

ar: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
en: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. So whoever follows me is with me, and whoever disobeys me—then surely You are ˹still˺ All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t1: O my Lord! These (idols) have led many people astray. So whoever follows me will belong to me, and whoever disobeys me, then indeed You are Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.
t2: my Lord, they have led astray many men. Then whoso follows me belongs to me; and whoso rebels against me, surely Thou art All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
t3: My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful.

ar: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
en: Our Lord! I have settled some of my offspring in a barren valley, near Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may establish prayer. So make the hearts of ˹believing˺ people incline towards them and provide them with fruits, so perhaps they will be thankful.
t1: O our Lord! Verily, I have settled my offspring (Isma‘il [Ishmael]) in the barren valley (of Mecca) in the close vicinity of Your Sacred House, O our Lord, so that they may establish Prayer. So make the hearts of the people incline towards them with love and fondness, and provide for them (all kinds of) fruits as sustenance so that they may remain grateful.
t2: Our Lord, I have made some of my seed to dwell in a valley where is no sown land by Thy Holy House; Our Lord, let them perform the prayer, and make hearts of men yearn towards them, and provide them with fruits; haply they will be thankful.
t3: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.

ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
en: Our Lord! You certainly know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from Allah.
t1: O our Lord! Surely, You know (all) what we hide and what we show, and there is nothing which is hidden from Allah either on earth or in the heaven.
t2: Our Lord, Thou knowest what we keep secret and what we publish; from God nothing whatever is hidden in earth and heaven.
t3: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.

ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
en: All praise is for Allah who has blessed me with Ishmael and Isaac in my old age. My Lord is indeed the Hearer of ˹all˺ prayers.
t1: All praise belongs to Allah alone, Who has bestowed upon me (two sons) in old age, Isma‘il (Ishmael) and Ishaq (Isaac). Indeed, my Lord is the All-Hearer of prayer.
t2: Praise be to God, who has given me, though I am old, Ishmael and Isaac; surely my Lord hears the petition.
t3: Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer.

ar: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
en: My Lord! Make me and those ˹believers˺ of my descendants keep up prayer. Our Lord! Accept my prayers.
t1: O my Lord! Make me and my children the ones who establish Prayer; O my Lord, and grant my prayer.
t2: My Lord, make me a performer of the prayer, and of my seed. Our Lord, and receive my petition.
t3: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.

ar: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
en: Our Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the judgment will come to pass.”
t1: O my Lord! Forgive me and (forgive) my parents* and all the believers as well on the Day when reckoning (and accountability) will be held.’
t2: Our Lord, forgive Thou me and my parents, and the believers, upon the day when the reckoning shall come to pass.
t3: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.

ar: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
en: Do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them until a Day when ˹their˺ eyes will stare in horror—
t1: And never think of Allah to be unaware of the works the wrongdoers are doing. He is only giving them (the wrongdoers) respite till the Day on which the eyes will be stare-fixed (in horror).
t2: Deem not that God is heedless of what the evildoers work; He is only deferring them to a day when eyes shall stare,
t3: Deem not that Allah is unaware of what the wicked do. He but giveth them a respite till a day when eyes will stare (in terror),

ar: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌۭ
en: rushing forth, heads raised, never blinking, hearts void.
t1: Their heads lifted up, they will be running (towards the Field of Grand Assembly), with eyes unable to twinkle and with hearts being drained of strength.
t2: when they shall run with necks outstretched and heads erect, their glances never returned on themselves, their hearts void.
t3: As they come hurrying on in fear, their heads upraised, their gaze returning not to them, and their hearts as air.

ar: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ ۗ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍۢ
en: And warn the people of the Day when the punishment will overtake ˹the wicked among˺ them, and the wrongdoers will cry, “Our Lord! Delay us for a little while. We will respond to Your call and follow the messengers!” ˹It will be said,˺ “Did you not swear before that you would never be removed ˹to the next life˺?”
t1: And warn the people of the Day when the torment will come upon them. Those who did injustice will say: ‘O our Lord, grant us respite for a while so that we may accept Your message and follow the Messengers.’ (It will be said to them:) ‘Are you not those who used to swear before that you would never fall?’
t2: And warn mankind of the day when the chastisement comes on them, And those who did evil shall say, ’Our Lord, defer us to a near term, and we will answer Thy call, and follow the Messengers.’ ’Ah, but did you not swear aforetime there should be no removing for you?
t3: And warn mankind of a day when the doom will come upon them, and those who did wrong will say: Our Lord! Reprieve us for a little while. We will obey Thy call and will follow the messengers. (It will be answered): Did ye not swear before that there would be no end for you ?

ar: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ
en: You passed by the ruins of those ˹destroyed peoples˺ who had wronged themselves. It was made clear to you how We dealt with them, and We gave you ˹many˺ examples.
t1: And (in your own turn) you were dwelling in the palaces (vacated by) those who had wronged their souls (during their respective eras), whereas this had dawned on you how We had dealt with them, and We also elucidated examples for your (easy comprehension).
t2: And you dwelt in the dwelling-places of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We did with them, and how We struck similitudes for you.
t3: And (have ye not) dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves (of old) and (hath it not) become plain to you how We dealt with them and made examples for you ?

ar: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ
en: They devised every plot, which was fully known to Allah, but their plotting was not enough to ˹even˺ overpower mountains ˹let alone Allah˺.
t1: And (having lost their balance, intoxicated by wealth and power,) they hatched many plots, whilst Allah had the countermeasures to foil all their plots, although their deceitful strategies were sufficient even to uproot the mountains.
t2: They devised their devising, and their devising is known to God; though their devising were such as to remove mountains.’
t3: Verily they have plotted their plot, and their plot is with Allah, though their plot were one whereby the mountains should be moved.

ar: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍۢ
en: So do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Allah is indeed Almighty, capable of punishment.
t1: So never think that Allah will break His promise with His Messengers. Indeed, Allah is Almighty, the Lord of Retribution.
t2: So do not deem that God will fail in His promise to His Messengers; surely God is All-mighty, Vengeful.
t3: So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).

ar: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
en: ˹Watch for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the earth will be changed into a different earth and the heavens as well, and all will appear before Allah—the One, the Supreme.
t1: The Day when (this) earth will be changed into a different earth and all the heavens will also be changed and the entire mankind will appear before Allah, the One, (and) the Dominant over all;
t2: Upon the day the earth shall be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens and they sally forth unto God, the One, the Omnipotent.
t3: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,

ar: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
en: On that Day you will see the wicked bound together in chains,
t1: And that Day you will see the sinners fettered in chains;
t2: And thou shalt see the sinners that day coupled in fetters,
t3: Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains,

ar: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍۢ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
en: with garments of tar, and their faces covered with flames.
t1: Their garments will be of pitch (or some inflammable oil), and the Fire will be enveloping their faces,
t2: of pitch their shirts, their faces enveloped by the Fire,
t3: Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces,

ar: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
en: As such, Allah will reward every soul for what it has committed. Surely Allah is swift in reckoning.
t1: So that Allah requites every soul for (the deeds) it has earned. Indeed, Allah is Swift in Reckoning.
t2: that God may recompense every soul for its earnings; surely God is swift at the reckoning.
t3: That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.

ar: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
en: This ˹Quran˺ is a ˹sufficient˺ message for humanity so that they may take it as a warning and know that there is only One God, and so that people of reason may be mindful.
t1: This (Qur’an) is perfect communication of the Message to mankind so that by means of this they may be warned, and that they may conscientiously bear in mind that He (Allah) is One God, and that those who possess wisdom may take advice.
t2: This is a Message to be delivered to mankind that they may be warned by it, and that they may know that He is One God, and that all possessed of minds may remember.
t3: This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One God, and that men of understanding may take heed.

ar: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
en: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran.
t1: Alif, Lam, Ra. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.) These are the Verses of the (Glorious) Book and the Enlightening Qur’an.
t2: Alif Lam Ra. Those are the signs of the Book and of a manifest Koran.
t3: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.

ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
en: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺.
t1: (Watching the scenes of Allah’s mercy on the believers in the Hereafter,) the disbelievers will persistently aspire: would that they were Muslims!
t2: Perchance the unbelievers will wish that they had surrendered:
t3: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.

ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know.
t1: (Feel not aggrieved.) Leave them. Let them eat (and drink) and make merry and let (their) false hopes keep them negligent (of the Hereafter). Then they will come to know (their end) soon.
t2: leave them to eat, and to take their joy, and to be bemused by hope; certainly they will soon know!
t3: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!

ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
en: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term.
t1: And never have We destroyed any township, except that there was for them a known inscription (law, which they violated and met their fate).
t2: Never a city have We destroyed, but it had a known decree,
t3: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.

ar: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
en: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it.
t1: No people can go beyond their appointed term, nor can they step back (under the law of rise and fall).
t2: and no nation outstrips its term, nor do they put it back.
t3: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
en: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane!
t1: And (the disbelievers) say (insolently): ‘O man on whom this Qur’an has been revealed, indeed you are insane.
t2: They say: ’Thou, upon whom the Remembrance is sent down, thou art assuredly possessed!
t3: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!

ar: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”
t1: Why do you not bring us angels if you are truthful?’
t2: Why dost thou not bring the angels unto us, if thou speakest truly?’
t3: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful ?

ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ
en: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed.
t1: We do not send down angels but with the (judgment of) truth (i.e., We send them down to execute the torment when its time approaches), and they are not granted respite at that time.
t2: We send not down the angels, save with truth;
t3: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
en: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it.
t1: Assuredly, We alone have revealed this Glorious Admonition (the Qur’an), and surely We alone will guard it.
t2: then they would not be respited. It is We who have sent down the Remembrance, and We watch over it.
t3: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples,
t1: And We indeed sent Messengers before you as well amongst the earlier generations.
t2: Indeed, We sent Messengers before thee, among the factions of the ancients,
t3: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.

ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked.
t1: And there did not come to them any Messenger but they would mock him.
t2: and not a single Messenger came to them, but they mocked at him;
t3: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
en: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked.
t1: That is how We infuse this (mockery and ridicule) into the hearts of the sinners;
t2: even so We cause it to enter into the hearts of the sinners --
t3: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:

ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before.
t1: These people will not believe in this (Qur’an), and (this) is what has been the practice of the bygone people.
t2: they believe not in it, though the wont of the ancients is already gone.
t3: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.

ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
en: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend,
t1: And if We open to them some gate in the heaven (and also make this possible for them that) they keep ascending through (it) the whole day,
t2: Though We opened to them a gate in heaven, and still they mounted through it,
t3: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,

ar: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ
en: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”
t1: (Even then) they will certainly say (this): ‘Our eyes have been hypnotized (through some magic trick and deceit), rather we are spellbound.’
t2: yet would they say, ’Our eyes have been dazzled; nay, we are a people bewitched!’
t3: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
en: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see.
t1: And indeed, We brought into existence constellations in the heavens (in the form of galaxies to safeguard the planets), and adorned this (spatial universe) for the beholders.
t2: We have set in heaven constellations and decked them out fair to the beholders,
t3: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.

ar: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ
en: And We protected it from every accursed devil,
t1: And We have ensured the protection of this (system of heavenly universe) from every outcast satan (i.e., from the destructive phenomenon of every rebellious force).
t2: and guarded them from every accursed Satan
t3: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,

ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
en: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare.
t1: But anyone who tries to eavesdrop, an illuminating (i.e., blazing) meteor follows it.
t2: excepting such as listens by stealth -- and he is pursued by a manifest flame.
t3: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ
en: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance.
t1: And We have spread out the earth (despite its being round), and We brought about firm mountains in it (by allying different elements together), and in it We provided means of growth to all species in (requisite) proportion.
t2: And the earth -- We stretched it forth, and cast on it firm mountains, and We caused to grow therein of every thing justly weighed,
t3: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
en: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for.
t1: And in it We generated for you means of subsistence and also for those (human beings, animals and birds) whom you do not provide for.
t2: and there appointed for you livelihood, and for those you provide not for.
t3: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.

ar: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
en: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure.
t1: And there is not a thing (in the universe) but that We have its treasures with Us, and We send it down only according to a fixed quantity.
t2: Naught is there, but its treasuries are with Us, and We send it not down but in a known measure.
t3: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.

ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
en: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves.
t1: And We send winds carrying the burden of clouds. Then We pour down water from the sky. Then it is you whom We give it to drink, and it is not you who maintain its reservoirs.
t2: And We loose the winds fertilising, and We send down out of heaven water, then We give it to you to drink, and you are not its treasurers.
t3: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.

ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
en: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor.
t1: And indeed, We alone give life and cause death, and We alone are the Inheritor (and the Owner of all).
t2: It is We who give life, and make to die, and it is We who are the inheritors.
t3: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.

ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
en: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺.
t1: And surely, We know those who lived before you, and We also know those who will come after you.
t2: We know the ones of you who press forward, and We know the laggards;
t3: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.

ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
en: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing.
t1: Verily, it is your Lord Who will gather them together (on the Day of Resurrection). Surely, He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.
t2: and it is thy Lord shall muster them, and He is All-wise, All-knowing.
t3: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
en: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud.
t1: And indeed, We originated man’s (chemical) genesis from that dry sounding clay which, (first) having grown old (and under the heat of the sun and other chemical and biological effects), had turned into black stinking mud.
t2: Surely We created man of a clay of mud moulded,
t3: Verily We created man of potter’s clay of black mud altered,

ar: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
en: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire.
t1: And We created jinn before this from a smokeless blazing fire.
t2: and the jinn created We before of fire flaming.
t3: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
en: ˹Remember, O  Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud.
t1: And (recall) when your Lord said to the angels: ‘I am about to create a human organism from old (and) black stinking, resounding mud.
t2: And when thy Lord said to the angels, ’See, I am creating a mortal of a clay of mud moulded.
t3: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter’s clay of black mud altered,

ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
en: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”
t1: So when I accomplish the perfection of his (physical) constitution into his real being, and breathe My (divine) spirit into (the inner self of) this (human physical) organism, then fall down prostrate before him.’
t2: When I have shaped him, and breathed My spirit in him, fall you down, bowing before him!’
t3: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.

ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
en: So the angels prostrated all together—
t1: So, (no sooner did the light of Allah’s effulgence illumine the human organism than) all the angels fell down in prostration together,
t2: Then the angels bowed themselves all together,
t3: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together

ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
en: but not Iblis, who refused to prostrate with the others.
t1: Except Iblis. He refused to join those who prostrated themselves.
t2: save Iblis; he refused to be among those bowing.
t3: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.

ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
en: Allah asked, “O Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”
t1: (Allah) said: ‘O Iblis, what has happened to you that you have not joined those who have prostrated themselves?’
t2: Said He, ’What ails thee, Iblis, that thou art not among those bowing?’
t3: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate ?

ar: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ
en: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”
t1: (Iblis) replied: ‘I cannot be the one who should fall down prostrate before a human being You have created from old (and) black stinking, sounding mud.’
t2: Said he, ’I would never bow myself before a mortal whom Thou hast created of a clay of mud moulded.’
t3: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter’s clay of black mud altered!

ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
en: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed.
t1: (Allah) said: ‘Then get out from here, for you are indeed the cursed one (the outcast).
t2: Said He, ’Then go thou forth hence; thou art accursed.
t3: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.

ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
en: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”
t1: And, verily, the curse will (persistently) rest upon you till the Day of Recompense.’
t2: Upon thee shall rest the curse, till the Day of Doom.’
t3: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
en: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”
t1: He said: ‘O Lord, then grant me respite till the Day (when) people will be raised up (again).’
t2: Said he, ’My Lord, respite me till the day they shall be raised.’
t3: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.

ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
en: Allah said, “You will be delayed
t1: Allah said: ‘So, indeed, you are amongst those granted respite,
t2: Said He, ’Thou art among the ones that are respited
t3: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved

ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
en: until the appointed Day.”
t1: Till the Day of the appointed time (Resurrection).’
t2: unto the day of a known time.’
t3: Till the Day of appointed time.

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together,
t1: Iblis said: ‘O Lord, because You have led me astray, I will (also) best adorn and embellish for them (the sins, revolts and violations) in the earth and will certainly lead all of them astray by all means,
t2: Said he, ’My Lord, for Thy perverting me I shall deck all fair to them in the earth, and I shall pervert them, all together,
t3: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,

ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
en: except Your chosen servants among them.”
t1: Except for those exalted servants of Yours who have attained freedom (from my deceits and intrigues of the ill-commanding selves).’
t2: excepting those Thy servants among them that are devoted.
t3: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.

ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
en: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me:
t1: Allah said: ‘This (freedom from these deceits and intrigues) is the (very) path that leads straight to My Threshold.
t2: Said He, ’This is for Me a straight path:
t3: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:

ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
en: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you,
t1: Surely, you will in no way be able to influence My servants (who have attained this freedom from you) except the misguided lot who have adopted your way.
t2: over My servants thou shalt have no authority, except those that follow thee,
t3: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,

ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together.
t1: And verily, the promised place for all of them is Hell.
t2: being perverse; Gehenna shall be their promised land all together.
t3: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.

ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
en: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”
t1: It has seven doors; for each one a fixed portion of them has been specified.’
t2: Seven gates it has, and unto each gate a set portion of them belongs.’
t3: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
en: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs.
t1: Indeed, the Godfearing will be amid Gardens and fountains.
t2: But the godfearing shall be amidst gardens and fountains:
t3: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.

ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
en: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”
t1: (It will be said to them:) ‘Enter them peacefully, casting aside all fears.’
t2: ’Enter you them, in peace and security!’
t3: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.

ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
en: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another.
t1: And We shall remove from their breasts all spite that they had (in the world against one another due to misunderstanding). They shall be brothers seated on couches face to face (in Paradise).
t2: We shall strip away all rancour that is in their breasts; as brothers they shall be upon couches set face to face;
t3: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.

ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
en: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave.
t1: No discomfort will touch them, nor will they be driven out from there.
t2: no fatigue there shall smite them, neither shall they ever be driven forth from there.
t3: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.

ar: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful,
t1: (O Beloved!) Tell My servants: ‘Indeed, I am Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.’
t2: Tell My servants I am the All-forgiving, the All-compassionate,
t3: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
en: and that My torment is indeed the most painful.
t1: And (also warn) that: ‘It is My torment which is the most grievous torment.’
t2: and that My chastisement is the painful chastisement.
t3: And that My doom is the dolorous doom.

ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
en: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests
t1: And (also) relate to them the news about the guests of Ibrahim (Abraham).
t2: And tell them of the guests of Abraham,
t3: And tell them of Abraham’s guests,

ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
en: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”
t1: When they came to Ibrahim (Abraham), they greeted (him with): ‘Peace.’ Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘We are feeling somewhat afraid of you.’
t2: when they entered unto him, saying, ’Peace!’ He said, ’Behold, we are afraid of you.’
t3: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
en: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”
t1: (The guest angels) said: ‘Do not feel afraid. We give you the glad tidings of (the birth of) a son endowed with knowledge and wisdom.’
t2: They said, ’Be not afraid; behold, we give thee good tidings of a cunning boy.’
t3: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.

ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
en: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”
t1: Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘You are giving me the glad tidings at a time when old age has already overtaken me. So what good news are you giving me now?’
t2: He said, ’What, do you give me good tidings, though old age has smitten me? Of what do you
t3: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me ? Of what then can ye bring good tidings ?

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
en: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”
t1: They said: ‘We give you the good news which is true. So do not lose hope.’
t2: give me good tidings?’ They said, ’We give thee good tidings of truth. Be not of those that despair.’
t3: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.

ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
en: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”
t1: Ibrahim (Abraham) said: ‘Who can lose hope of his Lord’s mercy except the strayed ones?’
t2: He said, ’And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, excepting those that are astray?’
t3: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray ?

ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O  messenger-angels?”
t1: Ibrahim (Abraham) asked: ‘O deputed angels (sent by Allah), what other assignment do you have (to accomplish besides these glad tidings for which you have come)?’
t2: He said, ’And what is your business, envoys?’
t3: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah) ?

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
en: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people.
t1: They said: ‘We have been sent towards a sinful people,
t2: They said, ’We have been sent unto a people of sinners,
t3: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,

ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all,
t1: Except the family of Lut (Lot) all of whom We will indeed save,
t2: excepting the folk of Lot; them we shall deliver
t3: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,

ar: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
en: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”
t1: With the exception of his wife. We have decided that she shall certainly be amongst those who stay back (to become the victims of the torment).’
t2: all together, excepting his wife -- we have decreed, she shall surely be of those that tarry.’
t3: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
t1: Then, when those deputed (angels) came to the house of Lut (Lot),
t2: So, when the envoys came to the folk of Lot,
t3: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,

ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
en: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”
t1: Lut (Lot) said: ‘Indeed, you are (looking) strangers.’
t2: he said, ’Surely you are a people unknown to me!’
t3: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
en: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted.
t1: They said: ‘(No indeed;) in fact we have come to you with the (punishment) about which these people have had doubts.
t2: They said, ’Nay, but we have brought thee that concerning which they were doubting.
t3: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,

ar: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
en: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful.
t1: And we have brought you (the judgment of) the truth and we are certainly truthful.
t2: We have come to thee with the truth, and assuredly we speak truly.
t3: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.

ar: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
en: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”
t1: So set off with your family sometime during the night, and follow them in the rear, and none of you should (even) look back, and proceed to the place (where) you have been commanded.’
t2: So set forth, thou with thy family, in a watch of the night, and follow after the backs of them, and let not any one of you turn round; and depart unto the place you are commanded.’
t3: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.

ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
en: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”
t1: And We informed Lut (Lot) of this judgment through Revelation that the root of these people would be cut off the moment it dawns.
t2: And We decreed for him that commandment, that the last remnant of those should be cut off in the morning.
t3: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.

ar: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
en: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing.
t1: And the people of the city (possessed by their lust) approached (Lut [Lot]), rejoicing.
t2: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
t3: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).

ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
en: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me.
t1: Lut (Lot) said: ‘Surely, they are my guests, so do not put me to shame (about them).
t2: He said, ’These are my guests; put me not to shame,
t3: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!

ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
en: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”
t1: And fear (the wrath of) Allah and do not humiliate me.’
t2: and fear God, and do not degrade me.’
t3: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”
t1: Those (lost in wickedness) said: ‘(O Lut [Lot],) did we not forbid you (to provide protection to) all the people of the world?’
t2: They said, ’Have we not forbidden thee all beings?’
t3: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone ?

ar: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
en: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”
t1: Lut (Lot) said: ‘There are my (people’s) daughters. If you desire to do something (then marry them instead of perpetrating indecency).’
t2: He said, ’These are my daughters, if you would be doing.’
t3: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).

ar: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
en: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺.
t1: (O Glorious Beloved!) By your (sacred) life, surely these people (too) are wandering astray, possessed by their lust (like the people of Lut [Lot]).
t2: By thy life, they wandered blindly in their dazzlement,
t3: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.

ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
en: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise.
t1: So, the blazing blast seized them at sunrise.
t2: and the Cry seized them at the sunrise,
t3: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.

ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
en: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay.
t1: And We turned their town upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay.
t2: and We turned it uppermost nethermost and rained on it stones of baked clay.
t3: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
en: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate.
t1: Verily, in this (occurrence) there are signs for those who possess the ability to probe into reality.
t2: Surely in that are signs for such as mark;
t3: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.

ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
en: Their ruins still lie along a known route.
t1: And truly that town lies along a frequented highway.
t2: surely it is on a way yet remaining;
t3: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe.
t1: Surely, in this (episode of the people of Lut [Lot]), there is a sign of (warning) for the believers.
t2: surely in that is a sign for believers.
t3: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.

ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
en: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers,
t1: And, in reality, the dwellers of al-Ayka (the Thick Wood) too were hardened wrongdoers.
t2: Certainly the dwellers in the Thicket were evildoers,
t3: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.

ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
en: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road.
t1: So We avenged Ourselves on them (as well), and (archeological remains of) both these (towns still exist) on the highway.
t2: and We took vengeance on them. The two of them were upon a roadway manifest.
t3: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.

ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers.
t1: And no doubt, the people of the valley of al-Hijr (the Rock) too denied the Messengers.
t2: The dwellers in El-Hijr cried lies to the Envoys.
t3: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.

ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
en: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them.
t1: And We (also) bestowed upon them Our signs, but they persisted in turning away from them.
t2: We brought them. Our signs, and they turned away from them.
t3: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.

ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
en: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure.
t1: And they used to carve out houses in the mountains without any threat and fear.
t2: They were hewing the mountains into houses, therein dwelling securely;
t3: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.

ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
en: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning,
t1: And the dreadful blast seized them (as well) the moment it dawned.
t2: and the Cry seized them in the morning;
t3: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,

ar: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
en: and all they achieved was of no help to them.
t1: So (the riches) they used to earn could not repel (Allah’s punishment) from them.
t2: that they earned did not avail them.
t3: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
en: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously.
t1: And We have not created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them without any purpose. And the Hour of Resurrection is certainly approaching. So, (O embodiment of excellent morality,) bear with (them) most graciously and effectively with perseverance.
t2: We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, save in truth. Surely the Hour is coming; so pardon thou, with a gracious pardoning.
t3: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing.
t1: Indeed, your Lord alone is the Creator of all things, All-Knowing.
t2: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-creator, the All-knowing.
t3: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
en: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran.
t1: And surely We have bestowed upon you the seven oft-recited Verses (i.e., Chapter al-Fatiha) and the Glorious Qur’an.
t2: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated, and the mighty Koran.
t3: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur’an.

ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers.
t1: Do not even lift your eyes towards the things with which We have benefitted the disbelievers for their (few days’) luxury, nor grieve over their (turning away from the straight path), and keep your wings (of affection and care) lowered over the believers (to make them feel contented and cared for).
t2: Stretch not thine eyes to that We have given pairs of them to enjoy; and do not sorrow for them, and lower thy wing unto the believers,
t3: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.

ar: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—
t1: And say: ‘Indeed, I am (now) the open and clear Warner (of Allah’s torment).’
t2: and say, ’Surely, I am the manifest warner.’
t3: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,

ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
en: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺,
t1: The (torment) that We sent down upon the dividers (i.e., the Jews and the Christians),
t2: So We sent it down to the partitioners,
t3: Such as We send down for those who make division,

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
en: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others.
t1: Those who divided the Qur’an into pieces (and split it, i.e., accepted the favourable Verses but rejected the others).
t2: who have broken the Koran into fragments.
t3: Those who break the Qur’an into parts.

ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all
t1: So, by your Lord, We shall indeed interrogate them all,
t2: Now by thy Lord, We shall surely question them all together
t3: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,

ar: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: about what they used to do.
t1: Pertaining to the works that they used to do.
t2: concerning that they were doing.
t3: Of what they used to do.

ar: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.
t1: So declare openly all those (matters) that you have been commanded, and turn away from those who set up partners with Allah.
t2: So shout that thou art commanded and turn thou away from the idolaters.
t3: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.

ar: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
en: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers,
t1: Surely, We suffice you for (taking them to task) who scoff,
t2: We suffice thee against the mockers,
t3: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know.
t1: Who set up other gods along with Allah. So they will come to know (their end) soon.
t2: even against those who set up with God another god. Certainly they will soon know!
t3: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.

ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
en: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say.
t1: And We indeed know that your (sacred) breast feels straitened by what they say.
t2: We know indeed thy breast is straitened by the things they say.
t3: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,

ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
en: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray,
t1: So glorify your Lord with His praise and live amongst those who prostrate themselves before Him.
t2: Proclaim thy Lord’s praise, and be of those that bow,
t3: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).

ar: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
en: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way.
t1: And worship your Lord till you attain to the station of certainty of faith (which goes with your glory, i.e., perfect cognizance of divinity or the moment of far-nearness to your Lord).
t2: and serve thy Lord, until the Certain comes to thee.
t3: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.

ar: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: The command of Allah is at hand, so do not hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him in worship˺!
t1: The promise of Allah has drawn (near), so do not hasten in seeking it. Holy is He and Exalted far above those objects, which the disbelievers set up as (His) peers.
t2: God’s command comes; so seek not to hasten it. Glory be to Him! High be He exalted above that they associate with Him!
t3: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).

ar: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
en: He sends down the angels with revelation by His command to whoever He wills of His servants, ˹stating:˺ “Warn ˹humanity˺ that there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so be mindful of Me ˹alone˺.”
t1: He alone sends down the angels by His command with Revelation (which is the spirit of all the teachings of Din [Religion]) to those of His servants He likes: ‘Warn (the people) that there is no God except Me, so fear Me against all evils.’
t2: He sends down the angels with the Spirit of His command upon whomsoever He will among His servants, saying: Give you warning that there is no God hut I; so fear you Me!
t3: He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no God save Me, so keep your duty unto Me.

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. Exalted is He above what they associate with Him ˹in worship˺!
t1: He alone has created the heavens and the earth with a decreed celestial order. He is Exalted far above those objects which the disbelievers set up as (His) peers.
t2: He created the heavens and the earth in truth; high be He exalted above that they associate With Him!
t3: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him).

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
en: He created humans from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Him˺.
t1: He alone has created man from a drop of vital fluid, yet he has become openly contentious (instead of becoming totally submissive to Allah).
t2: He created man of a sperm-drop; and, behold, he is a manifest adversary.
t3: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.

ar: وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
en: And He created the cattle for you as a source of warmth, food, and ˹many other˺ benefits.
t1: And He alone has created for you the cattle. They are for you a source of warm clothing and (other) benefits. And you (also) eat some of them.
t2: And the cattle -- He created them for you; in them is warmth, and uses various, and of them you eat,
t3: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat;

ar: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
en: They are also pleasing to you when you bring them home and when you take them out to graze.
t1: And there is beauty in them (and also a joy—an aesthetic pleasure) for you when you drive (them back) in the evening from pasture, and when you drive (them) out in the morning (to graze).
t2: and there is beauty in them for you, when you bring them home to rest and when you drive them forth abroad to pasture;
t3: And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture.

ar: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
en: And they carry your loads to ˹distant˺ lands which you could not otherwise reach without great hardship. Surely your Lord is Ever Gracious, Most Merciful.
t1: And these (animals also) carry your loads to those distant cities (and remote areas) where you cannot reach (otherwise) without toiling hard. Surely, your Lord is Most Clement, Ever-Merciful.
t2: and they bear your loads unto a land that you never would reach, excepting with great distress. Surely your Lord is All-clement, All-compassionate.
t3: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.

ar: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةًۭ ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
en: ˹He also created˺ horses, mules, and donkeys for your transportation and adornment. And He creates what you do not know.
t1: And (He is the One Who has created) horses, mules and donkeys so that you may ride them, and that they may serve as means of adornment (for you) as well, and He will (further) create (such ornamented means of conveyance) that you do not know (today).
t2: And horses, and mules, and asses, for you to ride, and as an adornment; and He creates what you know not.
t3: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.

ar: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌۭ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: It is upon Allah ˹alone˺ to ˹clearly˺ show the Straight Way. Other ways are deviant. Had He willed, He would have easily imposed guidance upon all of you.
t1: And the middle course reaches (the door of) Allah, and many crooked side tracks also (branch off) from it. And had He so willed, He would have guided all of you.
t2: God’s it is to show the way; and some do swerve from it. If He willed, He would have guided you all together.
t3: And Allah’s is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright.

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌۭ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌۭ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
en: He is the One Who sends down rain from the sky, from which you drink and by which plants grow for your cattle to graze.
t1: He is the One Who has sent down for you water from the sky. (Some) of it is to drink and (some) of it is for plantation. (You grow with it plants, vegetation and pastures) wherein you take (your cattle) to graze.
t2: It is He who sends down to you out of heaven water of which you have to drink, and of which trees, for you to pasture your herds,
t3: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture.

ar: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
en: With it He produces for you ˹various˺ crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and every type of fruit. Surely in this is a sign for those who reflect.
t1: With the same water, He grows for you crops and olives and date-palms and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Indeed, there are signs in it for those who reflect and meditate.
