t3: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
en: After that you will surely die,
t1: Then certainly, after this (life), you shall die.
t2: Then after that you shall surely die,
t3: Then lo! after that ye surely die.

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
en: then on the Day of Judgment you will be resurrected.
t1: Then indeed, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be raised up (after brought to life).
t2: then on the Day of Resurrection you shall surely be raised up.
t3: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
en: And indeed, We created above you seven levels ˹of heaven˺. We are never unmindful of ˹Our˺ creation.
t1: And surely, We have created above you seven paths (i.e., seven magnetic paths or fields, around the vast atmospheric expanse of the planet earth, for the safeguard of the cosmic system). And We were not unaware of the creation (of the universe and the pre-requisites of its security).
t2: And We created above you seven ways, and We were not heedless of creation.
t3: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.

ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
en: We send down rain from the sky in perfect measure, causing it to soak into the earth. And We are surely able to take it away.
t1: And We showered water persistently (for a long time) from the clouds according to an estimated measure. So (when the earth became cool then) We lodged this water in (the depressions and depths of) the earth (shaping into preliminary forms of oceans). And verily, We have the power to make it evaporate (as vapours).
t2: And We sent down out of heaven water in measure and lodged it in the earth; and We are able to take it away.
t3: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.

ar: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
en: With it We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are abundant fruits, and from which you may eat,
t1: Then by means of this We caused to grow for you (step by step firstly herbs, then plants and then trees and) the gardens of dates and grapes. (Furthermore, We created) for you many (other) fruits of which you eat (now).
t2: Then We produced for you therewith gardens of palms and vines wherein are many fruits for you, and of them you eat,
t3: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;

ar: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ
en: as well as ˹olive˺ trees which grow at Mount Sinai, providing oil and a condiment to eat.
t1: And (We have also created for you the olive) tree, which grows forth from Mount Sinai, (and) contains oil, and is a curry for those who eat.
t2: and a tree issuing from the Mount of Sinai that bears oil and seasoning for all to eat.
t3: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.

ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
en: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle, from whose bellies We give you ˹milk˺ to drink, and in them are many other benefits for you, and from them you may eat.
t1: And for you indeed there are (also) aspects to the cattle that need contemplation: We make you drink (milk We prepare from some ingredients) of what is in their bellies. And there are for you (also) many (other) benefits in them, and you eat (some) of them (as well).
t2: And surely in the cattle there is a lesson for you; We give you to drink of what is in their bellies, and many uses there are in them for you, and of them you eat;
t3: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;

ar: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
en: And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships.
t1: And you are (also) borne upon them and on boats.
t2: and upon them, and on the ships, you are borne.
t3: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people. He declared, “O my people! Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
t1: And surely, We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people. He said: ‘O people, always worship Allah. There is no God for you other than He. So do you not fear?’
t2: And We sent Noah to his people; and he, said, ’O my people, serve God! You have no god other than He. Will you not be godfearing?"
t3: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other God save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil) ?

ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: But the disbelieving chiefs of his people said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you, who wants to be superior to you. Had Allah willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. We have never heard of this in ˹the history of˺ our forefathers.
t1: Then the chiefs (and the lords) of his people who disbelieved said: ‘This man is just a human being like you (nothing else). He seeks to establish (his) superiority and predominance over you. And if Allah wanted (to send some Messenger for guidance), He would send down angels. We have never heard of it from our ancestors (that a human being like us should be appointed as our Messenger).
t2: Said the Council of the unbelievers of his people, ’This is naught but a mortal like yourselves, who desires to gain superiority over you. And if God willed, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of this among, our fathers, the ancients.
t3: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
en: He is simply insane, so bear with him for a while.”
t1: He is nothing but a man (afflicted) with madness. So wait for him, for a while (and keep an eye on what he does next).’
t2: He is naught but a man bedevilled; so wait on him for a time.
t3: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
en: Noah prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”
t1: Nuh (Noah) submitted: ‘O my Lord, help me because they have rejected me.’
t2: He said, ’O my Lord, help me, for that they cry me lies.’
t3: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.

ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
en: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts ˹with water˺, take on board a pair from every species along with your family—except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed. And do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”
t1: Then We revealed to him: ‘Build an Ark under Our supervision according to Our command. So when Our command (for torment) comes and the (water-filled) oven starts overflowing, load into it of every kind of animals two pairs each (male and female) and also your family, except that one amongst them about whom the command (of torment) has already been issued. And also do not supplicate Me concerning those who have wronged (by denying and mocking you). They shall (surely) be drowned.
t2: Then We said to him, ’Make thou the Ark under Our eyes and as We reveal, and then, when Our command comes and the Oven boils, insert in it two of every kind and thy, family -- except for him against whom the word already has been spoken; and address Me not concerning those who have done evil; they shall be drowned.
t3: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.

ar: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: Then when you and those with you have settled in the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
t1: So when you and the (people) accompanying you get settled in the Ark, then say: All praise be to Allah alone, Who has delivered us from the unjust people.
t2: Then, when thou art seated in the Ark and those with thee, say, "Praise belongs to God, who has delivered us from the people of the evildoers."
t3: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!

ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
en: And pray, “My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”
t1: And submit: O my Lord, land me at a blessed destination, and You are the Best of all who bring to land.’
t2: And say, "’O my Lord, do Thou harbour me in a blessed harbour, for Thou art the best of harbourers."
t3: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
en: Surely in this are lessons. And We ˹always˺ put ˹people˺ to the test.
t1: Surely in this (event), there are (many) signs and We do certainly make trials.
t2: Surely in that are signs, and surely We put to the test.
t3: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.

ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: Then We raised another generation after them,
t1: Then We raised after them another community.
t2: Thereafter, after them, We produced another generation,
t3: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;

ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: and sent to them a messenger from among themselves, ˹declaring,˺ “Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
t1: So We sent amongst them (also) a Messenger from amongst themselves: ‘Worship Allah. There is no God for you other than He. So do you not fear?’
t2: and We sent amongst them a Messenger of themselves, saying, ’Serve God! You have no god other than He. Will you not be godfearing?’
t3: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other God save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil) ?

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
en: But the chiefs of his people—who disbelieved, denied the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, and were spoiled by the worldly luxuries We had provided for them—said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you. He eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink.
t1: And thus proclaimed the chiefs (and the lords) of his people (too) who disbelieved and rejected the meeting of the Hereafter and whom We had (also) given prosperity (on account of abundant wealth) in the worldly life: ‘He is only a human being like you. He eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
t2: Said the Council of the unbelievers of his people, who cried lies to the encounter of the world to come, and to whom We had given ease in the present’ life, ’This is naught but a mortal like yourselves, who eats of what you eat and drinks of what you drink.
t3: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.

ar: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
en: And if you ˹ever˺ obey a human like yourselves, then you would certainly be losers.
t1: And if you obey a human being like yourselves, then you shall be the sure losers.
t2: If you obey a mortal like yourselves, then you will be losers.
t3: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.

ar: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
en: Does he promise you that once you are dead and reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth ˹alive˺?
t1: Does he promise you that, when you die and become dust and (decomposed) bones, you will be brought forth (alive again)?
t2: What, does he promise you that when you are dead, and become dust and bones, you shall be brought forth?
t3: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth ?

ar: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
en: Impossible, simply impossible is what you are promised!
t1: Far (from understanding), far (off from likelihood) are the things you are being promised.
t2: Away, away with that you are promised!
t3: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!

ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
en: There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.
t1: There is nothing (like life after death). Our life is only this world. We live and die (here alone) and (that is all). We shall not be raised up (again).
t2: There is nothing but our present life; we die, and we live, and we shall not be raised up.
t3: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: He is no more than a man who has fabricated a lie about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”
t1: He is merely a man who has put a false blame on Allah, and we are not going to believe in him at all.’
t2: He is naught but a man who has forged against God a lie, and we will not believe him.’
t3: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
en: The messenger prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”
t1: (The Prophet) submitted: ‘O my Lord, help me in the circumstances that they have rejected me.’
t2: He said, ’O my Lord, help me, for that they cry me lies.’
t3: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.

ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
en: Allah responded, “Soon they will be truly regretful.”
t1: (Allah) said: ‘They will be full of regret in a little while.’
t2: He said, ’In a little they will be remorseful.’
t3: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.

ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: Then the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them with justice, and We reduced them to rubble. So away with the wrongdoing people!
t1: So, according to the true promise, the dreadful Blast seized them, and We made them a waste of withered grass. Far distant from, and deprived (of, Our mercy) are the unjust and wrongdoing people.
t2: And the Cry seized them justly, and We made them as scum; so away with the people of the evildoers!
t3: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!

ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: Then We raised other generations after them.
t1: Later We raised after them other communities (one after the other).
t2: Thereafter, after them, We produced other generations;
t3: Then after them We brought forth other generations.

ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
en: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it.
t1: No community can step ahead of its appointed time, nor can it step back.
t2: no nation outstrips its term, nor do they put it back.
t3: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.

ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to his people, they denied him. So We destroyed them, one after the other, reducing them to ˹cautionary˺ tales. So away with the people who refuse to believe!
t1: Then We sent Our Messengers one after the other. Whenever there came to a community their Messenger, they rejected him. Then We also destroyed them one after another (by successive torments) and We reduced them to mere tales. So woe to the people who do not believe!
t2: Then sent We Our Messengers successively; whenever its Messenger came to a nation they cried him lies, so We caused some of them to follow others, and We made them as but tales; so away with a people who do not believe!
t3: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!

ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and compelling proof
t1: Then We sent Musa (Moses) and his brother Harun (Aaron) with Our signs and an evident authority,
t2: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a manifest authority
t3: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant

ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
en: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a tyrannical people.
t1: To Pharaoh and the chiefs (of his people). They too behaved with arrogance and conceit. And they too were (extremely) wrongdoing and a disobedient people.
t2: unto Pharaoh and his Council; but they waxed proud, and they were a lofty people,
t3: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.

ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
en: They argued, “Will we believe in two humans, like ourselves, whose people are slaves to us?”
t1: So they (also) said (the same): ‘Shall we believe in two human beings like ourselves whilst their people worship us?’
t2: and they said, ’What, shall we believe two mortals like ourselves, whose people are our servants?’
t3: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us ?

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
en: So they rejected them both, and ˹so˺ were among those destroyed.
t1: They (also) belied both of them. So they too became of those who were eliminated.
t2: So they cried them lies, and they were among the destroyed.
t3: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so perhaps his people would be ˹rightly˺ guided.
t1: And indeed, We gave Musa (Moses) the Book so that they might take guidance.
t2: And We gave Moses the Book, that haply they would be guided;
t3: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them refuge on high ground—a ˹suitable˺ place for rest with flowing water.
t1: And We made ‘Isa (Jesus), the son of Maryam (Mary), and his mother Our (great) sign. And We provided them a comfortable and facilitated abode on a pleasant, elevated ground fit for living with ease and comfort, and there was flowing water (i.e., streams, waterfalls and springs—a feast) for sight.
t2: and We made Mary’s son, and his mother, to be a sign, and gave them refuge upon a height, where was a hollow and a spring:
t3: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
en: O messengers! Eat from what is good and lawful, and act righteously. Indeed, I fully know what you do.
t1: O (My Esteemed) Messengers! Eat of the pure things (as your practice is) and do good deeds with persistence. Surely, I am Well Aware of whatever (deed) you do.
t2: ’O Messengers, eat of the good things and do righteousness; surely I know the things you do.
t3: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.

ar: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
en: Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺.
t1: And surely, this is your Umma ([Community] which is in fact) but one Umma (Community) and I am your Lord. Therefore, always fear Me.
t2: Surely this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord; so fear Me.’
t3: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.

ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
en: Yet the people have divided it into different sects, each rejoicing in what they have.
t1: But they broke the command of their din (religion) into sects by disagreeing amongst themselves. Each sect is pleased with that much (portion of din [religion]) which they have.
t2: But they split in their affair between them into sects, each party rejoicing in what is with them.
t3: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.

ar: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
en: So leave them ˹O Prophet˺ in their heedlessness for a while.
t1: So leave them ditched in their ignorance and error for a time.
t2: So leave thou them in their perplexity for a time.
t3: So leave them in their error till a time.

ar: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
en: Do they think, since We provide them with wealth and children,
t1: Do they think that the help We are giving them (in this world) in the shape of wealth and children,
t2: What, do they think that We succour them with of wealth and children,
t3: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them

ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: that We hasten to ˹honour˺ them ˹with˺ all kinds of good? No! They are not aware.
t1: (Implies that) We are hastening (the provision of) good things to them? (Nay!) The truth is that they have no awareness.
t2: We vie in good works for them? Nay, but they are not aware.
t3: We hasten unto them with good things ? Nay, but they perceive not.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
en: Surely those who tremble in awe of their Lord,
t1: Indeed, those who remain restless and tremble with fear of their Lord,
t2: Surely those who tremble in fear of their Lord
t3: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: and who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
t1: And those who believe in the Revelations of their Lord,
t2: and those who believe in the signs of their Lord
t3: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: and who associate none with their Lord,
t1: And those who do not associate (any) partners with their Lord,
t2: and those who associate naught with their Lord
t3: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
en: and who do whatever ˹good˺ they do with their hearts fearful, ˹knowing˺ that they will return to their Lord—
t1: And those who give away (in the way of Allah as much) as they can, yet (in spite of that) their hearts fear that they are to return to their Lord (lest it should be rejected),
t2: and those who give what they give, their hearts quaking that they are returning to their Lord --
t3: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
en: it is they who race to do good deeds, always taking the lead.
t1: It is these people who are hastening in (collecting) good works, and it is they who excel in this pursuit.
t2: those vie in good works, outracing to them.
t3: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.

ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
en: We never require of any soul more than what it can afford. And with Us is a record which speaks the truth. None will be wronged.
t1: And We do not strain any soul but commensurate with its capacity, and with Us is the record (of deeds) which will speak the truth, and they will not be wronged.
t2: We charge not any soul save to its capacity, and with Us is a Book speaking truth, and they shall not be wronged.
t3: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.

ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
en: But the hearts of those ˹who disbelieve˺ are oblivious to ˹all of˺ this, and they have other ˹evil˺ deeds, opposite to this, in which they are engrossed.
t1: But their hearts are in (utter) negligence of this (message of the Qur’an) and (also) besides that, there are many other (evil) deeds which they are doing,
t2: Nay, but their hearts are in perplexity as to this, and they have deeds besides that that they are doing.
t3: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur’an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
en: But as soon as We seize their elite with torment, they start to cry for help.
t1: Until when We seize the rich and the prosperous of them with torment, then they will cry out.
t2: Till, when We seize with the chastisement the ones of them that live at ease, behold, they groan.
t3: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.

ar: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
en: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry for help today. Surely you will never be saved from Us.
t1: (It will be said to them:) ‘Do not cry today. Surely, you will not be helped by Us.’
t2: ’Groan not today; surely you shall not be helped from Us.
t3: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.

ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
en: Indeed, My revelations were recited to you, but you used to back away ˹in disgust˺,
t1: Certainly, My Verses were repeatedly recited to you but you used to turn back on your heels.
t2: My signs were recited to you, but upon your heels you withdrew,
t3: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,

ar: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ
en: boasting of the Sacred House, and babbling ˹nonsense about the Quran˺ by night.”
t1: Displaying haughtiness and arrogance against it, you used to utter absurdity in the darkness of night.
t2: waxing proud against it, talking foolish talk by night.’
t3: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.

ar: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: Is it because they have never contemplated the Word ˹of Allah˺? Or ˹because˺ there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers?
t1: So have they not pondered over this command (of Allah)? Or has there come to them such a thing that did not come to their fathers?
t2: Have they not pondered the saying, or came there upon them that which came not upon their fathers, the ancients?
t3: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old ?

ar: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
en: Or ˹because˺ they failed to recognize their Messenger, and so they denied him?
t1: Or have they not recognized their Messenger and (so) they deny him?
t2: Or did they not recognise their Messenger and so denied him?
t3: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him ?

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
en: Or ˹because˺ they say, “He is insane?” In fact, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are resentful of the truth.
t1: Or do they say: ‘He (the Prophet) is (afflicted) with mania’? (Nay, not at all;) he has rather brought to them the truth, but most of them do not like the truth.
t2: Or do they say, ’He is bedevilled’? Nay, he has brought them the truth, but most of them are averse from the truth.
t3: Or say they: There is a madness in him ? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.

ar: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
en: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and all those in them would have certainly been corrupted. In fact, We have brought them ˹the means to˺ their glory, but they turn away from it.
t1: And had the (holy) truth (Allah) followed their vain desires, then (all) the heavens and the earth and whatever (living and non-living things) are therein, all would have been destroyed. We have rather brought them that (Qur’an) which contains (the secret of) their honour, dignity (and fame). So it is from their own honour that they are turning away.
t2: Had the truth followed their caprices, the heavens and the earth and whosoever in them is had surely corrupted. Nay, We brought them their Remembrance, but from their Remembrance they turned.
t3: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.

ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
en: Or ˹is it because˺ you ˹O Prophet˺ are asking them for tribute? But the reward of your Lord is best, for He is the Best Provider.
t1: Do you demand of them any recompense (for preaching the faith in Messengership? Nay, that too is not the case.) The recompense of your Lord itself is (by far) the best and He is the Best of all sustainers.
t2: Or dost thou ask them for tribute? Yet the tribute of thy Lord is better, and He is the best of providers.
t3: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute ? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.

ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
en: And surely you are calling them to the Straight Path,
t1: And surely, you call them to the straight path (for their own good).
t2: Assuredly thou art calling them to a straight path;
t3: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.

ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
en: but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from that Path.
t1: And surely, those who do not believe in the Hereafter remain deviated from the (straight) path.
t2: and surely they that believe not in the world to come are deviating from the path.
t3: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.

ar: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
en: ˹Even˺ if We had mercy on them and removed their affliction, they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
t1: And if We have mercy on them and remove the distress that has (afflicted) them, they will become hardened in their transgression, wandering disorientated.
t2: Did We have mercy on them, and remove the affliction that is upon them, they would persist in their insolence wandering blindly.
t3: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
en: And We have already seized them with torment, but they never humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they ˹submissively˺ appeal ˹to Him˺.
t1: And indeed, We seized them with torment, but (still) they did not adopt submissiveness to their Lord, nor did they entreat in humility (before His presence),
t2: We already seized them with the chastisement, yet they abased not themselves to their Lord nor were they humble;
t3: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
en: But as soon as We open for them a gate of severe punishment, they will be utterly desperate.
t1: Until when We open to them the gate of an extremely harsh torment, (then,) at that time, taken aback, they will (stay) therein, stunned in despair.
t2: until, when We open against them a door of terrible chastisement, lo, they are sore confounded at it.
t3: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
en: He is the One Who created for you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks.
t1: And He is the One Who (gradually) made for you ears and eyes and hearts (and minds), but you give very little thanks.
t2: It is He who produced for you hearing, and eyes, and hearts; little thanks you show.
t3: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
en: And He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered.
t1: And He is the One Who created and then scattered you in the earth, and before Him will you be gathered.
t2: It is He who scattered you in the earth, and to Him you shall be mustered.
t3: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the day and night. Will you not then understand?
t1: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and in His control is (also) the alternation of night and day. So do you not understand?
t2: It is He who gives life, and makes to die, and to Him belongs the alternation of night and day; what, will you not understand?
t3: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense ?

ar: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
en: But they ˹just˺ say what their predecessors said.
t1: But these people (too) utter similar words that the former (disbelievers) used to utter.
t2: Nay, but they said the like of what the ancients said.
t3: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
en: They said, “Once we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?
t1: They say: ‘When we die and turn into dust and (decomposed) bones, then shall we be raised up (after given life again)?’
t2: They said, ’What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be indeed raised up?
t3: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again ?

ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”
t1: Surely, this is what we and our fathers have (also) been promised. These (sayings) are but the tales of the bygone people.
t2: We and our fathers have been promised this before; this is naught but the fairy-tales of the ancients.’
t3: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.

ar: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: Ask ˹them, O  Prophet˺, “To whom belong the earth and all those on it, if you ˹really˺ know?”
t1: Say (to them): ‘To whom belongs the earth and everyone (living) in it, if you know (anything)?’
t2: Say: ’Whose is the earth, and whoso is in it, if you have knowledge?’
t3: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge ?

ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: They will reply, “To Allah!” Say, “Why are you not then mindful?”
t1: They will promptly say: ‘(All) belongs to Allah.’ (Then) say: ‘Then why do you not accept guidance?’
t2: They will say, God’s.’ Say: ’Will you not then remember?’
t3: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember ?

ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: ˹And˺ ask ˹them˺, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”
t1: Ask (them): ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Mighty Throne (i.e., the Sovereign Authority of the entire universe)?’
t2: Say: ’Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the mighty Throne?’
t3: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne ?

ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”
t1: They will spontaneously say: ‘(All) this belongs to Allah.’ Say: ‘Then why do you not fear?’
t2: They will say, ’God’s.’ Say: ’Will you not then be godfearing?’
t3: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him) ?

ar: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: Ask ˹them also,˺ “In Whose Hands is the authority over all things, protecting ˹all˺ while none can protect against Him, if you ˹really˺ know?”
t1: Say (to them): ‘Who is He in Whose Mighty Hand is the absolute ownership of everything and Who gives asylum, but against Whom no asylum can be given, if you know (anything)?’
t2: Say: ’In whose hand is the dominion of everything, protecting and Himself unprotected, if you have knowledge?’
t3: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge ?

ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
en: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “How are you then so deluded?”
t1: They will readily say: ‘That is all Allah’s (glory).’ So, say: ‘From where then are you being deceived (as if under a spell)?’
t2: They will say, ’God’s.’ Say: ’How then are you bewitched?
t3: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched ?

ar: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
en: In fact, We have brought them the truth, and they are certainly liars.
t1: The fact is that We have brought them the truth, and they are liars without any doubt.
t2: Nay, but We brought them the truth and they are truly liars.
t3: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.

ar: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
en: Allah has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he created, and they would have tried to dominate one another. Glorified is Allah above what they claim!
t1: Allah has not taken (to Himself) any son, nor is there any god with Him. In that case, each god would certainly have taken (away) what he had created, and they would surely have dominated each other (and the whole universe would have undergone violence and chaos). Glorified is Allah, above all that they describe.
t2: God has not taken to Himself any son, nor is there any god with Him; for then each god would have taken off that he created and some of them would have risen up over others; glory to be God, beyond that they describe,
t3: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.

ar: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen. Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺.
t1: (He) is the Knower of (all things) hidden and disclosed. So He is Exalted, High above all what they associate with Him.
t2: who has knowledge of the Unseen and the Visible; high exalted be He, above that they associate!
t3: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!

ar: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Should You show me what they are threatened with,
t1: Pray: ‘O my Lord, if You would show me that (torment) which they are being promised,
t2: Say: ’O my Lord, if Thou shouldst show me that they are promised,
t3: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.

ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: then, my Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”
t1: (Then,) my Lord, put me not amongst the unjust people.’
t2: O my Lord, put me not among the people of the evildoers.’
t3: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.

ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
en: We are indeed able to show you what We have threatened them with.
t1: And We certainly have the power to show you that (torment) of which We are making them a promise.
t2: Assuredly, We are able to show thee that We promise them.
t3: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.

ar: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
en: Respond to evil with what is best. We know well what they claim.
t1: Repel evil in such a way as is best of all. We know best (the things) they say.
t2: Repel thou the evil with that which is fairer. We Ourselves know very well that they describe.
t3: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.

ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
en: And say, “My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils.
t1: And say, (praying): ‘O my Lord, I seek Your shelter from the promptings of the satans.
t2: And say: ’O my Lord, I take refuge in Thee from the evil suggestions of the Satans,
t3: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,

ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
en: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, that they ˹even˺ come near me.”
t1: And, O my Lord, also I seek refuge with You lest they should come to me.’
t2: and I take refuge in Thee, O my Lord, lest they attend me.’
t3: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
en: When death approaches any of them, they cry, “My Lord! Let me go back,
t1: Until when death comes to any of them, (then) he will say: ‘O my Lord, send me back (to the world),
t2: Till, when death comes to one of them, he says, ’My Lord, return me;
t3: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,

ar: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
en: so I may do good in what I left behind.” Never! It is only a ˹useless˺ appeal they make. And there is a barrier behind them until the Day they are resurrected.
t1: So that I may do some righteous works in that (world) which I have left behind.’ No way! He will be saying this (only in despair). And ahead of them is a barrier (erected) till the Day (when) they will be raised up (from the graves).
t2: haply I shall do righteousness in that I forsook.’ Nay, it is but a word he speaks; and there; behind them, is a barrier until the day that they shall be raised up.
t3: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.

ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
en: Then, when the Trumpet will be blown,
t1: Then when the trumpet will be blown, neither will any relation remain (intact) amongst them that Day, nor will they be able to ask of one another.
t2: For when the Trumpet is blown, that day there shall be no kinship any more between them, neither will they question one another.
t3: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.

ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
en: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful.
t1: So they whose scales will weigh heavy (due to a great number of good deeds) will be successful and prosperous.
t2: Then he whose scales are heavy -- they are the prosperers,
t3: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.

ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
en: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever.
t1: And the ones whose scales will be light (due to the little weight of good deeds), it is they who have harmed themselves. They are permanent residents of Hell.
t2: and he whose scales are light -- they have lost their souls in Gehenna dwelling forever,
t3: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.

ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
en: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed.
t1: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will be lying in it with teeth bulging out and mouths deformed.
t2: the Fire smiting their faces the while they glower there.
t3: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.

ar: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”
t1: (It will be said to them:) ‘Were My Revelations not repeatedly recited to you, and then you used to belie them?’
t2: ’What, were My signs not recited to you, and you cried them lies?’
t3: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them ?

ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ
en: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people.
t1: They will say: ‘O our Lord, our misfortune overwhelmed us, and surely we were the misguided people.
t2: They shall say, ’Our Lord, our adversity prevailed over us; we were an erring people.
t3: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.

ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
en: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”
t1: O our Lord! Take us out from here. Then if we repeat (the same error), we shall certainly be the wrongdoers.’
t2: Our Lord, bring us forth out of it! Then, if we revert, we shall be evildoers indeed.’
t3: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.

ar: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
en: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺!
t1: (Allah will) say: ‘Stay on therein with disgrace and do not speak to Me.
t2: ’Slink you into it,’ He shall say, ’and do not speak to Me.
t3: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
en: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’
t1: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who used to submit (before My presence): O our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us. And (surely) You are the Best of the merciful.
t2: There is a party of My servants who said, "Our Lord, we believe; therefore forgive us, and have mercy on us, for Thou art the best of the merciful."
t3: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;

ar: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
en: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them.
t1: But you used to laugh at them till they made you forget My remembrance and you (just) continued making fun of them.
t2: But you took them for a laughing-stock, till they made you forget My remembrance, mocking at them.
t3: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.

ar: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
en: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”
t1: This Day, I have bestowed upon them (this) reward for their patience that they have triumphed.’
t2: Now today I have recompensed them for their patient endurance; they are the triumphant.’
t3: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.

ar: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
en: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”
t1: (Allah) will say: ‘How many years have you stayed in the earth?’
t2: He shall say, ’How long have you tarried in the earth, by number of years?’
t3: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years ?

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
en: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”
t1: They will say: ‘We might have stayed there a day or part of a day, but ask those who work out statistics.’
t2: They shall say, ’We have tarried a day, or part of a day; ask the numberers!’
t3: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!

ar: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew.
t1: (Allah) will say: ‘You stayed there but very little. Would that you knew (it there)!’
t2: He shall say, ’You have tarried but a little, did you know.
t3: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.

ar: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
en: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”
t1: So did you think that We had created you in vain (without any purpose) and that you would not return to Us?
t2: What, did you think that We created you only for sport, and that you would not be returned to Us?’
t3: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us ?

ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
en: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne.
t1: So Allah, the True Sovereign, is High and Exalted. There is no God but He. He alone is the Lord of the Venerated Throne (i.e., Authority).
t2: Then high exalted be God, the King, the True! There is no god but He? the Lord of the noble Throne.
t3: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no God save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.

ar: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
en: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed.
t1: And anyone who worships another god along with Allah has no proof of this. So he will be accountable for that to his Lord alone. Surely, the disbelievers will not be successful.
t2: And whosoever calls upon another god with God, whereof he has no proof, his reckoning is with his Lord; surely the unbelievers shall not prosper.
t3: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.

ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”
t1: And submit: ‘O my Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You (alone) are the Best of those who have mercy.’
t2: And say: ’My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for Thou art the best of the merciful.’
t3: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.

ar: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: ˹This is˺ a sûrah which We have revealed and made ˹its rulings˺ obligatory, and revealed in it clear commandments so that you may be mindful.
t1: This is a (great) Sura (chapter) which We have revealed and We have made its (commandments) obligatory. And We have sent down in it clear Revelations so that you may take direction and guidance.
t2: A sura that We have sent down and appointed; and We have sent down in it signs, clear signs, that haply you will remember.
t3: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.

ar: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍۢ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌۭ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: As for female and male fornicators, give each of them one hundred lashes, and do not let pity for them make you lenient in ˹enforcing˺ the law of Allah, if you ˹truly˺ believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a number of believers witness their punishment.
t1: Whip a hundred lashes each, the (unmarried) adulteress and the adulterer (on validation of adultery in accordance with the conditions of the statutory [hadd] punishment. If married, then both are to be stoned to death). And you should not feel even the slightest pity in Allah’s Din (Religion) for either of them (in executing the command), if you have faith in Allah and the Last Day. And a (sizeable) party of Muslims should be present on (the occasion of) award of punishment to both of them.
t2: The fornicatress and the fornicator -- scourge each one of them a hundred stripes, and in the matter of God’s religion let no tenderness for them seize you if you believe in God and the Last Day; and let a party of the believers witness their chastisement.
t3: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment.

ar: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةًۭ وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌۭ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: A male fornicator would only marry a female fornicator or idolatress. And a female fornicator would only be married to a fornicator or idolater. This is ˹all˺ forbidden to the believers.
t1: An adulterer does not (like to) marry (a chaste and virtuous woman) but only an adulteress or a polytheist, and no (pious man likes to) marry an adulteress (too) but only an adulterer or a polytheist. And this act (i.e., adultery) has been forbidden to the Muslims.
t2: The fornicator shall marry none but a fornicatress or an idolatress, and the fornicatress -- none shall marry her but a fornicator or an idolator; that is forbidden to the believers.
t3: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلْدَةًۭ وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدًۭا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
en: Those who accuse chaste women ˹of adultery˺ and fail to produce four witnesses, give them eighty lashes ˹each˺. And do not ever accept any testimony from them—for they are indeed the rebellious—
t1: And those who accuse chaste women (of adultery), then fail to produce four witnesses, whip them eighty lashes (as qadhaf—the punishment for false accusation of adultery) and never accept their evidence. And it is they who are the evildoers,
t2: And those who cast it up on women in wedlock, and then bring not four witnesses, scourge them with eighty stripes, and do not accept any testimony of theirs ever; those -- they are the ungodly,
t3: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
en: except those who repent afterwards and mend their ways, then surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t1: Except for those who repent after this (false blaming) and mend their ways. Then Allah is verily Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful. (They will not be counted amongst the disobedient, but this will not exempt them from hadd al-qadhaf [the penalty for false accusation of adultery].)
t2: save such as repent thereafter and make amends; surely God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
t3: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: And those who accuse their wives ˹of adultery˺ but have no witness except themselves, the accuser must testify, swearing four times by Allah that he is telling the truth,
t1: And those who accuse their wives (of adultery) and have no witnesses except themselves, the testimony of such a person is to swear (himself) four times by Allah that he is truthful (in his accusation),
t2: And those who cast it up on their wives having no witnesses except themselves, the testimony of one of them shall be to testify by God four times that he is of the truthful,
t3: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth;

ar: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
en: and a fifth oath that Allah may condemn him if he is lying.
t1: And the fifth time (to say) that Allah’s curse be upon him if he is a liar.
t2: and a fifth time, that the curse of God shall be upon him, if he should be of the liars.
t3: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie.

ar: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
en: For her to be spared the punishment, she must swear four times by Allah that he is telling a lie,
t1: And (similarly) this can avert punishment from that (woman too) if she (herself) gives evidence, swearing four times by Allah that he (the husband) is a liar (in accusing her),
t2: It shall avert from her the chastisement if she testify by God four times that he is of the liars,
t3: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false,

ar: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: and a fifth oath that Allah may be displeased with her if he is telling the truth.
t1: And the fifth time (to say) that Allah’s wrath be upon her if he (the husband) is truthful.
t2: and a fifth time, that the wrath of God shall be upon her, if he should be of the truthful.
t3: And a fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaketh truth.

ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ
en: ˹You would have suffered,˺ had it not been for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you, and had Allah not been Accepting of Repentance, All-Wise.
t1: And had there not been Allah’s grace and mercy upon you, (then you would have been more perturbed under such circumstances) and Allah is surely Most Relenting, All-Wise.
t2: But for God’s bounty to you and His mercy and that God turns, and is All-wise --
t3: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone).

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌۭ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّۭا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُم مَّا ٱكْتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلْإِثْمِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
en: Indeed, those who came up with that ˹outrageous˺ slander are a group of you. Do not think this is bad for you. Rather, it is good for you. he will suffer a tremendous punishment.
t1: Surely those who fabricated the accusation (against ‘A’isha the truthful, the pure, the chaste—may Allah be well pleased with her) were (also) a party from amongst you. Do not consider this (slander account) as a bad thing for you. It has rather (turned out to be) good for you.* Every one of them has a share in the sin as much as he has earned it, but whoever has had a major share in this (false accusation), for him is a terrible torment.
t2: Those who came with the slander are a band of you; do not reckon it evil for you; rather it is good for you. Every man of them shall have the sin that he has earned charged to him; and whosoever of them took upon himself the greater part of it, him there awaits a mighty chastisement.
t3: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom.

ar: لَّوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
en: If only the believing men and women had thought well of one another, when you heard this ˹rumour˺, and said, “This is clearly ˹an outrageous˺ slander!”
t1: Why did it not happen that when you heard of it (the slander), the believers, both men and women, would think good of their own people and say: ‘This is obviously a fabricated accusation (based on falsehood)’?
t2: Why, when you heard it, did the believing men and women not of their own account think good thoughts, and say, ’This is a manifest calumny’?
t3: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth ?

ar: لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰذِبُونَ
en: Why did they not produce four witnesses? Now, since they have failed to produce witnesses, they are ˹truly˺ liars in the sight of Allah.
t1: Why did these (slanderers) not produce four witnesses to this (turmoil)? Since they could not bring forth witnesses, it is certainly they who are liars in the sight of Allah.
t2: Why did they not bring four witnesses against it? But since they did not bring the witnesses, in God’s sight they are the liars.
t3: Why did they not produce four witnesses ? Since they produce not witnesses, they verily are liars in the sight of Allah.

ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِى مَآ أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
en: Had it not been for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you in this world and the Hereafter, you would have certainly been touched with a tremendous punishment for what you plunged into—
t1: And had there not been Allah’s grace upon you and His mercy in this world and in the Hereafter, severe torment would have afflicted you for promoting that (slander) into which you rushed headlong.
t2: But for God’s bounty to you and His mercy in the present world and the world to come there would have visited you for your mutterings a mighty chastisement.
t3: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in the world and the Hereafter an awful doom had overtaken you for that whereof ye murmured.

ar: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًۭا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌۭ
en: when you passed it from one tongue to the other, and said with your mouths what you had no knowledge of, taking it lightly while it is ˹extremely˺ serious in the sight of Allah.
t1: When (hearing this matter from one another) you brought it on your tongues, and uttered with your mouths something about which you (yourselves) had no knowledge, and you took (the propagation of) this matter as inconsiderable, whereas in the presence of Allah it was a grave (offence underway).
t2: When you received it on your tongues, and were speaking with your mouths that whereof you had no knowledge, and reckoned it a light thing, and with God it was a mighty thing --
t3: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.

ar: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبْحَٰنَكَ هَٰذَا بُهْتَٰنٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
en: If only you had said upon hearing it, “How can we speak about such a thing! Glory be to You ˹O Lord˺! This is a heinous slander!”
t1: And when you heard of this (heinous charge), why did you not declare (at the same moment): ‘It is not (at all justified) for us to talk about it’? (Rather you should have said: ‘O Allah,) Holy are You (High above making such a woman the beloved wife of Your Beloved and Esteemed Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him]). This is a grave charge.’
t2: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, ’It is not for us to speak about this; glory be to Thee! This is a mighty calumny’?
t3: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny.

ar: يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا۟ لِمِثْلِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: Allah forbids you from ever doing something like this again, if you are ˹true˺ believers.
t1: Allah admonishes you to never repeat such a thing (in your lifetime) if you are believers.
t2: God admonishes you, that you shall never repeat the like of it again; if you are believers.
t3: Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers.

ar: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
en: And Allah makes ˹His˺ commandments clear to you, for Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t1: And Allah explains to you the Revelations with utmost clarity. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t2: God makes clear to you the signs; and God is All-knowing, All-wise.
t3: And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةُ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
en: Indeed, those who love to see indecency spread among the believers will suffer a painful punishment in this life and the Hereafter. Allah knows and you do not know.
t1: Indeed, those who like that lewdness should spread amongst the Muslims, for them is an agonizing punishment in this world and in the Hereafter. And Allah knows (the intentions of such people) and you do not know.
t2: Those who love that indecency should be spread abroad concerning them that believe -- there awaits them a painful chastisement in the present world and the world to come; and God knows, and you know not.
t3: Lo! those who love that slander should be spread concerning those who believe, theirs will be a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knoweth. Ye know not.

ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
en: ˹You would have suffered,˺ had it not been for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you, and had Allah not been Ever Gracious, Most Merciful.
t1: And had there not been Allah’s grace and His mercy upon you (for the sake of the Holy Prophet [blessings and peace be upon him], you too would have been destroyed like the former communities). But Allah is Most Clement, Ever-Merciful.
t2: But for God’s bounty to you and His mercy and that God is All-gentle, All-compassionate --
t3: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Merciful, (ye had been undone).

ar: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًۭا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
en: O believers! Do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Whoever follows Satan’s footsteps, then ˹let them know that˺ he surely bids ˹all to˺ immorality and wickedness. Had it not been for Allah’s grace and mercy upon you, none of you would have ever been purified. But Allah purifies whoever He wills. And Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
t1: O believers! Do not follow the footsteps of Satan, and whoever follows the footsteps of Satan, then he (Satan) certainly commands to practise (and promotes) immorality and sinful deeds. And if there had not been Allah’s grace and His mercy upon you, then none of you would ever have been pure (of the stain of the sin of slander). But Allah purifies whom He wills and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
t2: O believers, follow not the steps of Satan; for whosoever follows the steps of Satan, assuredly he bids to indecency and dishonour. But for God’s bounty to you and His mercy not one of you would have been pure ever; but God purifies whom He will; and God is All-hearing, All-knowing.
t3: O ye who believe! Follow not the footsteps of the devil. Unto whomsoever followeth the footsteps of the devil, lo! he commandeth filthiness and wrong. Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, not one of you would ever have grown pure. But Allah causeth whom He will to grow. And Allah is Hearer, Knower.

ar: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
en: Do not let the people of virtue and affluence among you swear to suspend donations to their relatives, the needy, and the emigrants in the cause of Allah. Let them pardon and forgive. Do you not love to be forgiven by Allah? And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t1: And (now) those of you who are exalted (by way of the Din [Religion]) and are affluent (worldwise) must not swear that they will not provide (financial help) to the relatives, the needy and the Emigrants (who were involved in this offence of false accusation). They should forgive (their misconduct) and overlook (their mistake). Do you not like that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.
t2: Let not those of you who possess bounty and plenty swear off giving kinsmen and the poor and those who emigrate in the way of God; but let them pardon and forgive. Do you not wish that God should forgive you? God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
t3: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you ? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ٱلْغَٰفِلَٰتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ لُعِنُوا۟ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
en: Surely those who accuse chaste, unsuspecting, believing women are cursed in this life and the Hereafter. And they will suffer a tremendous punishment
t1: Verily, those who falsely accuse chaste, believing women who are unaware of, and unacquainted (with, even the very idea of indecency and evil) are cursed in this world and in the Hereafter. And for them is woeful punishment,
t2: Surely those who cast it up on women in wedlock that are heedless but believing shall be accursed in the present world and the world to come; and there awaits them a mighty chastisement
t3: Lo! as for those who traduce virtuous, believing women (who are) careless, cursed are they in the world and the Hereafter. Theirs will be an awful doom

ar: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: on the Day their tongues, hands, and feet will testify against them for what they used to do.
t1: On the Day when their (own) tongues and their hands and their feet will bear witness against them for whatever they used to do,
t2: on the day when their tongues, their hands and their feet shall testify against them touching that they were doing.
t3: On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do,

ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: On that Day, Allah will give them their just penalty in full, and they will ˹come to˺ know that Allah ˹alone˺ is the Ultimate Truth.
t1: On that Day, Allah will pay them full recompense that they truly deserve (for their deeds). And they will come to know that Allah is (Himself) the truth (and also) the Revealer (of the truth).
t2: Upon that day God will pay them in full their just due, and they shall know that God is the manifest Truth.
t3: On that day Allah will pay them their just due, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth.

ar: ٱلْخَبِيثَٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَٱلْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَٰتِ ۖ وَٱلطَّيِّبَٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَٱلطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ ۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَرِزْقٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
en: Wicked women are for wicked men, and wicked men are for wicked women. And virtuous women are for virtuous men, and virtuous men are for virtuous women. The virtuous are innocent of what the wicked say. They will have forgiveness and an honourable provision.
t1: Unclean women are (particular) for unclean men, while unclean men are meant for unclean women. And, (likewise,) clean and chaste women are (specific) to clean and pious men, whilst clean and pious men are exclusively for clean and chaste women. (So keeping in view the holiness, sanctity and purity of the Holy Prophet, you yourselves could imagine how pure, wholesome and chaste a wife Allah would have raised for him.) These (pure, innocent and pious people) are totally free from these (slanders), which these (foul-mouthed) people are levelling. Forgiveness and bestowal of honour and dignity have been (destined) for them. (Why do you ruin your life after death and earn disgrace and humiliation by denigrating his glory?)
t2: Corrupt women for corrupt men, and corrupt men for corrupt women; good women for good men, and good men for good women -- these are declared quit of what they say; theirs shall be forgiveness and generous provision.
t3: Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا۟ وَتُسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: O believers! Do not enter any house other than your own until you have asked for permission and greeted its occupants. This is best for you, so perhaps you will be mindful.
t1: O believers! Do not enter houses other than your own until you obtain their permission. And greet their residents (immediately after you enter). This (advice) is better for you so that you may contemplate (its rationale).
t2: O believers, do not enter houses other than your houses until you first ask leave and, salute the people thereof; that is better for you; haply you will remember.
t3: O ye who believe! Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence and invoking peace upon the folk thereof. That is better for you, that ye may be heedful.

ar: فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فِيهَآ أَحَدًۭا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۖ هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
en: If you find no one at home, do not enter it until you have been given permission. And if you are asked to leave, then leave. That is purer for you. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of what you do.
t1: Then, if you do not find anyone in these (houses), do not enter them until you are granted permission (for that). And if it is said to you: ‘Go back,’ then do go back. That is purer for you, and Allah is Well Aware of what you do.
