en: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”
t1: Say: ‘Wait on, I am also waiting together with you (for your destruction).’
t2: Say: ’Await! I shall be awaiting with you.’
t3: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.

ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
en: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people?
t1: Do their mental faculties suggest them this (foolishness), or are they rioters and rebels?
t2: Or do their intellects bid them do this? Or are they an insolent people?
t3: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk ?

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith.
t1: Or do they say: ‘He (the Messenger) has invented it (the Qur’an) himself’? (No indeed;) rather they simply do not believe (in the truth).
t2: Or do they say, ’He has invented it?’ Nay, but they do not believe.
t3: Or say they: He hath invented it ? Nay, but they will not believe!

ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true!
t1: So let them produce a treatise like this (Qur’an) if they are truthful.
t2: Then let them bring a discourse like it, if they speak truly.
t3: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.

ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
en: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators?
t1: Have they been created by nothing, or are they themselves the creators?
t2: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?
t3: Or were they created out of naught ? Or are they the creators ?

ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺.
t1: Or did they create the heavens and the earth themselves? (No,) in fact, they do not have any faith (in the truth).
t2: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Nay, but they have not sure faith.
t3: Or did they create the heavens and the earth ? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
en: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺?
t1: Or do they own the treasures of your Lord? Or are they guards and watchmen over them?
t2: Or are thy Lord’s treasuries in their keeping? Or are they the registrars?
t3: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord ? Or have they been given charge (thereof) ?

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
en: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof.
t1: Or do they have any ladder (by which they ascend) and listen stealthily (to the heaven)? So let the listener amongst them bring the clear proof.
t2: Or have they a ladder whereon they listen? Then let any of them that has listened bring a clear authority.
t3: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!

ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
en: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons?
t1: Are there daughters for Him (the Lord) and sons for you?
t2: Or has He daughters, and they sons?
t3: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons ?

ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
en: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt?
t1: Do you ask them for wages that they are weighed down with debt?
t2: Or askest thou them for a wage, and so they are weighed down with debt?
t3: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt ?

ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
en: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺?
t1: Do they have (the knowledge of) the unseen that they write down?
t2: Or is the Unseen in their keeping, and so they are writing it down?
t3: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down ?

ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
en: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes.
t1: Do they seek to deceive (you) by trickery? Those who disbelieve are being caught in their own trap.
t2: Or desire they to outwit? The unbelievers, they are the outwitted.
t3: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger) ? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!

ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺!
t1: Do they have any god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah, above all what they set up as a partner (with Allah).
t2: Or have they a god, other than God? Glory be to God, above that which they associate!
t3: Or have they any god beside Allah ? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
en: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”
t1: And if they see a fragment of the sky falling (on them, even then) they will say: ‘It is a layered (thick) cloud.’
t2: Even if they saw lumps falling from heaven, they would say, ’A massed cloud!’
t3: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.

ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
en: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—
t1: So leave them (in their plight) till they meet that Day of theirs when they will be destroyed,
t2: Then leave them, till they encounter their day wherein they shall be thunderstruck,
t3: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped.
t1: The Day when their plots will be of no use to them, nor will they be helped.
t2: the day when their guile shall avail them naught, and they shall not be helped.
t3: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.

ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know.
t1: And for those who are committed to doing wrong, there is a torment for them besides this torment as well but most of them do not know.
t2: And there surely awaits the evildoers a chastisement beyond even that, but most of them know it not.
t3: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.

ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
en: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.
t1: And, (O Esteemed Beloved, do not grieve over what they say). Wait patiently for the command of your Lord. Surely, you are (at all times) before Our Eyes.* And glorify your Lord with His praise whenever you stand forth.
t2: And be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord; surely thou art before Our eyes. And proclaim the praise of thy Lord when thou arisest,
t3: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord’s decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
en: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars.
t1: And also glorify Him during the hours of the night and (in later part of it) when the stars fade out.
t2: and proclaim the praise of thy Lord in the night, and at the declining of the stars.
t3: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.

ar: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
en: By the stars when they fade away!
t1: By the bright star (Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him]) when (he ascended during the Ascension Night in the twinkling of an eye and) descended.
t2: By the Star when it plunges,
t3: By the Star when it setteth,

ar: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
en: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray.
t1: He who bestowed on you his companionship (i.e., the Messenger, who made you his companions by blessing you with his companionship,) has never lost his way, nor has he (ever) strayed from the right path.
t2: your comrade is not astray, neither errs,
t3: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;

ar: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
en: Nor does he speak of his own whims.
t1: And he does not speak out of his (own) desire.
t2: nor speaks he out of caprice.
t3: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ
en: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺.
t1: His speech is nothing but Revelation, which is sent to him.
t2: This is naught but a revelation revealed,
t3: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,

ar: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
en: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power
t1: (The Lord) of Mighty Powers (directly) conferred on him (perfect) knowledge,
t2: taught him by one terrible in power,
t3: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,

ar: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
en: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form
t1: He Who is absolute beauty. Then He (the Effulgence of Beauty) decided to unveil (Himself).
t2: very strong; he stood poised,
t3: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view

ar: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
en: while on the highest point above the horizon,
t1: And he (Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him]) was on the uppermost horizon (of the realm of creation during the Ascension Night i.e., on the apex of the created cosmos).
t2: being on the higher horizon,
t3: When he was on the uppermost horizon.

ar: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
en: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close
t1: Then He (the Lord of Honour) drew closer (to His Beloved Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him]) and then drew even closer.*
t2: then drew near and suspended hung,
t3: Then he drew nigh and came down

ar: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
en: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less.
t1: Then a distance measuring only two bow-lengths was left (between Allah Unveiled and His Esteemed Beloved), or even less than that (in extreme nearness).
t2: two bows’ length away, or nearer,
t3: Till he was (distant) two bows’ length or even nearer,

ar: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
en: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺.
t1: So (on that station of nearness) He (Allah) revealed to His (Beloved) servant whatever He revealed.
t2: then revealed to his servant that he revealed.
t3: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.

ar: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
en: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw.
t1: (His) heart did not take it contrary to what (his) eyes beheld.
t2: His heart lies not of what he saw;
t3: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.

ar: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
en: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw?
t1: Do you argue with him about what he saw?
t2: what, will you dispute with him what he sees?
t3: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth ?

ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
en: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time
t1: And assuredly, he saw Him (Allah Unveiled) the second time (again and you argue only about seeing Him once).*
t2: Indeed, he saw him another time
t3: And verily he saw him yet another time

ar: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
en: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—
t1: At the farthest Lote-Tree—Sidra al-Muntaha,
t2: by the Lote-Tree of the Boundary
t3: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,

ar: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
en: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—
t1: Adjacent to that is the Eternal Paradise—Janna al-Ma’wa,
t2: nigh which is the Garden of the Refuge,
t3: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.

ar: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
en: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours!
t1: When theophanies (i.e., effulgent disclosures) of the divine light wrapped up al-Sidra (the Lote-Tree at the Far End), covering it expansively.*
t2: when there covered the Lote-Tree that which covered;
t3: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,

ar: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
en: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach.
t1: His eye neither inclined aside nor overstepped the limit; (it gazed in ecstasy at Whom it was to gaze).
t2: his eye swerved not; nor swept astray.
t3: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.

ar: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
en: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs.
t1: Surely, he saw the greatest signs of His Lord (during the Ascension Night).
t2: Indeed, he saw one of the greatest signs of his Lord.
t3: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.

ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
en: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lat and ’Uzza,
t1: Have you taken a look at (the goddesses) Lat and ‘Uzza?
t2: Have you considered El-Lat and El-’Uzza
t3: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-’Uzza

ar: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
en: and the third one, Manat, as well?
t1: And (have you) also (seen thoughtfully) another, that third one (goddess) Manat? (Have you declared them daughters of Allah?)
t2: and Manat the third, the other?
t3: And Manat, the third, the other ?

ar: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
en: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters?
t1: (O idolaters!) Are sons for you and daughters for Him (Allah)?
t2: What, have you males, and He females?
t3: Are yours the males and His the females ?

ar: تِلْكَ إِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ
en: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution!
t1: (If your concept is correct,) then that division is serious injustice.
t2: That were indeed an unjust division.
t3: That indeed were an unfair division!

ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
en: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord.
t1: But (the truth is that) these (idols) are nothing but mere names which you and your fathers have given. Allah has not sent down any authority for them. They follow only whims and suspicions and the desires of their (ill-commanding) selves, whereas guidance has already come to them from their Lord.
t2: They are naught but names yourselves have named, and your fathers; God has sent down no authority touching them. They follow only surmise, and what the souls desire; and yet guidance has come to them from their Lord.
t3: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.

ar: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
en: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire?
t1: Is (all) that available for man what he longs for?
t2: Or shall man have whatever he fancies?
t3: Or shall man have what he coveteth ?

ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
en: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next.
t1: So Allah alone is the Master of the Hereafter and the world.
t2: And to God belongs the First and the Last.
t3: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.

ar: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
en: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves.
t1: And how many angels there are in the heavens (whom the disbelievers and the idolaters worship and expect from them intercession but) whose intercession will be of no use at all, except after Allah (awards) permission for whom He wills and likes!
t2: How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession avails not anything, save after that God gives leave to whomsoever He wills and is well-pleased.
t3: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female,
t1: Surely, those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels female names.
t2: Those who do not believe in the world to come name the angels with the names of females.
t3: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.

ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
en: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth.
t1: And they know nothing about it. They follow only assumption, and surely assumption serves no purpose in comparison with certitude.
t2: They have not any knowledge thereof; they follow only surmise, and surmise avails naught against truth.
t3: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.

ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
en: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world.
t1: So divert your attention from him who turns away from Our remembrance and desires nothing but the life of this world.
t2: So turn thou from him who turns away from Our Remembrance, and desires only the present life.
t3: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.

ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
en: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided.
t1: That is but the limit of the working of their knowledge. Verily, your Lord fully knows him who has strayed from His path and (also) knows best him who has attained guidance.
t2: That is their attainment of knowledge. Surely thy Lord knows very well those who have gone astray from His way, and He knows very well those who are guided.
t3: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.

ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
en: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—
t1: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth so that He recompenses the acts of those who have committed vices and gives good reward to those who have performed virtues.
t2: To God belongs whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may recompense those who do evil for what they have done, and recompense those who have done good with the reward most fair.
t3: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
en: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous.
t1: Those who guard against grave sins and indecencies excepting small sins (and omissions), surely your Lord has vast prospects of forgiveness (for them). He knows you best when He originated your life and nourishment from the earth (i.e., soil) and when you were embryos (conceived) in your mothers’ wombs. So never pose yourselves as clean and pure; He knows best who is (really) pious.
t2: Those who avoid the heinous sins and indecencies, save lesser offences surely thy Lord is wide in His forgiveness. Very well He knows you, when He produced you from the earth, and when you were yet unborn in your mothers’ wombs; therefore hold not yourselves purified; God knows very well him who is godfearing.
t3: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).

ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
en: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺
t1: Have you seen him who has turned away (from the truth)?
t2: Hast thou considered him who turns his back
t3: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,

ar: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
en: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped?
t1: And he gave away a little (wealth in the way of Allah) and (then) held back (his hand)?
t2: and gives a little, and then grudgingly?
t3: And gave a little, then was grudging ?

ar: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
en: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺?
t1: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen that he can see?
t2: Does he possess the knowledge of the Unseen, and therefore he sees?
t3: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth ?

ar: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
en: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses,
t1: Has he not been given the knowledge of (matters) mentioned in the scriptures of Musa (Moses),
t2: Or has he not been told of what is in the scrolls of Moses,
t3: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses

ar: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
en: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺?
t1: And in the (scriptures) of Ibrahim (Abraham), who accomplished (all the commands of Allah) with perfection?
t2: and Abraham, he who paid his debt in full?
t3: And Abraham who paid his debt:

ar: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
en: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another,
t1: That no bearer of a burden will carry the burden of (the sins) of another;
t2: That no soul laden bears the load of another,
t3: That no laden one shall bear another’s load,

ar: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
en: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards,
t1: And that man (according to justice) will get only that for which he strives. (As for bounty, no one has any right to it. That is merely Allah’s bestowal and pleasure, granting as much as He wills to whom He pleases.)
t2: and that a man shall have to his account only as he has laboured,
t3: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,

ar: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
en: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺,
t1: And that all his endeavours will soon be shown (i.e., exposed).
t2: and that his labouring shall surely be seen,
t3: And that his effort will be seen.

ar: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
en: then they will be fully rewarded,
t1: Then he will be given full reward (for all his endeavours);
t2: then he shall be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense,
t3: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;

ar: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
en: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺.
t1: And that (ultimately all) have to return to your Lord;
t2: and that the final end is unto thy Lord,
t3: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
en: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness.
t1: And that He is the One Who makes one laugh (granting delight) and makes one weep (granting grief);
t2: and that it is He who makes to laugh, and that makes to weep,
t3: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
en: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death.
t1: And that He is the One Who causes death and gives life;
t2: and that it is He who makes to die, and that makes to live,
t3: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
en: And He created the pairs—males and females—
t1: And that He is the One Who has created the two genders, male and female,
t2: and that He Himself created the two kinds, male and female,
t3: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,

ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
en: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted.
t1: Out of a (sperm) drop when it is ejaculated (into the mother’s womb);
t2: of a sperm-drop, when it was cast forth,
t3: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;

ar: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
en: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation.
t1: And that it is upon Him alone to raise up alive (also after death);
t2: and that upon Him rests the second growth,
t3: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
en: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes.
t1: And that He is the One Who makes self-sufficient (by providing according to needs), and He is the One Who enriches treasures (by giving surplus to the needs);
t2: and that it is He who gives wealth and riches,
t3: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
en: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius.
t1: And that He alone is the Lord of Sirius (a star that was worshipped in the days of ignorance);
t2: and that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius,
t3: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
en: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd,
t1: And that He is the One Who destroyed the first (people of) ‘Ad,
t2: and that He destroyed Ad, the ancient,
t3: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A’ad,

ar: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
en: and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one.
t1: And (the people of) Thamud (as well). Then He did not spare (any of them) to survive.
t2: and Thamood, and He did not spare them,
t3: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;

ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
en: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression.
t1: And before that, He destroyed the people of Nuh ([Noah] as well). Surely, they were extremely wicked and exceedingly defiant.
t2: and the people of Noah before -- certainly they did exceeding evil, and were insolent
t3: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;

ar: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
en: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down.
t1: And He is the One Who (raised up) the overturned towns (of the people of Lut [Lot]) and smashed them down.
t2: and the Subverted City He also overthrew,
t3: And Al-Mu’tafikah He destroyed

ar: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
en: How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺!
t1: Then covered them that which did cover (i.e., the stones were rained on them).
t2: so that there covered it that which covered.
t3: So that there covered them that which did cover.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
en: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute?
t1: So, (O man,) which of the favours of your Lord will you doubt?
t2: Then which of thy Lord’s bounties disputest thou?
t3: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute ?

ar: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
en: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones.
t1: This (Holy Prophet [blessings and peace be upon him]) is also a Warner of the Warners of old.
t2: This is a warner, of the warners of old.
t3: This is a warner of the warners of old.

ar: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْءَازِفَةُ
en: The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near.
t1: The imminent (Hour of Judgment) has drawn near.
t2: The Imminent is imminent;
t3: The threatened Hour is nigh.

ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
en: None but Allah can disclose it.
t1: No one except Allah can bring it forth (and establish).
t2: apart from God none can disclose it.
t3: None beside Allah can disclose it.

ar: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
en: Do you find this revelation astonishing,
t1: So do you wonder at this Revelation?
t2: Do you then marvel at this discourse,
t3: Marvel ye then at this statement,

ar: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
en: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺,
t1: And do you laugh and not weep,
t2: and do you laugh, and do you not weep,
t3: And laugh and not weep,

ar: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ
en: while persisting in heedlessness?
t1: Whilst you are busy playing a game (of negligence)?
t2: while you make merry?
t3: While ye amuse yourselves ?

ar: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
en: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺!
t1: So prostrate yourselves before Allah and worship (Him).
t2: So bow yourselves before God, and serve Him!
t3: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.

ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
en: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺.
t1: The Last Hour has drawn near and the moon has split into two.
t2: The Hour has drawn nigh: the moon is split.
t3: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.

ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
en: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”
t1: And if they (the disbelievers) see a sign (a miracle), they turn their faces away and say: ‘This is the powerful magic ever running down through ages.’
t2: Yet if they see a sign they turn away, and they say ’A continuous sorcery!’
t3: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.

ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
en: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—
t1: And they have rejected (the truth even now) and followed their vain desires. And everything (that has been promised) is to take place at the appointed time.
t2: They have cried lies, and followed their caprices; but every matter is settled.
t3: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
en: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent.
t1: And indeed, the news has come to them (of the earlier communities) containing lessons of warning and admonition (on disbelief and disobedience).
t2: And there have come to them such tidings as contain a deterrent --
t3: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,

ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
en: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺.
t1: (This Qur’an) is perfect intellect and reason. Are the Warners still not of any benefit?
t2: a Wisdom far-reaching; yet warnings do not avail.
t3: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.

ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
en: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller
t1: So turn your face away from them. The Day when the caller (angel) will call towards the most detestable thing (the expanse of the last assembly),
t2: So turn thou away from them. Upon the day when the Caller shall call unto a horrible thing,
t3: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.

ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
en: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts,
t1: With eyes cast down, they will come out of their graves like scattered locusts,
t2: abasing their eyes, they shall come forth from the tombs as if they were scattered grasshoppers,
t3: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,

ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
en: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”
t1: Rushing towards the caller running. The disbelievers will say: ‘This is a very hard Day.’
t2: running with outstretched necks to the Caller. The unbelievers shall say, ’This is a hard day!’
t3: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.

ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
en: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated.
t1: The people of Nuh (Noah) also denied before this. So they belied Our servant (Nuh [Noah], the Messenger) and said: ‘(He) is mad.’ And he was given threats.
t2: The people of Noah cried lies before them; they cried lies to Our servant, and said, ’A man possessed!’ And he was rejected.
t3: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.

ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
en: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”
t1: So he prayed to his Lord: ‘I am powerless (before the transgressions of my people) so exact revenge.’
t2: And so he called unto his Lord, saying, ’I am vanquished; do Thou succour me!’
t3: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.

ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
en: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain,
t1: Then We opened the gates of heaven with torrential rain.
t2: Then We opened the gates of heaven unto water torrential,
t3: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
en: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set.
t1: And We burst springs from the earth. So the water (of the earth and the heaven) collected for the same purpose that had been decreed already (for their destruction).
t2: and made the earth to gush with fountains, and the waters met for a matter decreed.
t3: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.

ar: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
en: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails,
t1: And We carried him (Nuh [Noah]) in the (Ark) built with planks and nails,
t2: And We bore him upon a well-planked vessel well-caulked
t3: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,

ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
en: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied.
t1: Which floated before Our eyes (under Our security. All this) was done to exact revenge for him, Nuh (Noah), who was rejected.
t2: running before Our eyes-a recompense for him denied.
t3: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.

ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
en: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
t1: And surely, We made (the ruins of the Deluge) subsist as a sign. So is there anyone who will think (and take advice)?
t2: And We left it for a sign. Is there any that will remember?
t3: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth ?

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!
t1: So how My torment and My warning were!
t2: How then were My chastisement and My warnings?
t3: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
en: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
t1: And indeed, We have made the Qur’an easy for direction and guidance, but is there anyone who will take advice?
t2: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?
t3: And in truth We have made the Qur’an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth ?

ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!
t1: (The people of) ‘Ad too rejected (the Messengers). So how (awful) My torment (upon them) and My warning were!
t2: Ad cried lies. How then were My chastisement and My warnings?
t3: (The tribe of) A’ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
en: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery,
t1: Surely, We sent upon them a howling windstorm on a day of lasting evil (in their favour),
t2: We loosed against them a wind clamorous in a day of ill fortune continuous,
t3: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,

ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
en: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees.
t1: That plucked out people as if they were uprooted stems of date-palms.
t2: plucking up men as if they were stumps of uprooted palm-trees.
t3: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm- trees.

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!
t1: Then how (awful) My torment and My warning were!
t2: How then were My chastisement and My warnings?
t3: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
en: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
t1: And indeed, We have made the Qur’an easy for direction and guidance, but is there anyone who will take advice?
t2: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?
t3: And in truth We have made the Qur’an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth ?

ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺,
t1: (The people of) Thamud also rejected the Warning Messengers.
t2: Thamood cried lies to the warnings
t3: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
en: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane.
t1: So they said: ‘Are we to follow a human being who is one of us? Then we shall certainly run into error and insanity.
t2: and said, ’What, shall we follow a mortal, one out of ourselves? Then indeed we should be in error and insanity!
t3: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow ? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.

ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
en: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”
t1: Has the direction and guidance (Revelation) been sent down to him alone out of all of us? The truth is that he is a great liar, self-conceited (and arrogant).’
t2: Has the Reminder been cast upon him alone among us? Nay, rather he is an impudent liar.’
t3: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us ? Nay, but he is a rash liar.

ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
en: ˹It was revealed to salih,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is.
t1: They will come to know tomorrow (on the Day of Judgment) who is a great liar, self-conceited (and arrogant).
t2: ’They shall surely know tomorrow who is the impudent liar.
t3: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.

ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
en: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience.
t1: Indeed, We are going to send a she-camel for them to test them. So, (O Salih,) wait for their (end) and continue observing patience.
t2: They shall send the She-camel as a trial for them; so watch thou them and keep patience.
t3: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;

ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
en: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”
t1: And make it known to them that water has been divided between them (and the she-camel). Everyone will be served with the share of water by turn.
t2: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them, each drink for each in turn.
t3: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.

ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
en: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺.
t1: So they called one of their companions (named Qidar). He attacked (the she-camel with a sword) and hamstrung her.
t2: Then they called their comrade, and he took in hand, and hamstrung her.
t3: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings!
t1: Then how (awful) My torment and My warning were!
t2: How then were My chastisement and My warnings?
t3: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
en: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders.
t1: Verily, We sent upon them a terrible roar. So they became like a thatcher’s trampled stubble.
t2: We loosed against them one Cry, and they were as the wattles of a pen-builder.
t3: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
en: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
t1: And indeed, We have made the Qur’an easy for direction and guidance, but is there anyone who will take advice?
t2: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?
t3: And in truth We have made the Qur’an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth ?

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings.
t1: The people of Lut (Lot) also rejected the Warners.
t2: The people of Lot cried lies to the warnings.
t3: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
en: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn
t1: Surely, We sent a windstorm raining stones upon them except the family of Lut (Lot). We saved them (from the torment) in the later part of the night,
t2: We loosed against them a squall of pebbles except the folk of Lot; We delivered them at the dawn --
t3: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,

ar: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
en: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks.
t1: With a special favour from Us. In the same way, We give reward to him who gives thanks.
t2: a blessing from Us; even so We recompense him who is thankful.
t3: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings.
t1: And no doubt, Lut (Lot) warned them of Our seizure but, having doubts about his warnings, they denied.
t2: He had warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warnings.
t3: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.

ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”
t1: And indeed, they made up their minds to snatch from Lut (Lot) his guests. So We erased the structure of their eyes and stripped them of sight, then (said to them:) ‘Taste My punishment and warning.’
t2: Even his guests they had solicited of him; so We obliterated their eyes, saying, ’Taste now My chastisement and My warnings!’
t3: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
en: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment.
t1: And surely, the everlasting punishment reached them early in the morning.
t2: In the morning early there came upon them a settled chastisement:
t3: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.

ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”
t1: Then (it was said to them:) ‘Taste My punishment and warning.’
t2: ’Taste now My chastisement and My warnings!’
t3: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
en: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful?
t1: And indeed, We have made the Qur’an easy for direction and guidance, but is there anyone who will take advice?
t2: Now We have made the Koran easy for Remembrance. Is there any that will remember?
t3: And in truth We have made the Qur’an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth ?

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
en: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh.
t1: And surely, the Warners came to the people of Pharaoh (as well).
t2: The warnings came also to Pharaoh’s folk.
t3: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
en: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful.
t1: They denied all Our signs. Then We seized them with the seizure befitting the Glory of Almighty, All-Powerful.
t2: They cried lies to Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with the seizing of One mighty, omnipotent.
t3: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.

ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
en: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books?
t1: (O Quraysh of Mecca!) Are your disbelievers better than the people (before), or has your salvation been written in the (revealed) Books?
t2: What, are your unbelievers better than those? Or have you an immunity in the Scrolls?
t3: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures ?

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
en: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”?
t1: Or do these (disbelievers) say: ‘We are a strong party dominant (over the Prophet [blessings and peace be upon him])’?
t2: Or do they say, ’We are a congregation that shall be succoured?’
t3: Or say they: We are a host victorious ?

ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
en: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee.
t1: Soon this party will be defeated (in the battlefield of Badr), and they will flee away, turning their backs.
t2: Certainly the host shall be routed, and turn their backs.
t3: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.

ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
en: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter.
t1: But their (actual) promise is the Last Hour, and the Last Hour is extremely terrible and most agonizing.
t2: Nay, but the Hour is their tryst, and the Hour is very calamitous and bitter.
t3: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
en: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes.
t1: Assuredly, the evildoers are in (the fold of) error and insanity (or Fire).
t2: Surely the sinners are in error and insanity!
t3: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.

ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
en: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”
t1: The Day when they will be dragged into Hell on their faces (it will be said to them:) ‘Taste burning in Hell.’
t2: The day when they are dragged on their faces into the Fire: ’Taste now the touch of Sakar!’
t3: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.

ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
en: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained.
t1: Surely, We have created everything according to a fixed measure.
t2: Surely We have created everything in measure.
t3: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.

ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
en: Our command done in the blink of an eye.
t1: And Our command comes into action once and for all as the twinkling of an eye.
t2: Our commandment is but one word, as the twinkling of an eye.
t3: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
en: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful?
t1: And surely, We destroyed (many of) your groups. So is there anyone who will take advice?
t2: We have destroyed the likes of you; is there any that will remember?
t3: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth ?

ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
en: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records.
t1: And whatever they did is (recorded) in (their) Books of Deeds.
t2: Every thing that they have done is in the Scrolls,
t3: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,

ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
en: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺.
t1: And every (action), small or big, has been written.
t2: and everything, great and small, is inscribed.
t3: And every small and great thing is recorded.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
en: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers,
t1: Indeed, the Godfearing will (rejoice) in gardens and streams,
t2: Surely the godfearing shall dwell amid gardens and a river
t3: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,

ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
en: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.
t1: And will (be seated) in special nearness to the Sovereign Lord of (true) power during holy sessions.
t2: in a sure abode, in the presence of a King Omnipotent.
t3: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.

ar: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
en: The Most Compassionate
t1: The Most Compassionate (is He),
t2: The All-merciful
t3: The Beneficent

ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
en: taught the Quran,
t1: Who (Himself) taught the Qur’an to (the Arab Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him]).*
t2: has taught the Koran.
t3: Hath made known the Qur’an.

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
en: created humanity,
t1: He is the One Who created (this Absolutely Perfect) man.
t2: He created man
t3: He hath created man.

ar: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
en: ˹and˺ taught them speech.
t1: He alone taught him the art of expression and communication (i.e., taught the True Messenger ma kana wa ma yakun).*
t2: and He has taught him the Explanation.
t3: He hath taught him utterance.

ar: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ
en: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision.
t1: The sun and the moon are rotating according to the configuration determined (by Him).
t2: The sun and the moon to a reckoning,
t3: The sun and the moon are made punctual.

ar: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
en: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺.
t1: And the herbs spread over the earth, and all (species of) the trees prostrate themselves (to Him alone).
t2: and the stars and the trees bow themselves;
t3: The stars and the trees adore.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
en: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺
t1: And He is the One Who has maintained the sky raised high and (He is the One) Who has set up the balance (for justice),
t2: and heaven -- He raised it up, and set the Balance.
t3: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,

ar: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
en: so that you do not defraud the scales.
t1: So that you violate not the balance whilst weighing.
t2: (Transgress not in the Balance,
t3: That ye exceed not the measure,

ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
en: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure.
t1: And keep weighing justly and do not make the balance fall short.
t2: and weigh with justice, and skimp not in the Balance.)
t3: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
en: He laid out the earth for all beings.
t1: He is the One Who has spread out the earth for the creatures.
t2: And earth -- He set it down for all beings,
t3: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,

ar: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
en: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks,
t1: There are fruits in it and blossom-bearing date-palms,
t2: therein fruits, and palm-trees with sheaths,
t3: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,

ar: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
en: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants.
t1: And chaff-covered grain and fragrant (fruits and) blooms.
t2: and grain in the blade, and fragrant herbs.
t3: Husked grain and scented herb.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny?
t1: So, (O assembly of jinn and men,) which of your Lord’s blessings will you deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
en: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery,
t1: He is the One Who created man from a dry mud sounding like earthenware,
t2: He created man of a clay like the potter’s,
t3: He created man of clay like the potter’s,

ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
en: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire.
t1: And created the jinn from a flame of fire.
t2: and He created the jinn of a smokeless fire.
t3: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
en: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests.
t1: (He alone is) the Lord of the two easts and (He alone is) the Lord of the two wests.
t2: Lord of the Two Easts, Lord of the Two Wests,
t3: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
en: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water,
t1: He is the One Who has made the two seas flow that join each other;
t2: He let forth the two seas that meet together,
t3: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.

ar: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
en: yet between them is a barrier they never cross.
t1: There is a barrier between them; they cannot breach (their respective) limits.
t2: between them a barrier they do not overpass.
t3: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
en: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral.
t1: The pearls (shading green) and corals (shading red) come forth from both (the seas).
t2: From them come forth the pearl and the coral.
t3: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
en: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains.
t1: And (under) His (control) are (also) the big vessels with lofty sails raised high (anchoring or sailing) in the sea like mountains.
t2: His too are the ships that run, raised up in the sea like land-marks.
t3: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ
en: Every being on earth is bound to perish.
t1: Whoever is on the earth will perish.
t2: All that dwells upon the earth is perishing,
t3: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;

ar: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
en: Only your Lord Himself,
t1: And the essence of your Lord, Who is the Master of glory and splendour and the Master of bounty and honour, will remain.
t2: yet still abides the Face of thy Lord, majestic, splendid.
t3: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
en: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about.
t1: All that are in the heavens and the earth beg from Him alone. Every moment His Glory manifests anew.
t2: Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth implore Him; every day He is upon some labour.
t3: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
en: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O  two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺!
t1: O both the groups (of men and jinn), soon shall We attend to your account.
t2: We shall surely attend to you at leisure, you weight and you weight!
t3: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
en: O  assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority.
t1: O company of the jinn and men! If you have the power to go across the boundaries of the heaven and the earth (and overpower the universe), then go ahead. Whichever station (i.e., heavenly sphere) you will go to, there too will be His Kingdom alone.
t2: O tribe of jinn and of men, if you are able to pass through the confines of heaven and earth, pass through them! You shall not pass through except with an authority.
t3: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
en: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another.
t1: The flames of pure (i.e., smokeless) fire will be sent upon both of you and (flameless) smoke (too will be sent) and you both will be unable to escape from them.
t2: Against you shall be loosed a flame of fire, and molten brass; and you shall not be helped.
t3: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
en: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil!
t1: And when the heavens will split apart and will become rosy like burnt oil (or red leather),
t2: And when heaven is split asunder, and turns crimson like red leather --
t3: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of our Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ? -

ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
en: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins.
t1: That Day no man or jinn will be asked about his sin.
t2: on that day none shall be questioned about his sin, neither man nor jinn.
t3: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
en: The wicked will be recognized by their appearance, then will be seized by ˹their˺ forelocks and feet.
t1: The evildoers will be recognized by the darkness of their faces and so they will be pulled, seized by their forelocks and feet.
t2: The sinners shall be known by their mark, and they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
t3: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
en: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Hell which the wicked denied.”
t1: (It will be said to them:) ‘It is this Hell which the evildoers used to deny.’
t2: This is Gehenna, that sinners cried lies to;
t3: This is hell which the guilty deny.

ar: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ
en: They will alternate between its flames and scalding water.
t1: They will move about in that (Hell) and in the boiling hot water.
t2: they shall go round between it and between hot, boiling water.
t3: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
en: And whoever is in awe of standing before their Lord will have two Gardens.
t1: And whoever fears standing before his Lord (for meeting), for him are two Gardens.
t2: But such as fears the Station of his Lord, for them shall be two gardens --
t3: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ
en: ˹Both will be˺ with lush branches.
t1: They are (green and fresh Gardens) with deep thick branches.
t2: abounding in branches --
t3: Of spreading branches.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
en: In each ˹Garden˺ will be two flowing springs.
t1: Two springs are flowing in both of them.
t2: therein two fountains of running water --
t3: Wherein are two fountains flowing.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ
en: In each will be two types of every fruit.
t1: In them are two kinds of every fruit.
t2: therein of every fruit two kinds --
t3: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
en: Those ˹believers˺ will recline on furnishings lined with rich brocade. And the fruit of both Gardens will hang within reach.
t1: The residents of Paradise will be reclining on couches lined with fine and thick brocade (i.e., satin) and the fruits of both the Gardens will be hanging low (over them).
t2: reclining upon couches lined with brocade, the fruits of the gardens nigh to gather --
t3: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
en: In both ˹Gardens˺ will be maidens of modest gaze, who no human or jinn has ever touched before.
t1: And in them will be (chaste maidens) with downcast gazes, untouched either by any man or jinn.
t2: therein maidens restraining their glances, untouched before them by any man or jinn --
t3: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
en: Those ˹maidens˺ will be ˹as elegant˺ as rubies and coral.
t1: As if they (chaste maidens) were rubies and pearls.
t2: lovely as rubies, beautiful as coral --
t3: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ
en: Is there any reward for goodness except goodness?
t1: The reward of good cannot be anything but good.
t2: Shall the recompense of goodness be other than goodness?
t3: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness ?

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
en: And below these two ˹Gardens˺ will be two others.
t1: And apart from these two there are also two more gardens (for them).
t2: And besides these shall be two gardens --
t3: And beside them are two other gardens,

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ
en: Both will be dark green.
t1: Both appear deep green tinting black.
t2: green, green pastures --
t3: Dark green with foliage.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
en: In each will be two gushing springs.
t1: There are two springs which will be gushing with force in these two (as well).
t2: therein two fountains of gushing water --
t3: Wherein are two abundant springs.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَنَخْلٌۭ وَرُمَّانٌۭ
en: In both will be fruit, palm trees, and pomegranates.
t1: In both of them there are also fruits, date-palms and pomegranates.
t2: therein fruits, and palm-trees, and pomegranates --
t3: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌۭ
en: In all Gardens will be noble, pleasant mates.
t1: In them are pious and beautiful (chaste maidens as well).
t2: therein maidens good and comely --
t3: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful -

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ? -

ar: حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ
en: ˹They will be˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions.
t1: The maidens who are veiling, confined in tents.
t2: houris, cloistered in cool pavilions --
t3: Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions -

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ? -

ar: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
en: No human or jinn has ever touched these ˹maidens˺ before.
t1: Untouched before either by any man or jinn.
t2: untouched before them by any man or jinn --
t3: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them -

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
en: All ˹believers˺ will be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.
t1: (The residents of Paradise) will be (sitting) reclining on cushions over green carpets and rare and exquisite, fine rugs.
t2: reclining upon green cushions and lovely druggets --
t3: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.

ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
en: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny?
t1: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
t2: O which of your Lord’s bounties will you and you deny?
t3: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny ?

ar: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
en: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour.
t1: Most Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Master of glory and splendour and the Master of bounty and honour.
t2: Blessed be the Name of thy Lord, majestic, splendid.
t3: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!

ar: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
en: When the Inevitable Event takes place,
t1: When what is to occur (the Hour of Resurrection) will occur,
t2: When the Terror descends
t3: When the event befalleth -

ar: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
en: then no one can deny it has come.
t1: There is no falsehood in its occurrence.
t2: (and none denies its descending)
t3: There is no denying that it will befall -

ar: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ
en: It will debase ˹some˺ and elevate ˹others˺.
t1: (That Hour) will lower (some) and raise (some others) high.
t2: abasing, exalting,
t3: Abasing (some), exalting (others);

ar: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا
en: When the earth will be violently shaken,
t1: When the earth will tremor and then shake violently,
t2: when the earth shall be rocked
t3: When the earth is shaken with a shock

ar: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا
en: and the mountains will be crushed to pieces,
t1: And the mountains will be crumbled into bits,
t2: and the mountains crumbled
t3: And the hills are ground to powder

ar: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا
en: becoming scattered ˹particles of˺ dust,
t1: Then will become dust particles spread in the air,
t2: and become a dust, scattered,
t3: So that they become a scattered dust,

ar: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ
en: you will ˹all˺ be ˹divided into˺ three groups:
t1: And you will be divided into three classes.
t2: and you shall be three bands --
t3: And ye will be three kinds:

ar: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
en: the people of the right, how ˹blessed˺ will they be;
t1: So (first) those on the Right Hand; what a class the Right Hand will be!
t2: Companions of the Right (O Companions of the Right!)
t3: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand ?

ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
en: the people of the left, how ˹miserable˺ will they be;
t1: And (second) those on the Left Hand; (in what miserable plight will be) the Left Hand party!
t2: Companions of the Left (O Companions of the Left!)
t3: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand ?

ar: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
en: and the foremost ˹in faith˺ will be the foremost ˹in Paradise˺.
t1: And (third) the Excellent; (they) are the Foremost.
t2: and the Outstrippers: the Outstrippers
t3: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
en: They are the ones nearest ˹to Allah˺,
t1: It is they who will be the ones drawn near (to Allah).
t2: those are they brought nigh the Throne,
t3: Those are they who will be brought nigh

ar: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
en: in the Gardens of Bliss.
t1: (They will live) in the Gardens of Bliss.
t2: in the Gardens of Delight
t3: In gardens of delight;

ar: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
