And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity.
t1: And We have appointed only angels as guards of Hell. And We have fixed their number only as a trial for the disbelievers so that the People of the Book may believe with certitude (that the Qur’an and the Prophethood of Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him] is a truth because the same number was given in their scriptures as well), and that the faith of the believers may further be strengthened (with this confirmation), and that the People of the Book and the believers may not doubt (its veracity), and that those having a disease (of hypocrisy) in their hearts and the disbelievers may say: ‘What does Allah intend by this example (of number)?’ In this way, Allah holds astray whom He wills, and guides aright whom He wills (with the same stroke). And no one knows the armies of your Lord except Him. And this (description of Hell is nothing else) but an admonition to mankind.
t2: We have appointed only angels to be masters of the Fire, and their number We have appointed only as a trial for the unbelievers, that those who were given the Book may have certainty, and that those who believe may increase in belief, and that those who were given the Book and those who believe may not be in-doubt, and that those in whose hearts there is sickness, and the unbelievers, may say, ’What did God intend by this as a similitude?’ So God leads astray whomsoever He will, and He guides whomsoever He will; and none knows the hosts of thy Lord but He. And it is naught but a Reminder to mortals.
t3: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude ? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.

ar: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
en: But no! By the moon,
t1: Yes! By the moon (whose increase, decrease and disappearance is evidence),
t2: Nay! By the moon
t3: Nay, by the Moon

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
en: and the night as it retreats,
t1: And by the night when it backs away to depart,
t2: and the night when it retreats
t3: And the night when it withdraweth

ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
en: and the day as it breaks!
t1: And by the morning when it brightens,
t2: and the dawn when it is white,
t3: And the dawn when it shineth forth,

ar: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
en: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—
t1: Surely, this (Hell) is one of the greatest calamities.
t2: surely it is one of the greatest things
t3: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)

ar: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
en: a warning to humankind,
t1: It is a warning to mankind,
t2: as a warner to mortals.
t3: As a warning unto men,

ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
en: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind.
t1: For any of you who seeks to advance forward (in piety) or who lags behind (trapped in evil);
t2: to whoever of you desires to go forward or lag behind.
t3: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.

ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
en: Every soul will be detained for what it has done,
t1: Everyone is held in pledge for (the deeds) that he has earned,
t2: Every soul shall be pledged for what it has earned,
t3: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;

ar: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
en: except the people of the right,
t1: Except for those on the Right Side.
t2: save the Companions of the Right;
t3: Save those who will stand on the right hand.

ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
en: who will be in Gardens, asking one another
t1: (They) will be in Gardens and will be asking one another,
t2: in Gardens they will question
t3: In gardens they will ask one another

ar: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
en: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺:
t1: About the evildoers.
t2: concerning the sinners,
t3: Concerning the guilty:

ar: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
en: “What has landed you in Hell?”
t1: (And they will say:) ‘What has brought you into Hell?’
t2: ’What thrusted you into Sakar?’
t3: What hath brought you to this burning ?

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
en: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed,
t1: They will say: ‘We were not of those who used to offer Prayers.
t2: They shall say, ’We were not of those who prayed, and
t3: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed

ar: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
en: nor did we feed the poor.
t1: Nor did we feed the poor.
t2: we fed not the needy,
t3: Nor did we feed the wretched.

ar: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
en: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others,
t1: And we indulged in vain activities with those who had cast themselves into vain activities.
t2: and we plunged along with the plungers,
t3: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,

ar: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
en: and deny the Day of Judgment,
t1: And we rejected the Day of Reward and Punishment,
t2: and we cried lies to the Day of Doom,
t3: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
en: until the inevitable came to us.”
t1: Until that (death), which was certain to come, came upon us.’
t2: till the Certain came to us.’ --
t3: Till the Inevitable came unto us.

ar: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
en: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them.
t1: So (now) the intercession of the intercessors will not be of any benefit to them.
t2: Then the intercession of the intercessors shall not profit them.
t3: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.

ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
en: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder,
t1: Then what is the matter with these (disbelievers that even then) they turn away from the Reminder,
t2: What ails them, that they turn away from the Reminder,
t3: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,

ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
en: as if they were spooked zebras
t1: As if they were startled (wild) donkeys,
t2: as if they were startled asses
t3: As they were frightened asses

ar: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
en: fleeing from a lion?
t1: Fleeing away from a lion?
t2: fleeing -- before a lion?
t3: Fleeing from a lion ?

ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
en: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺.
t1: In fact, every one of them desires that he should be given (directly) open scrolls of (heavenly) scriptures.
t2: Nay, every man of them desires to be -- given -- scrolls unrolled.
t3: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).

ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
en: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter.
t1: That is not possible at all. Rather (the fact is that) they fear not the Last Day.
t2: No indeed; but they do not fear the Hereafter.
t3: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
en: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder.
t1: There is no doubt that this (Qur’an) is a Reminder.
t2: No indeed; surely it is a Reminder;
t3: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.

ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
en: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.
t1: So whoever wills may remember it.
t2: so whoever wills shall remember it.
t3: So whosoever will may heed.

ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
en: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive.
t1: And they will not remember (it) unless Allah so wills. He is the One to Whom fear (and righteousness) is due, and He alone is the Lord of forgiveness.
t2: And they will not remember, except that God wills; He is worthy to be feared, -- worthy to forgive.
t3: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.

ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
en: I do swear by the Day of Judgment!
t1: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
t2: No! I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
t3: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

ar: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
en: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul!
t1: And I swear by the blaming self, reproaching (itself for evil deeds).
t2: No! I swear by the reproachful soul.
t3: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
en: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones?
t1: Does man think We shall not at all collect his bones (which will decompose into dust particles after his death)?
t2: What, does man reckon We shall not gather his bones?
t3: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones ?

ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
en: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips.
t1: Yes, of course! We have also the power to restore and set right even his finger joints and finger tips.
t2: Yes indeed; We are able to shape again his fingers.
t3: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!

ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
en: Still people want to deny what is yet to come,
t1: Yet man still wants to continue committing sins also (in the life to come).
t2: Nay, but man desires to continue on as a libertine,
t3: But man would fain deny what is before him.

ar: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
en: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”
t1: He asks (scornfully): ‘When is the Day of Resurrection?’
t2: asking, ’When shall be the Day of Resurrection?’
t3: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection ?

ar: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
en: But when the sight is stunned,
t1: But when the eyes will be dazzled,
t2: But when the sight is dazed
t3: But when sight is confounded

ar: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
en: and the moon is dimmed,
t1: And the moon will be eclipsed,
t2: and the moon is eclipsed,
t3: And the moon is eclipsed

ar: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
en: and the sun and the moon are brought together,
t1: And the sun and the moon will be fused (i.e., darkened) together,
t2: and the sun and moon are brought together,
t3: And sun and moon are united,

ar: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
en: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”
t1: On that Day man will cry out: ‘Where to flee away?’
t2: upon that day man shall say, ’Whither to flee?’
t3: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!

ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
en: But no! There will be no refuge.
t1: No indeed! There is no place of refuge.
t2: No indeed; not a refuge!
t3: Alas! No refuge!

ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
en: On that Day all will end up before your Lord.
t1: The place of refuge and repose that Day will be with your Lord alone.
t2: Upon that day the recourse shall be to thy Lord.
t3: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.

ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
en: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind.
t1: That Day man will be informed of those (deeds) which he sent forward and those (repercussions) which he left behind (after his death).
t2: Upon that day man shall be told his former deeds and his latter;
t3: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.

ar: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
en: In fact, people will testify against their own souls,
t1: In truth, man will (himself) be aware of (the affairs of) his self,
t2: nay, man shall be a clear proof against himself,
t3: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,

ar: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
en: despite the excuses they come up with.
t1: Even though he will offer all his excuses.
t2: even though he offer his excuses.
t3: Although he tender his excuses.

ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
en: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran.
t1: (O Beloved!) Do not move your tongue in a hurry (to learn the Qur’an by heart when it is revealed to you).
t2: Move not thy tongue with it to hasten it;
t3: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.

ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
en: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it.
t1: Assuredly, upon Us rests its collection and preservation (in your breast) and its recitation (by your tongue).
t2: Ours it is to gather it, and to recite it.
t3: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.

ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
en: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺.
t1: So when We complete its recitation (by the tongue of Jibril [Gabriel]), then follow that recitation.
t2: So, when We recite it, follow thou its recitation.
t3: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
en: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺.
t1: Then surely upon Us is the clear exposition (of its implications).
t2: Then Ours it is to explain it.
t3: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.

ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
en: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world,
t1: The truth is, (O disbelievers,) that you love (the world) which you can readily gain.
t2: No indeed; but you love the hasty world,
t3: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now

ar: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
en: and neglect the Hereafter.
t1: And you have left aside the Hereafter.
t2: and leave be the Hereafter.
t3: And neglect the Hereafter.

ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
en: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright,
t1: Many faces will be fresh and in full bloom that Day,
t2: Upon that day faces shall be radiant,
t3: That day will faces be resplendent,

ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
en: looking at their Lord.
t1: Beholding (the enchanting radiance and beauty of) their Lord (unveiled).
t2: gazing upon their Lord;
t3: Looking toward their Lord;

ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
en: And ˹other˺ faces will be gloomy,
t1: And many faces will be deformed (depressed and dark) that Day,
t2: and upon that day faces shall be scowling,
t3: And that day will other faces be despondent,

ar: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
en: anticipating something devastating to befall them.
t1: Thinking that they will be subjected to such a harsh treatment that will break their backbones.
t2: thou mightest think the Calamity has been wreaked on them.
t3: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.

ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
en: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺,
t1: No indeed! When the soul reaches the throat,
t2: No indeed; when it reaches the clavicles
t3: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat

ar: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
en: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”
t1: And it is said: ‘Who can (now) treat him with magic (to cure him)?’
t2: and it is said, ’Who is an enchanter?’
t3: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now) ?

ar: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
en: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart,
t1: And (the departing soul) comes to realize that (now) is the hour of parting (with all).
t2: and he thinks that it is the parting
t3: And he knoweth that it is the parting;

ar: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
en: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺.
t1: And one leg clings to the other;
t2: and leg is intertwined with leg,
t3: And agony is heaped on agony;

ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
en: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺.
t1: Towards your Lord is the departure that Day.
t2: upon that day unto thy Lord shall be the driving.
t3: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.

ar: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
en: This denier neither believed nor prayed,
t1: So (how ill-fated is he that) he neither affirmed (what the Messenger said) nor offered Prayer.
t2: For he confirmed it not, and did not pray,
t3: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.

ar: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
en: but persisted in denial and turned away,
t1: Rather he kept belying and turning away.
t2: but he cried it lies, and he turned away,
t3: But he denied and flouted.

ar: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
en: then went to their own people, walking boastfully.
t1: Then he went off towards his family in arrogance.
t2: then he went to his household arrogantly.
t3: Then went he to his folk with glee.

ar: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
en: Woe to you, and more woe!
t1: Woe to you (when dying), then woe to you (in the grave),
t2: Nearer to thee and nearer
t3: Nearer unto thee and nearer,

ar: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
en: Again, woe to you, and even more woe!
t1: Then again woe to you (on the Last Day), then woe to you (in Hell)!
t2: then nearer to thee and nearer!
t3: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
en: Do people think they will be left without purpose?
t1: Does man think that he will be left for nothing (without any reckoning)?
t2: What, does man reckon he shall be left to roam at will?
t3: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless ?

ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
en: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted?
t1: Was he not (in his beginning) a sperm drop ejaculated (into the woman’s womb)?
t2: Was he not a sperm-drop spilled?
t3: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth ?

ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
en: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form,
t1: Then it developed into a hanging mass (clinging to the womb like a nest). Then He created (in it the preliminary form of all the limbs of the body). Then He set (them) right.
t2: Then he was a blood-clot, and He created and formed,
t3: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned

ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
en: producing from it both sexes, male and female.
t1: Then He made from the same sperm drop two genders: male and female.
t2: and He made of him two kinds, male and female.
t3: And made of him a pair, the male and female.

ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
en: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life?
t1: Then has He not the power to give life to the dead again?
t2: What, is He not able to quicken the dead?
t3: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life ?

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
en: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning?
t1: Surely, there has passed over man a period of time when he was not a thing worth mentioning.
t2: Has there come on man a while of time when he was a thing unremembered?
t3: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered ?

ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
en: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see.
t1: Surely, We created man from a fertilized ovum that We keep turning and examining (from one stage to the next till birth). So We have made him (in the order of) hearing (then) seeing.
t2: We created man of a sperm-drop, a mingling, and We made him hearing, seeing.
t3: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.

ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
en: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful.
t1: Indeed, We also showed him the way (to understanding and insight for distinguishing between the truth and falsehood) whether he (now) becomes thankful or continues to be ungrateful.
t2: Surely We guided him upon the way whether he be thankful or unthankful.
t3: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.

ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
en: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire.
t1: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains (for the feet), neck-fetters and the Blazing Fire (of Hell).
t2: Surely We have prepared for the unbelievers chains, fetters, and a Blaze.
t3: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
en: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—
t1: Surely, the sincerely devoted and obedient will drink from the cups (of the holy drink) mixed with kafur (to enhance its aroma, colour and taste).
t2: Surely the pious shall drink of a cup whose mixture is camphor,
t3: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,

ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
en: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will.
t1: (Kafur is) a spring (in Paradise) that (the privileged) servants of Allah (i.e., Awliya’ Allah) will drink from, and will (also) make it flow to wherever they will desire in the form of small brooks (to make others drink of it).
t2: a fountain whereat drink the servants of God, making it to gush forth plenteously.
t3: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,

ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
en: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror,
t1: (These privileged servants of Allah are those) who fulfil their vows and keep fearing that Day whose severity spreads afar.
t2: They fulfil their vows, and fear a day whose evil is upon the wing;
t3: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,

ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
en: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive,
t1: And they give (their own) food, in deep love of Allah, to the needy, the orphan and prisoner (out of sacrifice, despite their own desire and need for it),
t2: they give food, for the love of Him, to the needy, the orphan, the captive:
t3: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,

ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
en: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you.
t1: (And say:) ‘We are feeding you only to please Allah. We do not seek any recompense from you nor (wish for) any thanks.
t2: ’We feed you only for the Face of God; we desire no recompense from you, no thankfulness;
t3: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;

ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
en: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”
t1: We fear from our Lord the Day which will make (the faces) look very dark (and) ugly.’
t2: for we fear from our Lord a frowning day, inauspicious.
t3: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.

ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
en: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy,
t1: So Allah will save them from the terror of that Day (for their fear of Allah) and will grant them freshness, bloom and blush (on their faces) and ecstasy and delight (in their hearts),
t2: So God has guarded them from the evil of that day, and has procured them radiancy and gladness,
t3: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;

ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
en: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk.
t1: And will bless them with Gardens (to live in) and silky clothes (to wear), a reward for their patience.
t2: and recompensed them for their patience with a Garden, and silk;
t3: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;

ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
en: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold.
t1: Reclining in it against cushions on raised couches, they will find there neither intense cold nor heat.
t2: therein they shall recline upon couches, therein they shall see neither sun nor bitter cold;
t3: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.

ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
en: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach.
t1: And the shades (of trees in Paradise) will close upon them, and the bunches of their (fruits) will be hanging low.
t2: near them shall be its shades, and its clusters hung meekly down,
t3: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.

ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
en: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—
t1: And (the servants) will go round them with vessels of silver and (pure and clean) goblets of shining glass,
t2: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver, and goblets of crystal,
t3: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

ar: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
en: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired.
t1: And glasses made of silver which they will have filled with exact measures (according to everyone’s desire).
t2: crystal of silver that they have measured -- very exactly.
t3: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).

ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
en: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger
t1: And they will be made to drink there cups of (the holy drink) mixed with Zanjabil.
t2: And therein they shall be given to drink a cup whose mixture is ginger,
t3: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
roots: ز ن ج ب ي ل

ar: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
en: from a spring there, called Salsabil.
t1: (Zanjabil is) a spring in this (Paradise) named Salsabil.
t2: therein a fountain whose name is called Salsabil.
t3: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.

ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
en: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls.
t1: And going round them will be (innocent) adolescents who will remain ever-young. When you will see them, you will consider them as scattered pearls.
t2: Immortal youths shall go about them; when thou seest them, thou supposest them scattered pearls,
t3: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.

ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
en: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom.
t1: And when you will look (at Paradise), you will find blessings (in abundance) and a mighty kingdom (all around).
t2: when thou seest them then thou seest bliss and a great kingdom.
t3: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.

ar: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
en: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
t1: They will be clad in green, fine silk and rich brocade attire, and they will be made to wear silver bracelets, and their Lord will make them drink a holy beverage.
t2: Upon them shall be green garments of silk and brocade; they are adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord shall give them to drink a pure draught.
t3: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
en: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”
t1: Surely, that will be your reward and your hard work is acknowledged.
t2: Behold, this is a recompense for you, and your striving is thanked.’
t3: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
en: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages.
t1: Indeed, We have revealed the Qur’an to you piecemeal.
t2: Surely We have sent down the Koran on thee, a sending down;
t3: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur’an, a revelation;

ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
en: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them.
t1: So (continue to) be patient for the sake of your Lord’s command and do not give your ear to any liar, sinner or disbeliever or thankless person from amongst them.
t2: so be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord, and obey not one of them, sinner or unbeliever.
t3: So submit patiently to thy Lord’s command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.

ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
en: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening,
t1: And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening.
t2: And remember the Name of thy Lord at dawn and in the evening
t3: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
en: and prostrate before Him during part of the night,
t1: And prostrate yourself before His presence for some hours of the night, and glorify Him during (the rest of) the long hours of the night.
t2: and part of the night; bow down before Him and magnify Him through the long night.
t3: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
en: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them.
t1: Surely, these (world-mongers) love the gains that are achievable right away. And they have put behind their backs (the remembrance of) the very hard Day.
t2: Surely these men love the hasty world, and leave be behind them a heavy day.
t3: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.

ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
en: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others.
t1: (They do not realize that) We alone have created them and have made their every joint strong, and We can replace them whenever We may please with the people like them.
t2: We created them, and We strengthened their joints; and, when We will, We shall exchange their likes.
t3: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
en: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord.
t1: Indeed, this (Qur’an) is a Reminder. So whoever desires may adopt the way to (reach) his Lord.
t2: Surely this is a Reminder; so he who will, takes unto his Lord a way.
t3: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.

ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
en: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t1: And you cannot wish anything yourselves except what Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
t2: But you will not unless God wills; surely God is ever All-knowing, All-wise.
t3: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

ar: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
en: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment
t1: He admits whom He wills to (the circle of) His mercy, and He has prepared a grievous torment for the wrongdoers.
t2: For He admits into His mercy whomsoever He will; as for the evildoers, He has prepared for them a painful chastisement.
t3: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.

ar: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
en: By those ˹winds˺ sent forth successively,
t1: By the soft blowing, pleasant breezes which blow in succession,
t2: By the loosed ones successively
t3: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another

ar: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
en: and those blowing violently,
t1: Then by the violent winds which blow with fierce gusts,
t2: storming tempestuously
t3: By the raging hurricanes,

ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
en: and those scattering ˹rainclouds˺ widely!
t1: And by those which spread the clouds all around,
t2: by the scatterers scattering
t3: By those which cause earth’s vegetation to revive;

ar: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
en: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺,
t1: Then by those which split (them) apart and break them off,
t2: and the severally severing
t3: By those who winnow with a winnowing,

ar: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
en: and those delivering revelation,
t1: Then by those which bring direction and guidance,
t2: and those hurling a reminder
t3: By those who bring down the Reminder,

ar: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
en: ending excuses and giving warnings.
t1: To accomplish the argument or to warn,
t2: excusing or warning,
t3: To excuse or to warn,

ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
en: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass.
t1: Surely, the promise (of the Last Day) which is being given to you will be certainly fulfilled.
t2: surely that which you are promised is about to fall!
t3: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.

ar: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
en: So when the stars are put out,
t1: Then when the light of the stars will be extinguished,
t2: When the stars shall be extinguished,
t3: So when the stars are put out,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
en: and the sky is torn apart,
t1: And when the heavenly universe will be split open,
t2: when heaven shall be split
t3: And when the sky is riven asunder,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
en: and the mountains are blown away,
t1: And when the mountains will be (broken down to dust) and blown off,
t2: when the mountains shall be scattered
t3: And when the mountains are blown away,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
en: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—
t1: And when the Messengers will be brought together at the appointed time (to bear witness to their respective communities),
t2: and when the Messengers’ time is set,
t3: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -

ar: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
en: for which Day has all this been set?
t1: Well, for what Day is the term (of all the affairs) appointed?
t2: to what day shall they be delayed?
t3: For what day is the time appointed ?

ar: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
en: For the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision!
t1: For the Day of Judgment!
t2: To the Day of Decision.
t3: For the Day of Decision.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
en: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is?
t1: And who has told you what the Day of Judgment is?
t2: And what shall teach thee what is the Day of Decision?
t3: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe (and devastation) to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers?
t1: Did We not destroy the people (who denied) before?
t2: Did We not destroy the ancients,
t3: Destroyed We not the former folk,

ar: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
en: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them.
t1: Then We also cause the later ones to follow them (in destruction).
t2: and then follow them with the later folk?
t3: Then caused the latter folk to follow after ?

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
en: This is how We deal with the wicked.
t1: This is how We sort out (the matter) with the evildoers.
t2: So We serve the sinners.
t3: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
en: Did We not create you from a humble fluid,
t1: Did We not create you from (a drop) of detestable fluid?
t2: Did We not create you of a mean water,
t3: Did We not create you from a base fluid

ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
en: placing it in a secure place
t1: Then We placed it in a secure place (i.e., the mother’s womb),
t2: that We laid within a sure lodging
t3: Which We laid up in a safe abode

ar: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
en: until an appointed time?
t1: Till an appointed period (of time).
t2: till a known term decreed?
t3: For a known term ?

ar: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
en: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so!
t1: Then We determined time periods (for all the stages of growth from conception to birth). And how excellent do We determine!
t2: We determined; excellent determiners are We.
t3: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
en: Have We not made the earth a lodging
t1: Have We not made the earth an assembling expanse,
t2: Made We not the earth to be a housing
t3: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

ar: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
en: for the living and the dead,
t1: (That draws together) the living (as well as) the dead?
t2: for the living and for the dead?
t3: Both for the living and the dead,

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
en: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink?
t1: And We placed on it soaring high and firm mountains, and gave you sweet water to drink (from springs of sweet, fresh water).
t2: Set We not therein soaring mountains? Sated you with sweetest water?
t3: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein ?

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny!
t1: (Now) move on to that (torment) which you used to deny.
t2: Depart to that you cried was lies!
t3: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;

ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
en: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns,
t1: Proceed towards that shadow (of the smoke of Hell) that forks into three columns,
t2: Depart to a triple-massing shadow
t3: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,

ar: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
en: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames.
t1: A shadow which is neither cool nor protecting against the heat of Fire.
t2: unshading against the blazing flame
t3: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.

ar: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
en: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles,
t1: Indeed, that (Hell) throws up sparks and flames (huge) as a lofty palace.
t2: that shoots sparks like dry faggots,
t3: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,

ar: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
en: and ˹as dark˺ as black camels.”
t1: (It also appears) as if those (sparks) are yellow camels.
t2: sparks like to golden herds.
t3: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
en: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak,
t1: This is a Day (on which) they will not be able to speak too.
t2: This is the day they shall not speak
t3: This is a day wherein they speak not,

ar: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
en: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses.
t1: Nor will they be allowed to offer any excuses.
t2: neither be given leave, and excuse themselves.
t3: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺.
t1: This is the Day of Judgment (on which) We shall gather you and (all) the earlier communities.
t2: ’This is the Day of Decision; We have joined you with the ancients;
t3: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.

ar: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
en: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”
t1: Then if you have any scheme (and trick to escape from the torment), try (that) against Me.
t2: if you have a trick, try you now to trick Me!’
t3: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe (i.e., dejection) to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
en: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs
t1: Surely, the Godfearing will be (rejoicing) under cool shades and amid springs.
t2: Truly the godfearing shall dwell amid shades and fountains,
t3: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,

ar: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
en: and any fruit they desire.
t1: And whatever fruits they will long for (will be available for them).
t2: and such fruits as their hearts desire:
t3: And fruits such as they desire.

ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
t1: (It will be said to them:) ‘Enjoy eating and drinking to your taste as a reward for what you used to do.’
t2: ’Eat and drink, with wholesome appetite, for that you were working.’
t3: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.

ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
en: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers.
t1: Indeed, the same way do We reward the pious.
t2: Even so do We recompense the good-doers.
t3: Thus do We reward the good.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
en: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”
t1: (O deniers of the truth!) Eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while. No doubt, you are the evildoers.
t2: ’Eat and take your joy a little; you are sinners!’
t3: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
en: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow.
t1: And when it is said to them: ‘Bow down (before Allah),’ they do not bow.
t2: When it is said to them, ’Prostrate yourselves!’ they prostrate not.
t3: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers!
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day!
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in?
t1: Then in what revelation after this (Qur’an) will they believe?
t2: In what discourse after this will they believe?
t3: In what statement, after this, will they believe ?

ar: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
en: What are they asking one another about?
t1: What is (it) they are questioning about one another?
t2: Of what do they question one another?
t3: Whereof do they question one another ?

ar: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: About the momentous news,
t1: (Are they asking) of the Great News,
t2: Of the mighty tiding
t3: (It is) of the awful tidings,

ar: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
en: over which they disagree.
t1: About which they differ?
t2: whereon they are at variance.
t3: Concerning which they are in disagreement.

ar: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
en: But no! They will come to know.
t1: (That News is) not at all (deniable). They will soon know (that reality).
t2: No indeed; they shall soon know!
t3: Nay, but they will come to know!

ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
en: Again, no! They will come to know.
t1: (We) once more (assert: Dissent and denial are) in no way (right). They will come to know soon.
t2: Again, no indeed; they shall soon know!
t3: Nay, again, but they will come to know!

ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
en: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺,
t1: Have We not made the earth a place to stay for (life) and to earn living and deeds?
t2: Have We not made the earth as a cradle
t3: Have We not made the earth an expanse,

ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
en: and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs,
t1: And (have We not) erected mountains raised (out of it)?
t2: and the mountains as pegs?
t3: And the high hills bulwarks ?

ar: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
en: and created you in pairs,
t1: And (ponder:) We (have) created you in pairs (for reproduction).
t2: And We created you in pairs,
t3: And We have created you in pairs,

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
en: and made your sleep for rest,
t1: And We (have) made your sleep (a means of bodily) rest,
t2: and We appointed your sleep for a rest;
t3: And have appointed your sleep for repose,

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
en: and made the night as a cover,
t1: And We (have) made the night a covering (by virtue of its darkness).
t2: and We appointed night for a garment,
t3: And have appointed the night as a cloak,

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
en: and made the day for livelihood,
t1: And We (have) made the day (a time) for (earning) livelihood.
t2: and We appointed day for a livelihood.
t3: And have appointed the day for livelihood.

ar: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
en: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺,
t1: And (now study the spatial universe as well). We built above you seven strong (firmaments).
t2: And We have built above you seven strong ones,
t3: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
en: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp,
t1: And We made (the sun a massive) fountainhead of light and heat.
t2: and We appointed a blazing lamp
t3: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,

ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
en: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water,
t1: And We poured water in torrents from rain-laden clouds,
t2: and have sent down out of the rainclouds water cascading
t3: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,

ar: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
en: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants,
t1: So that by means of this (downpour), We bring forth (from the earth) grain and vegetation,
t2: that We may bring forth thereby grain and plants,
t3: Thereby to produce grain and plant,

ar: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
en: and dense orchards?
t1: And (grow) thick gardens.
t2: and gardens luxuriant.
t3: And gardens of thick foliage.

ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
en: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—
t1: (Observing these signs of Our Might, know that) the Day of Judgment (i.e., Resurrection too) is certainly a fixed time.
t2: Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,
t3: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
en: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds.
t1: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, you will flock (in the holy presence of Allah) in droves.
t2: the day the Trumpet is blown, and you shall come in troops,
t3: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,

ar: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
en: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates,
t1: And the (layers of) heaven will be torn, and (owing to the rip) they will become (as if) all doors.
t2: and heaven is opened, and become gates,
t3: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,

ar: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
en: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage.
t1: And the mountains (after being reduced to dust) will be blown off (into the atmosphere); so they will be (eliminated like) a mirage.
t2: and the mountains are set in motion, and become a vapour.
t3: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.

ar: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
en: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush
t1: Surely, Hell is a place of ambush.
t2: Behold, Gehenna has become an ambush,
t3: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,

ar: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
en: as a home for the transgressors,
t1: (That) is the abode of rebels.
t2: for the insolent a resort,
t3: A home for the rebellious.

ar: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
en: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages.
t1: They will abide there for recurrent, infinite periods.
t2: therein to tarry for ages,
t3: They will abide therein for ages.

ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
en: There they will not taste any coolness or drink,
t1: They will taste in it neither coolness (of any sort) nor any drink,
t2: tasting therein neither coolness nor any drink
t3: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink

ar: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
en: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—
t1: Except boiling water and suppurated fluid oozing (from the wounds of the inmates of Hell),
t2: save boiling water and pus
t3: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:

ar: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
en: a fitting reward.
t1: A compensation commensurate with (their revolt),
t2: for a suitable recompense.
t3: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).

ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
en: For they never expected any reckoning,
t1: For they had no fear of Reckoning (on the Last Day) in the least.
t2: They indeed hoped not for a reckoning,
t3: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;

ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
en: and totally rejected Our signs.
t1: And they used to utterly deny Our signs.
t2: and they cried loud lies to Our signs;
t3: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.

ar: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
en: And We have everything recorded precisely.
t1: And We have preserved everything (major or minor) in writing.
t2: and everything We have numbered in a Book.
t3: Everything have We recorded in a Book.

ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
en: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”
t1: (O disbelievers, you excelled in rebellion and disbelief in the world.) Now taste the outcome (of your actions). We shall keep increasing but the torment upon you.
t2: ’Taste! We shall increase you not save in chastisement.’
t3: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.

ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
en: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—
t1: Surely, the Godfearing will triumph.
t2: Surely for the godfearing awaits a place of security,
t3: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -

ar: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
en: Gardens, vineyards,
t1: (For them) there will be gardens and grapes,
t2: gardens and vineyards
t3: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,

ar: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
en: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,
t1: And well-matched young maidens,
t2: and maidens with swelling breasts, like of age,
t3: And maidens for companions,

ar: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
en: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺,
t1: And overflowing cups (of holy beverage).
t2: and a cup overflowing.
t3: And a full cup.

ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
en: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—
t1: There, these (people) will neither hear any foolish talk nor belie (one another).
t2: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, no cry of lies,
t3: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -

ar: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
en: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord,
t1: From your Lord this is the reward which is an (amply) sufficient bestowal (in proportion to your works).
t2: for a recompense from thy Lord, a gift, a reckoning,
t3: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -

ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
en: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him
t1: He is the Lord of (all) the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Kind. (But on the Last Day, the effect and impact of His mighty power and most high authority will be such that) none (from His creation) will dare converse with Him.
t2: Lord of the heavens and earth, and all that between them is, the All-merciful of whom they have no power to speak.
t3: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.

ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
en: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true.
t1: That Day Gabriel (the Spirit of peace and security) and (all) angels will stand in ranks, none able to speak except he whom the Most Kind (Lord) would already have awarded sanction (to intercede) and who also said the right thing (in keeping with the teachings of Islam, during his life of the world).
t2: Upon the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in ranks they shall speak not, save him to whom the All-merciful has given leave, and who speaks aright.
t3: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.

ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
en: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord.
t1: This is the Day of truth. So, whoever longs may obtain an abode (of mercy and nearness) in the presence of his Lord.
t2: That is the true day; so whosoever wills takes unto his Lord a resort.
t3: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.

ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
en: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
t1: We have, indeed, warned you of the impending torment. On that Day, everyone will see whatever (acts) he has sent ahead and (every) disbeliever will say: ‘Would that I were dust (and escaped this punishment)!’
t2: Lo, We have warned you of a nigh chastisement, upon the day when a man shall behold what his hands have forwarded, and the unbeliever shall say, ’O would that I were dust!’
t3: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"

ar: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
en: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly,
t1: By the (angels) who violently snatch out (the souls of the disbelievers from each tendon and ligament of their body), Or By the waves of energy that pierce into matter and break up the chemical bonds fiercely,
t2: By those that pluck out vehemently
t3: By those who drag forth to destruction,

ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
en: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently,
t1: And by the (angels) who unweave sinews (of the believers’ organisms) gently and peacefully, Or By the waves of energy that disintegrate gently and peacefully the chemical bonds within matter,
t2: and those that draw out violently,
t3: By the meteors rushing,

ar: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
en: and those gliding ˹through heavens˺ swiftly,
t1: And by the (angels) who swiftly glide (between the heavens and the earth), Or By the waves of energy that move around freely in space and atmosphere,
t2: by those that swim serenely
t3: By the lone stars floating,

ar: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
en: and those taking the lead vigorously,
t1: Then by the (angels) who with burst of speed sprint past others, Or By the waves of energy that surpass other waves in speed, force and assimilation,
t2: and those that outstrip suddenly
t3: By the angels hastening,

ar: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
en: and those conducting affairs ˹obediently˺!
t1: Then by the (angels) who manage different affairs well, Or By the waves of energy that, through mutual dynamism and coordination, maintain equilibrium and keep the balance of the management going for the survival of the system of the universe,
t2: by those that direct an affair!
t3: And those who govern the event,

ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
en: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass,
t1: (When they will be commanded to devastate the system of the universe) that Day, everything in motion (in the universe) will tremor into violent convulsion,
t2: Upon the day when the first blast shivers
t3: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.

ar: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
en: followed by a second Blast.
t1: Chased by a succeeding convulsion.
t2: and the second blast follows it,
t3: And the second followeth it,

ar: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
en: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺,
t1: That Day, hearts (of the people) will pound with agony and terror.
t2: hearts upon that day shall be athrob
t3: On that day hearts beat painfully

ar: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
en: with their eyes downcast.
t1: Their eyes will be downcast (with dread and horror).
t2: and their eyes shall be humbled.
t3: While eyes are downcast

ar: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
en: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state,
t1: The disbelievers say: ‘Shall we be reverted to the former life?
t2: They shall say, ’What, are we being restored as we were before?
t3: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state

ar: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
en: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”
t1: (Shall we be given life even) when we shall have become rotten (hollow) bones?’
t2: What, when we are bones old and wasted?’
t3: Even after we are crumbled bones ?

ar: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
en: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”
t1: They say: ‘This (return) would then be a losing return.’
t2: They shall say, ’That then were a losing return!’
t3: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.

ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
en: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast,
t1: Then it will be rending (of all heavenly bodies) asunder with single extremely horrible explosion.
t2: But it shall be only a single scare,
t3: Surely it will need but one shout,

ar: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
en: and at once they will be above ground.
t1: Then they (all) will forgather suddenly in the open expanse (for assembly).
t2: and behold, they are awakened.
t3: And lo! they will be awakened.

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
en: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺?
t1: Has the account of Musa (Moses) reached you?
t2: Hast thou received the story of Moses?
t3: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses ?

ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
en: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa,
t1: When His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
t2: When his Lord called to him in the holy valley, Towa:
t3: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,

ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
en: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.
t1: (And commanded:) ‘Go to Pharaoh. He has transgressed all bounds.’
t2: ’Go to Pharaoh; he has waxed insolent.
t3: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -

ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
en: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself,
t1: Then say (to him): ‘Do you wish that you should be purified?
t2: And say, "Hast thou the will to purify thyself;
t3: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace) ?

ar: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
en: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”
t1: And (do you desire that) I guide you to your Lord so that you may fear (Him)?’
t2: and that I should guide thee to thy Lord, then thou shalt fear?"’
t3: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).

ar: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
en: Then Moses showed him the great sign,
t1: Then Musa (Moses) showed him the great sign.
t2: So he showed him the great sign,
t3: And he showed him the tremendous token.

ar: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
en: but he denied and disobeyed ˹Allah˺,
t1: But he denied it and disobeyed.
t2: but he cried lies, and rebelled,
t3: But he denied and disobeyed,

ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
en: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺.
t1: Then, turning away (from the truth), he launched struggle (in rivalry against Musa [Moses]).
t2: then he turned away hastily,
t3: Then turned he away in haste,

ar: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
en: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out,
t1: So he gathered (people) and started calling out,
t2: then he mustered
t3: Then gathered he and summoned

ar: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
en: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”
t1: And said: ‘I am your lord, most high.’
t2: and proclaimed, and he said, ’I am your Lord, the Most High!’
t3: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."

ar: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
en: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next.
t1: Then Allah seized him in (dual) punishment of this world and the Hereafter.
t2: So God seized him with the chastisement of the Last World and the First.
t3: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
en: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺.
t1: Surely, in this (incident) there is a great lesson of warning for him who fears (Allah).
t2: Surely in that is a lesson for him who fears!
t3: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.

ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
en: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it,
t1: Is it you who are harder to create, or (the entire) galactic universe that He has built?
t2: What, are you stronger in constitution or the heaven He built?
t3: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built ?

ar: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
en: raising it high and forming it flawlessly.
t1: He raised high all the heavenly spheres (planets, after creating them in the infinite cosmos), then moderated, equipoised and stabilized (their composition, construction, functions and movements).
t2: He lifted up its vault, and levelled it,
t3: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;

ar: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
en: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight.
t1: And He is the One Who blackened the night of heavenly space (i.e., darkened the entire spatial environment like a murky night) and emitted (after creating) the light of these (planets from this space).
t2: and darkened its night, and brought forth its forenoon;
t3: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
en: As for the earth, He spread it out as well,
t1: And He is the One Who, later, (after the creation of the planet sun) separated (from it) the earth, flung it with centrifugal force (and spread its expanse to make it inhabitable).
t2: and the earth-after that He spread it out,
t3: And after that He spread the earth,

ar: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
en: bringing forth its water and pastures
t1: He is the One Who drew water from the earth (separately), and brought forth its vegetable kingdom (from the rest of the dry regions).
t2: therefrom brought forth its waters and its pastures,
t3: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,

ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
en: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—
t1: And He is the One Who (putting together different elements) raised from the earth firmly fixed mountains.
t2: and the mountains He set firm,
t3: And He made fast the hills,

ar: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
en: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals.
t1: (He did all this) for the benefit of you and your livestock.
t2: an enjoyment for you and your flocks.
t3: A provision for you and for your cattle.

ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
en: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—
t1: Then, whilst (the universe) attains (to its acme through evolution), there will befall the great all-encompassing calamity (the Hour of Resurrection).
t2: Then, when the Great Catastrophe comes
t3: But when the great disaster cometh,

ar: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
en: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving,
t1: That Day man will retrospect his (every) effort and action.
t2: upon the day when man shall remember what he has striven,
t3: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,

ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
en: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—
t1: And Hell will be made manifest to everyone who can see.
t2: and Hell is advanced for whoever sees,
t3: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,

ar: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
en: then as for those who transgressed
t1: Then he who transgressed the limits,
t2: then as for him who was insolent
t3: Then, as for him who rebelled

ar: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
en: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world,
t1: And preferred the life of the world (to the Hereafter),
t2: and preferred the present life,
t3: And chose the life of the world,

ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
en: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home.
t1: Hell will truly be (his) abode.
t2: surely Hell shall be the refuge.
t3: Lo! hell will be his home.

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
en: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires,
t1: But as for him who feared standing in the presence of his Lord and forbade (his ill-commanding) self its appetites and lusts,
t2: But as for him who feared the Station of his Lord and forbade the soul its caprice,
t3: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,

ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
en: Paradise will certainly be ˹their˺ home.
t1: Paradise will surely be (his) abode.
t2: surely Paradise shall be the refuge.
t3: Lo! the Garden will be his home.

ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
en: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”
t1: (The disbelievers) ask you about the Hour of Rising: ‘When will it come to pass?’
t2: They will question thee concerning the Hour, when it shall berth.
t3: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port ?

ar: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
en: But it is not for you to tell its time.
t1: What should be your concern in talking about (its appointed time)?
t2: What art thou about, to mention it?
t3: Why (ask they) ? What hast thou to tell thereof ?

ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
en: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺.
t1: Its ultimate limit is up to your Lord (i.e., as in the beginning, only Oneness will survive in the end as well).
t2: Unto thy Lord is the final end of it.
t3: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.

ar: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
en: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it.
t1: You are but a Warner to him who fears it.
t2: Thou art only the warner of him who fears it.
t3: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.

ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
en: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning.
t1: So the Day when they will see it, they (will feel as if they) did not tarry (in the world) but for one evening or one morning.
t2: It shall be as if; on the day they see it, they have but tarried for an evening, or its forenoon.
t3: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.

ar: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
en: He frowned and turned ˹his attention˺ away,
t1: A feeling of uneasiness came upon his (holy) face, and he turned aside his (radiant) face,
t2: He frowned and turned away
t3: He frowned and turned away

ar: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
en: ˹simply˺ because the blind man came to him ˹interrupting˺.
t1: Because a blind man approached him (who interrupted his discourse).
t2: that the blind man came to him.
t3: Because the blind man came unto him.

ar: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
en: You never know ˹O Prophet˺, perhaps he may be purified,
t1: And what do you know? Perhaps he would be purified (further owing to your attending to him),
t2: And what should teach thee? Perchance he would cleanse him,
t3: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)

ar: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
en: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder.
t1: Or would accept (your) advice which would provide him benefit (more and more).
t2: or yet remember, and the Reminder profit him.
t3: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him ?

ar: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
en: As for the one who was indifferent,
t1: But the one who disregards (the Din [Religion)],
t2: But the self-sufficient,
t3: As for him who thinketh himself independent,

ar: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
en: you gave him your ˹undivided˺ attention,
t1: You administer greater care (for his acceptance of Islam),
t2: to him thou attendest
t3: Unto him thou payest regard.

ar: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
en: even though you are not to blame if he would not be purified.
t1: Whereas there is no (burden of) responsibility on you, even if he does not adopt purification (i.e., faith).
t2: though it is not thy concern, if he does not cleanse himself.
t3: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).

ar: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
en: But as for the one who came to you, eager ˹to learn˺,
t1: And as for him who has (himself) come to you exerting (in pursuit of piousness),
t2: And he who comes to thee eagerly
t3: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose

ar: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
en: being in awe ˹of Allah˺,
t1: And he fears (his Lord) as well,
t2: and fearfully,
t3: And hath fear,

ar: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
en: you were inattentive to him.
t1: But you are not focusing your attention on him.
t2: to him thou payest no heed.
t3: From him thou art distracted.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
en: But no! This ˹revelation˺ is truly a reminder.
t1: (O My Esteemed Beloved!) Not so indeed! These (Verses of the Holy Qur’an) are but advice.
t2: No indeed; it is a Reminder
t3: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,

ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
en: So let whoever wills be mindful of it.
t1: The one who seeks may accept it (and learn by heart).
t2: (and whoso wills, shall remember it)
t3: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,

ar: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
en: It is ˹written˺ on pages held in honour—
t1: (They are inscribed) on venerable and revered pages,
t2: upon pages high-honoured,
t3: On honoured leaves

ar: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
en: highly esteemed, purified—
t1: Which are exalted (and) purified,
t2: uplifted, purified,
t3: Exalted, purified,

ar: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
en: by the hands of angel-scribes,
t1: (Have come forth) by the hands of emissaries (and scribes),
t2: by the hands of scribes
t3: (Set down) by scribes

ar: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
en: honourable and virtuous.
t1: Who are possessors of eminence (and) embodiments of obedience.
t2: noble, pious
t3: Noble and righteous.

ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
en: Condemned are ˹disbelieving˺ humans! How ungrateful they are ˹to Allah˺!
t1: Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is!
t2: Perish Man! How unthankful he is!
t3: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!

ar: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
en: From what substance did He create them?
t1: From what stuff has Allah created him?
t2: Of what did He create him?
t3: From what thing doth He create him ?

ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
en: He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development.
t1: He created him from a sperm drop, then determined his measure along with that (regarding genes and sex),
t2: Of a sperm-drop He created him, and determined him,
t3: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,

ar: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
en: Then He makes the way easy for them,
t1: Then (after structuring, developing and completing it) eased for him the passage (of delivery from the mother’s womb),
t2: then the way eased for him,
t3: Then maketh the way easy for him,

ar: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
en: then causes them to die and be buried.
t1: Then caused him to die and (buried him) in a grave.
t2: then makes him to die, and buries him,
t3: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;

ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
en: Then when He wills, He will resurrect them.
t1: Then whenever He wills, He will raise them up (alive again).
t2: then, when He wills, He raises him.
t3: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.

ar: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
en: But no! They have failed to comply with what He ordered.
t1: Indeed, he (the disobedient man) did not fulfil that (obligatory due) which (Allah) had commanded him.
t2: No indeed! Man has not accomplished His bidding.
t3: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.

ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
en: Let people then consider their food:
t1: So man should look at his food (and ponder).
t2: Let Man consider his nourishment.
t3: Let man consider his food:

ar: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
en: how We pour down rain in abundance
t1: Indeed, We pour down water in torrents.
t2: We poured out the rains abundantly,
t3: How We pour water in showers

ar: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
en: and meticulously split the earth open ˹for sprouts˺,
t1: Then We split the earth and tear it asunder.
t2: then We split the earth in fissures
t3: Then split the earth in clefts

ar: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
en: causing grain to grow in it,
t1: We then grow from it grain,
t2: and therein made the grains to grow
t3: And cause the grain to grow therein

ar: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
en: as well as grapes and greens,
t1: And grapes and vegetables,
t2: and vines, and reeds,
t3: And grapes and green fodder

ar: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
en: and olives and palm trees,
t1: And the olive and the date palm,
t2: and olives, and palms,
t3: And olive-trees and palm-trees

ar: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
en: and dense orchards,
t1: And thickly planted dense gardens,
t2: and dense-tree’d gardens,
t3: And garden-closes of thick foliage

ar: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
en: and fruit and fodder—
t1: And (a variety of) fruits and (animals’) fodder,
t2: and fruits, and pastures,
t3: And fruits and grasses:

ar: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
en: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals.
t1: As provision both for you and your livestock (to live on).
t2: an enjoyment for you and your flocks.
t3: Provision for you and your cattle.

ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
en: Then, when the Deafening Blast comes to pass—
t1: So, when the Deafening Blast comes,
t2: And when the Blast shall sound,
t3: But when the Shout cometh

ar: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
en: on that Day every person will flee from their own siblings,
t1: On that Day man will flee from his brother,
t2: upon the day when a man shall flee from his brother,
t3: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother

ar: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
en: and ˹even˺ their mother and father,
t1: And from his mother and his father (too),
t2: his mother, his father,
t3: And his mother and his father

ar: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
en: and ˹even˺ their spouse and children.
t1: And (even) from his wife and his children.
t2: his consort, his sons,
t3: And his wife and his children,

ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
en: For then everyone will have enough concern of their own.
