t1: On that Day every person will be in such a (dismal) state that will make him unconcerned (with everyone else).
t2: every man that day shall have business to suffice him.
t3: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).

ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
en: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright,
t1: The same Day many faces will be shining (with light).
t2: Some faces on that day shall shine
t3: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,

ar: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
en: laughing and rejoicing,
t1: (They will be) smiling, laughing (and) rejoicing.
t2: laughing, joyous;
t3: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;

ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
en: while ˹other˺ faces will be dusty,
t1: And numerous faces there will be covered with dust that Day.
t2: some faces on that day shall be dusty
t3: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,

ar: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
en: cast in gloom—
t1: These (faces) will be overshadowed with darkness (as well).
t2: o’erspread with darkness --
t3: Veiled in darkness,

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
en: those are the disbelievers, the ˹wicked˺ sinners.
t1: They are the people who are disbelievers (and) mischief-mongers (i.e., evildoers).
t2: those -- they are the unbelievers, the libertines.
t3: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.

ar: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
en: When the sun is put out,
t1: When the sun will be folded up and extinguished,
t2: When the sun shall be darkened,
t3: When the sun is overthrown,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
en: and when the stars fall down,
t1: And the stars will fall (from their galaxies),
t2: when the stars shall be thrown down,
t3: And when the stars fall,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
en: and when the mountains are blown away,
t1: And when the mountains, (after having changed into dust,) will be set in motion (into the atmosphere),
t2: when the mountains shall be set moving,
t3: And when the hills are moved,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
en: and when pregnant camels are left untended,
t1: And when the she-camels heavy with young will be left neglected and discarded (i.e., no one will tend them),
t2: when the pregnant camels shall be neglected,
t3: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
en: and when wild beasts are gathered together,
t1: And when (fear-stricken) wild beasts will be herded together,
t2: when the savage beasts shall be mustered,
t3: And when the wild beasts are herded together,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
en: and when the seas are set on fire,
t1: And when (all) oceans and rivers will be made to rise and swell,
t2: when the seas shall be set boiling,
t3: And when the seas rise,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
en: and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺,
t1: And when souls will be united (with their bodies),
t2: when the souls shall be coupled,
t3: And when souls are reunited,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
en: and when baby girls, buried alive, are asked
t1: And when the infant girl buried alive will be asked,
t2: when the buried infant shall be asked
t3: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked

ar: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
en: for what crime they were put to death,
t1: For what crime was she slain?
t2: for what sin she was slain,
t3: For what sin she was slain,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
en: and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open,
t1: And when the records of deeds will be laid open,
t2: when the scrolls shall be unrolled,
t3: And when the pages are laid open,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
en: and when the sky is stripped away,
t1: And when the layers of heaven will be torn asunder and moved away from their places,
t2: when heaven shall be stripped off;
t3: And when the sky is torn away,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
en: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up,
t1: And when (the Fire of) Hell will be burnt ablaze,
t2: when Hell shall be set blazing,
t3: And when hell is lighted,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
en: and when Paradise is brought near—
t1: And when Paradise will be brought up close,
t2: when Paradise shall be brought nigh,
t3: And when the Garden is brought nigh,

ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
en: ˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along.
t1: Everyone will come to know what he has brought forth.
t2: then shall a soul know what it has produced.
t3: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.

ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
en: I do swear by the receding stars
t1: So I swear by (the heavenly spheres) which recede (after appearing),
t2: No! I swear by the slinkers,
t3: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,

ar: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
en: which travel and hide,
t1: Which revolve freely, (then) hide (after appearing),
t2: the runners, the sinkers,
t3: The stars which rise and set,

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
en: and the night as it falls
t1: And by the night when its darkness tapers off,
t2: by the night swarming,
t3: And the close of night,

ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
en: and the day as it breaks!
t1: And by the morning when its light dawns,
t2: by the dawn sighing,
t3: And the breath of morning

ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
en: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel,
t1: Indeed, this (Qur’an) is the Word (communicated) by a glorious and most venerable Messenger (blessings and peace be upon him),
t2: truly this is the word of a noble Messenger
t3: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,

ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
en: full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne,
t1: Who is mighty and strong (in calling to the truth, preaching the faith in Messengership and spiritual competence, and) is held in extreme reverence and veneration (and splendour and glory) in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
t2: having power, with the Lord of the Throne secure,
t3: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,

ar: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
en: obeyed there ˹in heaven˺, and trustworthy.
t1: Entitled to obligatory obedience (by all the worlds because obedience to him is obedience to Allah) and faithful to His trust (possesses Revelation and all divine secrets of the heavens and the earth).
t2: obeyed, moreover trusty.
t3: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;

ar: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
en: And your fellow man is not insane.
t1: And, (O people,) he who blesses you with his (holy) companionship (Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him]) is not mad. (Whatever he communicates is the truth.)
t2: Your companion is not possessed;
t3: And your comrade is not mad.

ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
en: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon,
t1: And he has indeed seen (the absolute beauty of the Lord of the Throne) on the effulgent horizon (of the realm of Divinity).*
t2: he truly saw him on the clear horizon;
t3: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.

ar: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
en: and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen.
t1: And he (the glorious Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him]) is not at all miserly in (disclosing) the unseen. (The Lord of the Throne has not left for him any deficiency.)
t2: he is not niggardly of the Unseen.
t3: And he is not avid of the Unseen.

ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
en: And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil.
t1: Nor is that (Qur’an) the utterance of any accursed Satan.
t2: And it is not the word of an accursed Satan;
t3: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.

ar: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
en: So what ˹other˺ path would you take?
t1: Then, (O you doomed,) where are you going (disregarding such a valuable treasure)?
t2: where then are you going?
t3: Whither then go ye ?

ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—
t1: This (Qur’an) is but admonition (revealed) for all the worlds.
t2: It is naught but a Reminder unto all beings,
t3: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,

ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
en: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way.
t1: Every one of you who aspires to tread the straight path (can take guidance from this source spring).
t2: for whosoever of you who would go straight;
t3: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.

ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds.
t1: And you can aspire only to what Allah intends, Who is the Sustainer of all the worlds.
t2: but will you shall not, unless God wills, the Lord of all Being.
t3: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.

ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
en: When the sky splits open,
t1: When (all) the heavenly spheres will be split apart,
t2: When heaven is split open,
t3: When the heaven is cleft asunder,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
en: and when the stars fall away,
t1: And when the planets will fall and scatter,
t2: when the stars are scattered,
t3: When the planets are dispersed,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
en: and when the seas burst forth,
t1: And when oceans (and rivers) will flood and overflow,
t2: when the seas swarm over,
t3: When the seas are poured forth,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
en: and when the graves spill out,
t1: And when graves will be overturned,
t2: when the tombs are overthrown,
t3: And the sepulchres are overturned,

ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
en: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind.
t1: Then everyone will come to know what actions he sent forward and what he left behind.
t2: then a soul shall know its works, the former and the latter.
t3: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
en: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous,
t1: O man! What has deluded you concerning your Gracious Lord,
t2: O Man! What deceived thee as to thy generous Lord
t3: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
en: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design,
t1: (The One) Who created you (from a fertiled ovum in the mother’s womb), then, (to structure your limbs at the fetal stage,) He shaped you aright, then brought about proportionate alteration in your constitution?
t2: who created thee and shaped thee and wrought thee in symmetry
t3: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee ?

ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
en: moulding you in whatever form He willed?
t1: He constituted you in whatever form He willed.
t2: and composed thee after what form He would?
t3: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.

ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
en: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment,
t1: That is the truth, (but) on the contrary, you deny the Day of Recompense,
t2: No indeed; but you cry lies to the Doom;
t3: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.

ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
en: while you are certainly observed by vigilant,
t1: Whereas there are guardian angels appointed over you,
t2: yet there are over you watchers
t3: Lo! there are above you guardians,

ar: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
en: honourable angels, recording ˹everything˺.
t1: (Who are) dignified, the scribes (writing the records of all your deeds).
t2: noble, writers
t3: Generous and recording,

ar: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
en: They know whatever you do.
t1: They know (all) those (actions) which you do.
t2: who know whatever you do.
t3: Who know (all) that ye do.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
en: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss,
t1: Indeed, the truly good will be in the Garden of Bliss.
t2: Surely the pious shall be in bliss,
t3: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.

ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
en: and the wicked will be in Hell,
t1: And surely, the evildoers will be in the (Blazing Fire of) Hell.
t2: and the libertines shall be in a fiery furnace
t3: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;

ar: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
en: burning in it on Judgment Day,
t1: They will enter it on the Day of Rising,
t2: roasting therein on the Day of Doom,
t3: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,

ar: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
en: and they will have no escape from it.
t1: And will never be able to absent themselves from it (Hell).
t2: nor shall they ever be absent from it.
t3: And will not be absent thence.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
en: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is?
t1: And what have you made out what the Day of Recompense is?
t2: And what shall teach thee what is the Day of Doom?
t3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
en: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is?
t1: So what have you learnt about what the Day of Recompense is?
t2: Again, what shall teach thee what is the Day of Doom?
t3: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
en: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺.
t1: It is the Day when no soul will own anything for any other soul, and the command on that Day will be entirely Allah’s.
t2: A day when no soul shall possess aught to succour another soul; that day the Command shall belong unto God.
t3: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah’s.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
en: Woe to the defrauders!
t1: Woe to those who give less in measure or weight!
t2: Woe to the stinters who,
t3: Woe unto the defrauders:

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
en: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people,
t1: When (they) take by measure from others, they take (from them) full.
t2: when they measure against the people, take full measure
t3: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,

ar: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
en: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers.
t1: And when they (themselves) give by measure or weigh to others, they give them less.
t2: but, when they measure for them or weigh for them, do skimp.
t3: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.

ar: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
en: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected
t1: Do they not believe that they will be raised up (again after death),
t2: Do those not think that they shall be raised up
t3: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again

ar: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
en: for a tremendous Day—
t1: For a Terrible Day,
t2: unto a mighty day
t3: Unto an Awful Day,

ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds?
t1: The Day when all mankind will stand before the Lord of all the worlds?
t2: a day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of all Being?
t3: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds ?

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
en: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjin ˹in the depths of Hell˺—
t1: It is true that the record of the evildoers is kept in Sijjin (the ante-chamber of Hell).
t2: No indeed; the Book of the libertines is in Sijjin;
t3: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
en: and what will make you realize what Sijjin is?—
t1: And what do you know what Sijjin is?
t2: and what shall teach thee what is Sijjin?
t3: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -

ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
en: a fate ˹already˺ sealed.
t1: It is an inscribed book (set down in the large ante-chamber of the prison of Hell, with the names and evil deeds of every inmate of Hell registered in it).
t2: A book inscribed.
t3: A written record.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: Woe on that Day to the deniers—
t1: Woe to the deniers on that Day,
t2: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies,
t3: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
en: those who deny Judgment Day!
t1: Those who deny the Day of Recompense!
t2: who cry lies to the Day of Doom;
t3: Those who deny the Day of Judgment

ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
en: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor.
t1: And no one else denies it except every defiant and sinner.
t2: and none cries lies to it but every guilty aggressor.
t3: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,

ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”
t1: When Our Revelations are read out to him, he says (or thinks) that (they are) tales of the ancients.
t2: When our signs are recited to him, he says, ’Fairy-tales of the ancients!’
t3: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.

ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
en: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit!
t1: That is not at all (the case); rather (the fact is that the evil deeds) which they earned have rusted their hearts. (The Revelations, therefore, do not move their hearts.)
t2: No indeed; but that they were earning has rusted upon their hearts.
t3: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
en: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day.
t1: The truth is that they will be screened off (to deprive them of) the sight of their Lord.
t2: No indeed; but upon that day they shall be veiled from their Lord,
t3: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell,
t1: Then they will be cast into Hell.
t2: then they shall roast in Hell.
t3: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,

ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
en: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”
t1: Then it will be said to them: ‘This is (the punishment of Hell) which you used to belie.’
t2: Then it shall be said to them, ’This is that you cried lies to.’
t3: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
en: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—
t1: This is (also) true that the record of the truly pious is for sure maintained in ‘Illiyyin (the ante-chamber of Paradise).
t2: No indeed; the book of the pious is in Illiyun;
t3: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in ’Illiyin -

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
en: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—
t1: And what do you know what ‘Illiyyin is?
t2: and what shall teach thee what is Illiyun?
t3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what ’Illiyin is! -

ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
en: a fate ˹already˺ sealed,
t1: It is an inscribed book (set down in the large ante-chamber of a lofty mansion of Paradise with the names and pious deeds of those who will be allocated superior stations in Paradise).
t2: A book inscribed,
t3: A written record,

ar: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
en: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺.
t1: The angels closest (to Allah) remain present here.
t2: witnessed by those brought nigh.
t3: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
en: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss,
t1: Indeed, the truly pious, (joyful and glad,) will be in blissful Paradise,
t2: Surely the pious shall be in bliss,
t3: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,

ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
en: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around.
t1: Reclining on couches, enjoying the wonderful sights.
t2: upon couches gazing;
t3: On couches, gazing,

ar: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
en: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight.
t1: You will find on their faces the glow and freshness of bliss and delight.
t2: thou knowest in their faces the radiancy of bliss
t3: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.

ar: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
en: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine,
t1: They shall be served with securely sealed delicious and holy beverage.
t2: as they are given to drink of a wine sealed
t3: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,

ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
en: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺.
t1: Its seal will be musk. And (it is this beverage which) all aspirants should hastily strive and compete to acquire. (Some seek the drink of bliss whilst others long for the drink of nearness, and still others yearn for the drink of countenance—all will be served according to their respective tastes).
t2: whose seal is musk -- so after that let the strivers strive --
t3: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -

ar: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
en: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnim—
t1: And this (beverage of Paradise) will be mixed with the water of Tasnim.
t2: and whose mixture is Tasnim,
t3: And mixed with water of Tasnim,

ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
en: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink.
t1: (This Tasnim) is a fountain at which only those drawn close will drink.
t2: a fountain at which do drink those brought nigh.
t3: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
en: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers,
t1: Surely (in the worldly life), the evildoers used to ridicule the believers,
t2: Behold, the sinners were laughing at the believers,
t3: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,

ar: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
en: wink to one another whenever they passed by,
t1: And winked at one another when they passed by them.
t2: when them passed them by winking at one another,
t3: And wink one to another when they passed them;

ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
en: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people.
t1: And when they went back to their families, they used to exult over the believers (by comparing the believers’ destitution and their own affluence) and returned speaking of them with jests.
t2: and when they returned to their people they returned blithely,
t3: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;

ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
en: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
t1: And when they (the arrogant people) saw these (the indigent believers), they used to say: ‘They have gone astray,’ (i.e., they have lost the world whilst the Hereafter is nothing but fiction.)
t2: and when they saw them they said, ’Lo, these men are astray!’
t3: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.

ar: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
en: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers.
t1: Yet they had not been sent to watch over their (state of affairs).
t2: Yet they were not sent as watchers over them.
t3: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.

ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
en: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers,
t1: So (see) Today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers.
t2: So today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers,
t3: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,

ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
en: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on.
t1: Reclining on ornamented couches, they are viewing the sight (comparing their own prosperity and the disbelievers’ impoverishment).
t2: upon couches gazing.
t3: On high couches, gazing.

ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
en: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
t1: So, have the disbelievers been rewarded in full for (the mockery), which they used to inflict upon (the believers)?
t2: Have the unbelievers been rewarded what they were doing?
t3: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do ?

ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
en: When the sky bursts open,
t1: When (all) the heavenly bodies will split asunder,
t2: When heaven is rent asunder
t3: When the heaven is split asunder

ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
en: obeying its Lord as it must,
t1: And obey the command of their Lord (with regard to the catastrophic split) and (it is this implementation of the command) that they are bound to do,
t2: and gives ear to its Lord, and is fitly disposed;
t3: And attentive to her Lord in fear,

ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
en: and when the earth is flattened out,
t1: And when the earth will be flattened out (after it is broken into dust particles),
t2: when earth is stretched out
t3: And when the earth is spread out

ar: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
en: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty,
t1: And it will cast out all that is inside it and become empty,
t2: and casts forth what is in it, and voids itself,
t3: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty

ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
en: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺.
t1: And (it) will (also) obey the command of its Lord (with regard to the catastrophic split) and (it is this obedience) which it is worthy of.
t2: and gives ear to its Lord, and is fitly disposed!
t3: And attentive to her Lord in fear!

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
en: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences.
t1: O man! You sustain rigours to reach your Lord. Ultimately, you will meet Him.
t2: O Man! Thou art labouring unto thy Lord laboriously, and thou shalt encounter Him.
t3: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).

ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
en: As for those who are given their record in their right hand,
t1: So as for him who will be given his record in his right hand,
t2: Then as for him who is given his book in his right hand,
t3: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand

ar: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
en: they will have an easy reckoning,
t1: He will soon be given an easy reckoning,
t2: he shall surely receive an easy reckoning
t3: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

ar: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
en: and will return to their people joyfully.
t1: And will return to his family rejoicing.
t2: and he will return to his family joyfully.
t3: And will return unto his folk in joy.

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
en: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs,
t1: And as for him who will be given his record behind his back,
t2: But as for him who is given his book behind his back,
t3: But whoso is given his account behind his back,

ar: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
en: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction,
t1: He will soon cry out for death.
t2: he shall call for destruction
t3: He surely will invoke destruction

ar: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
en: and will burn in the blazing Fire.
t1: And he will enter the Blazing Fire of Hell.
t2: and he shall roast at a Blaze.
t3: And be thrown to scorching fire.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
en: For they used to be prideful among their people,
t1: Surely, he lived joyfully with his family (in the world).
t2: He once lived among his family joyfully;
t3: He verily lived joyous with his folk,

ar: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
en: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺.
t1: No doubt, he thought he would never return (to his Lord) for reckoning.
t2: he surely thought he would never revert.
t3: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).

ar: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
en: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them.
t1: Why not! Indeed, his Lord is ever watching him.
t2: Yes indeed; his Lord had sight of him.
t3: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!

ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
en: So, I do swear by the twilight!
t1: So I swear by the evening glow (i.e., the twilight or its later glare),
t2: No! I swear by the twilight
t3: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
en: And by the night and whatever it envelops!
t1: And by the night and all that it envelops (under its embrace),
t2: and the night and what it envelops
t3: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,

ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
en: And by the moon when it waxes full!
t1: And the moon when it appears full,
t2: and the moon when it is at the full,
t3: And by the moon when she is at the full,

ar: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
en: You will certainly pass from one state to another.
t1: You will assuredly ride along stage by stage.
t2: you shall surely ride stage after stage.
t3: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.

ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe,
t1: So, what is the matter with them that (even after witnessing the truth of the forecast of the Qur’an), they do not believe?
t2: Then what ails them, that they believe not,
t3: What aileth them, then, that they believe not

ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
en: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺?
t1: And when the Qur’an is recited to them, they do not fall down prostrate (before Allah)?
t2: and when the Koran is recited to them they do not bow?
t3: And, when the Qur’an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah) ?

ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
en: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial.
t1: Instead, the disbelievers (further) deny it.
t2: Nay, but the unbelievers are crying lies,
t3: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;

ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
en: But Allah knows best whatever they hide.
t1: And Allah knows best (the contention and disbelief) which they are piling.
t2: and God knows very well what they are secreting.
t3: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.

ar: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
en: So give them good news of a painful punishment.
t1: So give them the news of a painful punishment.
t2: So give them good tidings of a painful chastisement,
t3: So give them tidings of a painful doom,

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
en: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward.
t1: But those who believe and do pious deeds, for them is an unending (i.e., everlasting) reward.
t2: except those that believe, and do righteous deeds -- theirs shall be a wage unfailing.
t3: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
en: By the sky full of constellations,
t1: By the heaven with its constellations,
t2: By heaven of the constellations,
t3: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,

ar: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
en: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺,
t1: And by the Promised Day,
t2: by the promised day,
t3: And by the Promised Day.

ar: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
en: and the witness and what is witnessed!
t1: And by the One Who will be Present (that Day) and by what will be brought to the presence,
t2: by the witness and the witnessed,
t3: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,

ar: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
en: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—
t1: The (people) of the trenches were slain,
t2: slain were the Men of the Pit,
t3: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

ar: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
en: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—
t1: (The people of) the fierce fire which was (fed) with abundant fuel,
t2: the fire abounding in fuel,
t3: Of the fuel-fed fire,

ar: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
en: when they sat around it,
t1: When they sat beside it,
t2: when they were seated over it
t3: When they sat by it,

ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
en: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers,
t1: And they are themselves witnesses to all they did to the believers (i.e., casting them into the fire and burning them).
t2: and were themselves witnesses of what they did with the believers.
t3: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.

ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
en: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—
t1: And nothing (of the believers) was annoying them except that they had believed in Allah the Almighty, All-Praiseworthy,
t2: They took revenge on them only because they believed in the All-mighty, the Al-laudable,
t3: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,

ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
en: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things.
t1: To Whom the (entire) kingdom of the heavens and the earth belongs and Allah is Witness over everything.
t2: God to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and God is Witness over everything.
t3: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
en: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning.
t1: Indeed, those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not (even) repent, for them is the punishment of Hell, and for them is (especially) the torment of burning in the Fire.
t2: Those who persecute the believers, men and women, and then have not repented, there awaits them the chastisement of Gehenna, and there awaits them the chastisement of the burning.
t3: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
en: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph.
t1: And indeed, those who believe and keep doing pious deeds, for them are Gardens with streams flowing under them. This is the great victory.
t2: Those who believe, and do righteous deeds, for them await gardens underneath which rivers flow; that is the great triumph.
t3: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.

ar: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
en: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe.
t1: Surely, the seizure of your Lord is most severe.
t2: Surely thy Lord’s assault is terrible.
t3: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
en: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺.
t1: Verily, He creates the first time, and He is the One Who will bring to life the second time.
t2: Surely it is He who originates, and brings again,
t3: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
en: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—
t1: And He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving,
t2: and He is the All-forgiving, the All-loving,
t3: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,

ar: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
en: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious,
t1: The Lord of the Throne (controlling the whole universe) and the Lord of Honour.
t2: Lord of the Throne, the All-glorious,
t3: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

ar: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
en: Doer of whatever He wills.
t1: He (thoroughly) executes whatever He intends.
t2: Performer of what He desires.
t3: Doer of what He will.

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
en: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—
t1: Has the news of the troops reached you?
t2: Hast thou received the story of the hosts,
t3: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts

ar: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
en: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd?
t1: The troops of Pharaoh and Thamud?
t2: Pharaoh and Thamood?
t3: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud ?

ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
en: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial.
t1: But such disbelievers (persistently strive to) belie (the truth).
t2: Nay, but the unbelievers still cry lies,
t3: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial

ar: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
en: But Allah encompasses them from all sides.
t1: And Allah encompasses (them) from all sides.
t2: and God is behind them, encompassing.
t3: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.

ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
en: In fact, this is a glorious Quran,
t1: It is indeed the Glorious Qur’an,
t2: Nay, but it is a glorious Koran,
t3: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur’an.

ar: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
en: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet.
t1: (Inscribed) in the very Well-guarded Tablet (al-Lawh al-Mahfuz).
t2: in a guarded tablet.
t3: On a guarded tablet.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
en: By the heaven and the nightly star!
t1: By the (endless expanse and infinite space of) heaven and the Nightly (discernable) Visitant.
t2: By heaven and the night-star!
t3: By the heaven and the Morning Star

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
en: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is?
t1: And what do you know what the Nightly (discernable) Visitant is?
t2: And what shall teach thee what is the night-star?
t3: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!

ar: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
en: ˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness.
t1: (It implies) every heavenly body (be it a star, a planet, or any of the heavenly spheres) which shines and brightens (the space).*
t2: The piercing star!
t3: - The piercing Star!

ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
en: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺.
t1: There is no human soul but with a protector (appointed) over it.
t2: Over every soul there is a watcher.
t3: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.

ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
en: Let people then consider what they were created from!
t1: So man should ponder (and find out) from what substance he has been created.
t2: So let man consider of what he was created;
t3: So let man consider from what he is created.

ar: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
en: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid,
t1: He has been created from the ejaculated fluid (i.e., virile and motile sperm).
t2: he was created of gushing water
t3: He is created from a gushing fluid

ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
en: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage.
t1: That proceeds from the middle of the sacrum (and pelvic girdle) and is ejected.
t2: issuing between the loins and the breast-bones.
t3: That issued from between the loins and ribs.

ar: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
en: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺
t1: Indeed, He has the power to bring it (life) back,
t2: Surely He is able to bring him back
t3: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)

ar: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
en: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed.
t1: The Day when all secrets will be disclosed.
t2: upon the day when the secrets are tried,
t3: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.

ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
en: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper.
t1: Then man will have neither any strength (himself) nor any helper.
t2: and he shall have no strength, no helper.
t3: Then will he have no might nor any helper.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
en: By the sky with its recurring cycles,
t1: By the heavenly universe which will regress to its primitive state,
t2: By heaven of the returning rain,
t3: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
en: and the earth with its sprouting plants!
t1: And by the earth which will split asunder (and change into dust particles),
t2: by earth splitting with verdure,
t3: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)

ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
en: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word,
t1: This is indeed a decisive (i.e., absolute) commandment.
t2: surely it is a decisive word;
t3: Lo! this (Qur’an) is a conclusive word,

ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
en: and is not to be taken lightly.
t1: And it is no joke!
t2: it is no merriment.
t3: It is no pleasantry.

ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
en: They are certainly devising ˹evil˺ plans,
t1: Indeed, they (the disbelievers) are hatching plots.
t2: They are devising guile,
t3: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)

ar: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
en: but I too am planning.
t1: And I am designing My own strategy.
t2: and I am devising guile.
t3: And I plot a plot (against them).

ar: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
en: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while.
t1: So give the disbelievers a respite (for a while, not much); let them relax a little (more).
t2: So respite the unbelievers; delay with them awhile.
t3: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.

ar: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
en: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,
t1: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,
t2: Magnify the Name of thy Lord the Most High
t3: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
en: Who created and ˹perfectly˺ fashioned ˹all˺,
t1: He Who has created (everything in the universe) and then (fulfilling all requisites) equipoised it to its exact proportion,
t2: who created and shaped,
t3: Who createth, then disposeth;

ar: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
en: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly,
t1: And He Who has determined law, and guided (it to its) way (of sustaining and functioning according to its respective system),
t2: who determined and guided,
t3: Who measureth, then guideth;

ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
en: and Who brings forth ˹green˺ pasture,
t1: And He Who has brought forth green pasture (from the earth),
t2: who brought forth the pasturage
t3: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,

ar: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
en: then reduces it to withered chaff.
t1: And then made it blackened stubble.
t2: then made it a blackening wrack.
t3: Then turneth it to russet stubble.

ar: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
en: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O  Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺,
t1: (O Esteemed Beloved!) We shall teach you (in a way) that nothing will you (ever) forget,
t2: We shall make thee recite, to forget not
t3: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget

ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
en: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden.
t1: Except what Allah wills. Indeed, He knows all, the manifest as well as the hidden (i.e., open to human perception as well as veiled from it, and the audible and the inaudible).
t2: save what God wills; surely He knows what is spoken aloud and what is hidden.
t3: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;

ar: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
en: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease.
t1: And We shall (also) facilitate you (to put into practice this) easy (law).
t2: We shall ease thee unto the Easing.
t3: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.

ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
en: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺.
t1: So keep admonishing, provided admonition benefits (the listeners).
t2: Therefore remind, if the Reminder profits,
t3: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.

ar: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
en: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺.
t1: But only he who fears (Allah) will accept the admonition.
t2: and he who fears shall remember,
t3: He will heed who feareth,

ar: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
en: But it will be shunned by the most wretched,
t1: And the wretched one will avoid and evade it,
t2: but the most wretched shall flout it,
t3: But the most hapless will flout it,

ar: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
en: who will burn in the greatest Fire,
t1: He who will enter the greatest Fire (on the Day of Judgment).
t2: even he who shall roast in the Great Fire,
t3: He who will be flung to the great Fire

ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
en: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die.
t1: Then he will neither die nor live in it.
t2: then he shall neither die therein, nor live.
t3: Wherein he will neither die nor live.

ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
en: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves,
t1: Indeed, only he who is purified (from the afflictions of his ill-commanding self and pollution of sins) will triumph,
t2: Prosperous is he who has cleansed himself,
t3: He is successful who groweth,

ar: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
en: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray.
t1: And the one who remembers the Name of his Lord and offers Prayers (regularly and abundantly).
t2: and mentions the Name of his Lord, and prays.
t3: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,

ar: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
en: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world,
t1: Yet you go for the (pleasures of) the worldly life (instead of turning towards Allah),
t2: Nay, but you prefer the present life;
t3: But ye prefer the life of the world

ar: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
en: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting.
t1: Whereas (the comfort and pleasure of) the Hereafter is preferable and everlasting.
t2: and the world to come is better, and more enduring.
t3: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
en: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—
t1: Indeed, this (enlightenment) is (also contained) in earlier scriptures,
t2: Surely this is in the ancient scrolls,
t3: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.

ar: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
en: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
t1: The scriptures of Ibrahim (Abraham) and Musa (Moses).
t2: the scrolls of Abraham and Moses.
t3: The Books of Abraham and Moses.

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
en: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺?
t1: Has the news of the Calamity overwhelming (everything) reached you?
t2: Hast thou received the story of the Enveloper?
t3: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming ?

ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
en: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast,
t1: Many faces on that Day will be humiliated and degraded,
t2: Faces on that day humbled,
t3: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,

ar: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
en: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted,
t1: (Forgetting Allah,) toiling (for worldly gains), sustaining (strenuous) rigours (for a fleeting luxury),
t2: labouring, toilworn,
t3: Toiling, weary,

ar: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
en: burning in a scorching Fire,
t1: Will plunge into the Blazing Fire.
t2: roasting at a scorching fire,
t3: Scorched by burning fire,

ar: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
en: left to drink from a scalding spring.
t1: (They will be) offered to drink (water) from a boiling spring.
t2: watered at a boiling fountain,
t3: Drinking from a boiling spring,

ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
en: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub,
t1: They will have no food except thorny and dry venomous herbage.
t2: no food for them but cactus thorn
t3: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit

ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
en: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger.
t1: (This food) will neither nourish nor gratify hunger.
t2: unfattening, unappeasing hunger.
t3: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.

ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
en: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss,
t1: (On the contrary) that Day a number of faces will be (pleasing to the eye,) glowing with joy and freshness,
t2: Faces on that day jocund,
t3: In that day other faces will be calm,

ar: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
en: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving,
t1: Delighted and rejoicing over their (righteous) travail,
t2: with their striving well-pleased,
t3: Glad for their effort past,

ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
en: in an elevated Garden,
t1: (Abiding) in a magnificent Paradise,
t2: in a sublime Garden,
t3: In a high Garden

ar: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
en: where no idle talk will be heard.
t1: Where they will not hear anything absurd (as the disbelievers used to say to them in the world).
t2: hearing there no babble;
t3: Where they hear no idle speech,

ar: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
en: In it will be a running spring,
t1: In it there will be flowing springs,
t2: therein a running fountain,
t3: Wherein is a gushing spring,

ar: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
en: along with thrones raised high,
t1: And raised-up couches (laid),
t2: therein uplifted couches
t3: Wherein are couches raised

ar: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
en: and cups set at hand,
t1: And goblets (decently) set in place,
t2: and goblets set forth
t3: And goblets set at hand

ar: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
en: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up,
t1: And silken cushions orderly lined up,
t2: and cushions arrayed
t3: And cushions ranged

ar: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
en: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out.
t1: And soft and refined carpets and rugs (richly) spread.
t2: and carpets outspread.
t3: And silken carpets spread.

ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
en: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created;
t1: (The disbelievers wonder how all that would be arranged in Paradise. So) do they not see how the camel has been created (in an unusual form)?
t2: What, do they not consider how the camel was created,
t3: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created ?

ar: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
en: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺;
t1: And (do they not observe) how the heaven is raised so high (with its vast expanse)?
t2: how heaven was lifted up,
t3: And the heaven, how it is raised ?

ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
en: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up;
t1: And (do they not see) how the mountains have been created (raised out of the earth)?
t2: how the mountains were hoisted,
t3: And the hills, how they are set up ?

ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
en: and the earth—how it was levelled out?
t1: (Nor do they consider) how the earth has been spread out (besides its round shape)?
t2: how the earth was outstretched?
t3: And the earth, how it is spread ?

ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
en: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O  Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind.
t1: So, continuously admonish them, for you are but an admonisher,
t2: Then remind them! Thou art only a reminder;
t3: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,

ar: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
en: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺.
t1: You are not imposed upon them (as) an oppressor and persecutor.
t2: thou art not charged to oversee them.
t3: Thou art not at all a warder over them.

ar: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
en: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief,
t1: But anyone who turns away and becomes a disbeliever,
t2: But he who turns his back, and disbelieves,
t3: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,

ar: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
en: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment.
t1: Allah will torment him with the greatest punishment.
t2: God shall chastise him with the greatest chastisement.
t3: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.

ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
en: Surely to Us is their return,
t1: Indeed, it is to Us that they will return (in the end);
t2: Truly, to Us is their return;
t3: Lo! unto Us is their return

ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
en: then surely with Us is their reckoning.
t1: Then, surely, it is Our concern to call them to account.
t2: then upon Us shall rest their reckoning.
t3: And Ours their reckoning.

ar: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
en: By the dawn,
t1: By the emerging dawn (that dispels the darkness of night),*
t2: By the dawn
t3: By the Dawn

ar: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
en: and the ten nights,
t1: And by the ten (blessed) nights,*
t2: and ten nights,
t3: And ten nights,

ar: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
en: and the even and the odd,
t1: And by the even and the odd,*
t2: by the even and the odd,
t3: And the Even and the Odd,

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
en: and the night when it passes!
t1: And by the night as it departs. (Every night or particularly the night of Muzdalifa or the night of Qadr.)
t2: by the night when it journeys on!
t3: And the night when it departeth,

ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
en: Is all this ˹not˺ a sufficient oath for those who have sense?
t1: Surely, in that is a mighty oath for the wise.
t2: Is there in that an oath for a mindful man?
t3: There surely is an oath for thinking man.

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
en: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—
t1: Have you not seen how your Lord treated (the people of ‘Ad)?
t2: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with Ad,
t3: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A’ad,

ar: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
en: ˹the people˺ of Iram—with ˹their˺ great stature,
t1: (They) were (the people) of Iram (and) were (tall like) lofty columns (possessing towering castles),
t2: Iram of the pillars,
t3: With many-columned Iram,

ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
en: unmatched in any other land;
t1: The like of which has not (at all) been created in the countries (of the world).
t2: the like of which was never created in the land,
t3: The like of which was not created in the lands;

ar: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
en: and Thamûd who carved ˹their homes into˺ the rocks in the ˹Stone˺ Valley;
t1: And (what treatment was given to) Thamud, who carved rocks (and constructed hundreds of cities) in the (Qura) valley?
t2: and Thamood, who hollowed the rocks in the valley,
t3: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;

ar: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
en: and the Pharaoh of mighty structures?
t1: And (how was) Pharaoh (dealt with), who wielded large armies (and used to punish victims with stakes)?
t2: and Pharaoh, he of the tent-pegs,
t3: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
en: They all transgressed throughout the land,
t1: (They were) the people who perpetrated tyranny in their (respective) countries,
t2: who all were insolent in the land
t3: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,

ar: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
en: spreading much corruption there.
t1: And spread great mischief and corruption there.
t2: and worked much corruption therein?
t3: And multiplied iniquity therein ?

ar: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
en: So your Lord unleashed on them a scourge of punishment.
t1: Then your Lord unleashed the scourge of punishment on them.
t2: Thy Lord unloosed on them a scourge of chastisement;
t3: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
en: ˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant.
t1: Indeed, your Lord is Ever-Watchful (over the tyrant transgressors).
t2: surely thy Lord is ever on the watch.
t3: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.

ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
en: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”
t1: But as for man, when his Lord tests him (by providing him pleasure and comfort) and honours him and gives him bounties, he says: ‘My Lord has honoured me.’
t2: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him, and honours him, and blesses him, then he says, ’My Lord has honoured me.’
t3: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.

ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
en: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”
t1: But when He tries him (by afflicting him with pain and discomfort) and limits his means of sustenance, he says: ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’
t2: But when he tries him and stints for him his provision, then he says, ’My Lord has despised me.’
t3: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.

ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
en: Absolutely not! In fact, you are not ˹even˺ gracious to the orphan,
t1: No indeed! But (the truth is that after you gain honour and good fortune), you do not give honour and care to orphans.
t2: No indeed; but you honour not the orphan,
t3: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan

ar: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
en: nor do you urge one another to feed the poor.
t1: Nor do you inspire one another (in society) to promote the feeding of the destitute (i.e., the poor and the needy).
t2: and you urge not the feeding of the needy,
t3: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.

ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
en: And you devour ˹others’˺ inheritance greedily,
t1: And you lay hand on the inherited wealth and devour it (yourselves and do not pay the poverty-stricken their due).
t2: and you devour the inheritance greedily,
t3: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.

ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
en: and love wealth fervently.
t1: And you love wealth and riches inordinately.
t2: and you love wealth with an ardent love
t3: And love wealth with abounding love.

ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
en: Enough! When the earth is entirely crushed over and over,
t1: Assuredly, when the earth will be cleft asunder and crushed to dust particles,
t2: No indeed! When the earth is ground to powder,
t3: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,

ar: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
en: and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank,
t1: And your Lord will unveil His Light and the angels will appear (before His presence) rank upon rank,
t2: and thy Lord comes, and the angels rank on rank,
t3: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,

ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
en: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then?
t1: And that Day, Hell will be brought forth. On that Day man will come to understand, but how will admonition (avail him then)?
t2: and Gehenna is brought out, upon that day man will remember; and how shall the Reminder be for him?
t3: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him) ?

ar: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
en: They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”
t1: He will say: ‘Would that I had sent (something) ahead of me for my (real) life (which would have helped me Today)!’
t2: He shall say, ’O would that I had forwarded for my life!’
t3: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!

ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
en: On that Day He will punish ˹them˺ severely, like no other,
t1: But that Day no one will be able to torment like His torment,
t2: Upon that day none shall chastise as He chastises,
t3: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!

ar: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
en: and bind ˹them˺ tightly, like no other.
t1: And no one will be able to bind as He binds.
t2: none shall bind as He binds.
t3: None bindeth as He then will bind.

ar: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
en: ˹Allah will say to the righteous,˺ “O tranquil soul!
t1: O contented (pleased) self!
t2: ’O soul at peace,
t3: But ah! thou soul at peace!

ar: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
en: Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺.
t1: Return to your Lord in such a state that you are both the aspirant to, and the aspired of, His pleasure (i.e., you seek His pleasure and He seeks yours).
t2: return unto thy Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing!
t3: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!

ar: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
en: So join My servants,
t1: So join My (perfect) servants.
t2: Enter thou among My servants!
t3: Enter thou among My bondmen!

ar: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
en: and enter My Paradise.”
t1: And enter My Paradise (of nearness and sight).
t2: Enter thou My Paradise!’
t3: Enter thou My Garden!

ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
en: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—
t1: I swear by this city (Mecca),
t2: No! I swear by this land,
t3: Nay, I swear by this city -

ar: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
en: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—
t1: (O My Esteemed Beloved,) because you are residing in it.*
t2: and thou art a lodger in this land;
t3: And thou art an indweller of this city -

ar: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
en: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child!
t1: (O My Esteemed Beloved!) By (your) father (Adam or Ibrahim [Abraham]) and by those who are born,*
t2: by the begetter, and that he begot,
t3: And the begetter and that which he begat,

ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
en: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle.
t1: Indeed, We have created man (ever suffering) in rigours.
t2: indeed, We created man in trouble.
t3: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
en: Do they think that no one has power over them,
t1: Does he think that no one can ever overpower him?
t2: What, does he think none has power over him,
t3: Thinketh he that none hath power over him ?

ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
en: boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”?
t1: (Boasting,) he says: ‘I have spent heaps of wealth.’
t2: saying, ’I have consumed wealth abundant’?
t3: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:

ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
en: Do they think that no one sees them?
t1: Does he think that no one has seen him (making this extravagant spending)?
t2: What, does he think none has seen him?
t3: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him ?

ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
en: Have We not given them two eyes,
t1: Have We not made for him two eyes?
t2: Have We not appointed to him two eyes,
t3: Did We not assign unto him two eyes

ar: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
en: a tongue, and two lips;
t1: And (have We not given him) a tongue and two lips?
t2: and a tongue, and two lips,
t3: And a tongue and two lips,

ar: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
en: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺?
t1: And (have We also not) shown him the two highways (of good and evil)?
t2: and guided him on the two highways?
t3: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways ?

ar: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
en: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺!
t1: But he has not yet attempted the steep ascent (of the Din [Religion]) of truth and the practical life dedicated to good and piety).
t2: Yet he has not assaulted the steep;
t3: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
en: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is?
t1: And what have you thought of the steep ascent (of the rigours of the Din [Religion] of truth)?
t2: and what shall teach thee what is the steep?
t3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -

ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
en: It is to free a slave,
t1: It is freeing a neck (from slavery and subjugation),
t2: The freeing of a slave,
t3: (It is) to free a slave,

ar: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
en: or to give food in times of famine
t1: Or feeding on a day of scarcity (the poor and the needy during famine and scarcity i.e., striving to put an end to their sufferings and economic crises),
t2: or giving food upon a day of hunger
t3: And to feed in the day of hunger.

ar: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
en: to an orphaned relative
t1: The orphaned relative,
t2: to an orphan near of kin
t3: An orphan near of kin,

ar: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
en: or to a poor person in distress,
t1: Or the poverty-stricken destitute who is completely rundown (and homeless).
t2: or a needy man in misery;
t3: Or some poor wretch in misery,

ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
en: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion.
t1: (Provided this striving soul is) one of those who believe and advise one another patience and tolerance and urge one another for mutual affection and mercy.
t2: then that he become of those who believe and counsel each other to be steadfast, and counsel each other to be merciful.
t3: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
en: These are the people of the right.
t1: These are the people of the Right Hand (i.e., the privileged and the pardoned).
t2: Those are the Companions of the Right Hand.
t3: Their place will be on the right hand.

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
en: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left.
t1: And those who reject Our signs are the people of the Left Hand (the callous and the doomed).
t2: And those who disbelieve in Our signs, they are the Companions of the Left Hand;
t3: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.

ar: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
en: The Fire will be sealed over them.
t1: Fire will be enclosed upon them (covering from all sides).
t2: over them is a Fire covered down.
t3: Fire will be an awning over them.

ar: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
en: By the sun and its brightness,
t1: By the sun and by its brightness,
t2: By the sun and his morning brightness
t3: By the sun and his brightness,

ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
en: and the moon as it follows it,
t1: And by the moon when it follows the sun (i.e., reflects sunshine),
t2: and by the moon when she follows him,
t3: And the moon when she followeth him,

ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
en: and the day as it unveils it,
t1: And by the day when it displays the sun (i.e., brings it forth shining),
t2: and by the day when it displays him
t3: And the day when it revealeth him,

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
en: and the night as it conceals it!
t1: And by the night when it draws a veil over the sun (from one of the hemispheres of the earth),
t2: and by the night when it enshrouds him!
t3: And the night when it enshroudeth him,

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
en: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it,
t1: And by the heaven and by that (energy) which built it (with Allah’s permission in the form of a vast universe),
t2: By the heaven and That which built it
t3: And the heaven and Him Who built it,

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
en: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it!
t1: And by the earth and by that (force which, by Allah’s command,) pulled it (from the sun far) apart.
t2: and by the earth and That which extended it!
t3: And the earth and Him Who spread it,

ar: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
en: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it,
t1: And by the human soul and by the One Who provided it with an all-dimensional poise, proportion and perfection,
t2: By the soul, and That which shaped it
t3: And a soul and Him Who perfected it

ar: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
en: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it!
t1: Then He inspired it with (discrimination between) vice and virtue,
t2: and inspired it to lewdness and godfearing!
t3: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.

ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
en: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul,
t1: Indeed, the one who purifies his (ill-commanding) self (from all vain and vicious desires and cultivates in it virtue and piousness) succeeds,
t2: Prosperous is he who purifies it,
t3: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,

ar: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
en: and doomed is the one who corrupts it!
t1: But the one who corrupts himself (in sins and suppresses virtue) is doomed indeed.
t2: and failed has he who seduces it.
t3: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
en: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance,
t1: The people of Thamud rejected (their Messenger Salih) due to their rebellion.
t2: Thamood cried lies in their insolence
t3: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,

ar: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
en: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺.
t1: When the most wretched of them stood up,
t2: when the most wretched of them uprose,
t3: When the basest of them broke forth

ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
en: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”
t1: Allah’s Messenger said to them: ‘Guard (that) she-camel and (the time of) her taking water.’
t2: then the Messenger of God said to them, ’The She-camel of God; let her drink!’
t3: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
en: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground.
t1: But they rejected the Messenger and hamstrung (the she-camel). So because of their sin, their Lord sent down destruction on them, and levelled (them all in the torment devastating) the town.
t2: But they cried him lies, and hamstrung her, so their Lord crushed them for their sin, and leveled them:
t3: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).

ar: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
en: He has no fear of consequences.
t1: And Allah does not fear any repercussions of this (devastation).
t2: and He fears not the issue thereof.
t3: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
en: By the night when it covers,
t1: By the night when it covers up (and conceals everything in its darkness),
t2: By the night enshrouding
t3: By the night enshrouding

ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
en: and the day when it shines!
t1: And by the day when it brightens up,
t2: and the day in splendour
t3: And the day resplendent

ar: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
en: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female!
t1: And by that Being Who created male and female (in everything),
t2: and That which created the male and the female,
t3: And Him Who hath created male and female,

ar: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
en: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse.
t1: Indeed, your striving is different (and singular).
t2: surely your striving is to diverse ends.
t3: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).

ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
en: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺,
t1: So he who gives away (his wealth in the way of Allah) and commits himself to piousness,
t2: As for him who gives and is godfearing
t3: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

ar: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
en: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward,
t1: And affirms the good (the Din [Religion]) of truth and life after death through charity and Godwariness),
t2: and confirms the reward most fair,
t3: And believeth in goodness;

ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
en: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease.
t1: Soon We shall facilitate him in seeking (Allah’s pleasure) with ease.
t2: We shall surely ease him to the Easing.
t3: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
en: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺,
t1: But he who is miser and disregards (spending in the cause of Allah),
t2: But as for him who is a miser, and self-sufficient,
t3: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,

ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
en: and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward,
t1: And (in this way) denies the good (the Din [Religion]) of truth and afterlife),
t2: and cries lies to the reward most fair,
t3: And disbelieveth in goodness;

ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
en: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship.
t1: Soon shall We facilitate his landing into hardship (advancing towards torment, so that punishment becomes his rightful due).
t2: We shall surely ease him to the Hardship;
t3: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.

ar: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
en: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺.
t1: And his wealth will not help him any way when he falls into (the pit of) destruction.
t2: his wealth shall not avail him when he perishes.
t3: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.

ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
en: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance.
t1: Indeed, it is binding on Us to show you the path (of truth).
t2: Surely upon Us rests the guidance,
t3: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

ar: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
en: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next.
t1: And indeed, We are the Master of the Hereafter and the world.
t2: and to Us belong the Last and the First.
t3: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.

ar: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
en: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire,
t1: So I have warned you of the raging Fire (of Hell).
t2: Now I have warned you of a Fire that flames,
t3: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire

ar: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
en: in which none will burn except the most wretched—
t1: No one shall enter it but the most wretched,
t2: whereat none but the most wretched shall be roasted,
t3: Which only the most wretched must endure,

ar: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
en: who deny and turn away.
t1: He who gives lie to (the Din [Religion] of truth) and turns away (from obedience to the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him]).
t2: even he who cried lies, and turned away;
t3: He who denieth and turneth away.

ar: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
en: But the righteous will be spared from it—
t1: But the most pious one shall be saved from this (Fire),
t2: and from which the most godfearing shall be removed,
t3: Far removed from it will be the righteous

ar: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
en: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves,
t1: Who gives his wealth away (in the cause of Allah) to attain to purity (of his soul and assets),
t2: even he who gives his wealth. to purify himself
t3: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).

ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
en: not in return for someone’s favours,
t1: And who owes no favour to anyone that he is seeking to pay back.
t2: and confers no favour on any man for recompense,
t3: And none hath with him any favour for reward,

ar: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
en: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High.
t1: Rather (he spends) seeking the pleasure of his Lord, Most High.
t2: only seeking the Face of his Lord the Most High;
t3: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.

ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
en: They will certainly be pleased.
t1: And soon shall he be well-pleased (with Allah for His bestowal and Allah with him for his fidelity).
t2: and he shall surely be satisfied.
t3: He verily will be content.

ar: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
en: By the morning sunlight,
t1: By the growing morning bright (when the sun gains height and spreads its radiance), Or (O My Esteemed Beloved,) I swear by (your holy face glowing like) the growing morning bright, (the radiant face, whose effulgence has illumined the dark souls,) Or By (the growing sunshine of your Messengership rising like) the morning bright (whose radiance has replaced the darkness of ignorance with the enlightenment of guidance,)
t2: By the white forenoon
t3: By the morning hours

ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
en: and the night when it falls still!
t1: And by the night when it covers up, Or (O My Esteemed Beloved,) I swear by (your fragrant tresses spread like) the sprawling murky night (over your effulgent face and shoulders,) Or By (the veil of your essence that is keeping under layered covers your real nucleus of radiance like) the dark night when it envelops,
t2: and the brooding night!
t3: And by the night when it is stillest,

ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
en: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺.
t1: (Ever since He has chosen you,) your Lord has not forsaken you. Nor is He displeased (ever since He has taken you as His Beloved).
t2: Thy Lord has neither forsaken thee nor hates thee
t3: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,

ar: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
en: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one.
t1: Indeed, every following hour is a better (source of eminence and exaltation) for you than the preceding one.
t2: and the Last shall be better for thee than the First.
t3: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,

ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
en: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased.
t1: And soon your Lord shall bestow upon you (so much) that you will be well-pleased.
t2: Thy Lord shall give thee, and thou shalt be satisfied.
t3: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.

ar: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
en: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you?
t1: (O Beloved!) Did He not find you an orphan, and then provided you (a dignifying and graceful) abode? Or Did He not find you (compassionate) and provided (in your person) a shelter for orphans?
t2: Did He not find thee an orphan, and shelter thee?
t3: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee) ?

ar: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
