en: Did He not find you unguided then guided you?
t1: And He found you engrossed and lost in His love and then made you achieve the coveted objective. Or And He found in you (a leader) for a straying people so He provided them guidance (through you).
t2: Did He not find thee erring, and guide thee?
t3: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee) ?

ar: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
en: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs?
t1: And He found you seeking (closeness with your Lord), and (then blessed you with the pleasure of His sight and) freed you of every need (forever). Or And He found you compassionate and benevolent, then (through you) made the destitute non-liable.
t2: Did He not find thee needy, and suffice thee?
t3: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee) ?

ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
en: So do not oppress the orphan,
t1: So, never should you be strict with any orphan,
t2: As for the orphan, do not oppress him,
t3: Therefor the orphan oppress not,

ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
en: nor repulse the beggar.
t1: Nor reproach any beggar (seeking help at your door),
t2: and as for the beggar, scold him not;
t3: Therefor the beggar drive not away,

ar: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
en: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord.
t1: And proclaim (well) the bounties of your Lord.
t2: and as for thy Lord’s blessing, declare it.
t3: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.

ar: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
en: Have We not uplifted your heart for you ˹O Prophet˺,
t1: Have We not broadened your breast for you (for the light of knowledge, wisdom and spiritual gnosis)?
t2: Did We not expand thy breast for thee
t3: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,

ar: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
en: relieved you of the burden
t1: And We have taken off the load (of grief of the Umma [Community]) from you,
t2: and lift from thee thy burden,
t3: And eased thee of the burden

ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
en: which weighed so heavily on your back,
t1: (The load) which was growing heavier on your (holy) back.
t2: the burden that weighed down thy back?
t3: Which weighed down thy back;

ar: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
en: and elevated your renown for you?
t1: And We exalted for you your remembrance (by annexing it to Ours everywhere in the world and in the Hereafter).
t2: And exalted for you your esteem?
t3: And exalted thy fame ?

ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
en: So, surely with hardship comes ease.
t1: So surely ease (comes) with every hardship.
t2: So truly with hardship comes ease,
t3: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,

ar: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
en: Surely with ˹that˺ hardship comes ˹more˺ ease.
t1: Verily, with (this) hardship (too) there is ease.
t2: truly with hardship comes ease.’
t3: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;

ar: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
en: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺,
t1: So when you are free (from educating the Umma (Community), preaching the Din (Religion) and fighting, and fulfilling your responsibilities), then strive hard (in remembrance and the worship of your Lord),
t2: So when thou art empty, labour,
t3: So when thou art relieved, still toil

ar: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
en: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope.
t1: And turn to your Lord earnestly.
t2: and let thy Lord be thy Quest.
t3: And strive to please thy Lord.

ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
en: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺,
t1: By the fig and by the olive!
t2: By the fig and the olive
t3: By the fig and the olive,

ar: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
en: and Mount Sinai,
t1: And by (Mount) Tur of Sinai!
t2: and the Mount Sinai
t3: By Mount Sinai,

ar: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
en: and this secure city ˹of Mecca˺!
t1: And by this city of peace (Mecca)!
t2: and this land secure!
t3: And by this land made safe;

ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
en: Indeed, We created humans in the best form.
t1: Indeed, We have created man in the best constitution (equipoised in the finest proportion).
t2: We indeed created Man in the fairest stature
t3: Surely We created man of the best stature

ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
en: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺,
t1: Then We returned him to the lowest state of the low,
t2: then We restored him the lowest of the low --
t3: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
en: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward.
t1: Except for those who believe and do good works. For them is an unending (i.e., everlasting) reward.
t2: save those who believe, and do righteous deeds; they shall have a wage unfailing.
t3: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.

ar: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
en: Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment?
t1: Then who denies you after this regarding the Din (Religion or the Last Hour and reward and punishment)?
t2: What then shall cry thee lies as to the Doom?
t3: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment ?

ar: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
en: Is Allah not the most just of all judges?
t1: Is Allah not the Greatest of all the rulers?
t2: Is not God the justest of judges?
t3: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges ?

ar: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
en: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—
t1: (O Beloved!) Read (commencing) with the Name of Allah, Who has created (everything).
t2: Recite: In the Name of thy Lord who created,
t3: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,

ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
en: created humans from a clinging clot.
t1: He created man from a hanging mass (clinging) like a leech (to the mother’s womb).
t2: created Man of a blood-clot.
t3: Createth man from a clot.

ar: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
en: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,
t1: Read, and your Lord is Most Generous,
t2: Recite: And thy Lord is the Most Generous,
t3: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,

ar: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
en: Who taught by the pen—
t1: Who taught man (reading and writing) by the pen,
t2: who taught by the Pen,
t3: Who teacheth by the pen,

ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
en: taught humanity what they knew not.
t1: Who (besides that) taught man (all that) which he did not know. Or Who imparted to (the most eminent of) mankind (the chosen Prophet Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him] without using any pen) the whole knowledge that he was not aware of before.
t2: taught Man that he knew not.
t3: Teacheth man that which he knew not.

ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
en: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds
t1: (But) the fact is that (the disobedient) man rebels,
t2: No indeed; surely Man waxes insolent,
t3: Nay, but verily man is rebellious

ar: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
en: once they think they are self-sufficient.
t1: For the reason that (apparently) he finds himself self-sufficient (in the world).
t2: for he thinks himself self-sufficient.
t3: That he thinketh himself independent!

ar: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
en: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺.
t1: Surely, (every man) has to return to your Lord.
t2: Surely unto thy Lord is the Returning.
t3: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
en: Have you seen the man who prevents
t1: Have you seen him who prevents,
t2: What thinkest thou? He who forbids
t3: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth

ar: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
en: a servant ˹of Ours˺ from praying?
t1: The servant (of Allah) when he prays? Or The (beloved and the exalted) servant of Allah (Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him]) when he offers Prayers.
t2: a servant when he prays --
t3: A slave when he prayeth ?

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
en: What if this ˹servant˺ is ˹rightly˺ guided,
t1: Well, imagine! If he had been rightly guided;
t2: What thinkest thou? If he were upon guidance
t3: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)

ar: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
en: or encourages righteousness?
t1: Or if he had commanded (the people) to be pious (how beneficial it would have been)!
t2: or bade to godfearing --
t3: Or enjoineth piety ?

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
en: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away?
t1: But see now when he has rejected (the true Din [Religion]) and has turned away (from you, what torment is he going to face?)
t2: What thinkest thou? If he cries lies, and turns away -
t3: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah’s guidance) and is froward ?

ar: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
en: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺?
t1: Does he not know that Allah monitors (minutely all his conduct)?
t2: Did he not know that God sees?
t3: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth ?

ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
en: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—
t1: Beware! If he does not desist (from the denigration of the Holy Prophet [blessings and peace be upon him] and antagonism against the true Din [Religion]), We shall certainly grab his forehead and drag him by the forelock,
t2: No indeed; surely, if he gives not over, We shall seize him by the forelock,
t3: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -

ar: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
en: a lying, sinful forelock.
t1: His lying (and) sinful forehead!
t2: a lying, sinful forelock.
t3: The lying, sinful forelock -

ar: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
en: So let him call his associates.
t1: Then let him call his companions (for help).
t2: So let him call on his concourse!
t3: Then let him call upon his henchmen!

ar: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
en: We will call the wardens of Hell.
t1: We too shall soon call (Our) guards (the angels appointed to inflict the punishment of Hell).
t2: We shall call on the guards of Hell.
t3: We will call the guards of hell.

ar: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
en: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺.
t1: No indeed! Do not pay any heed to his doings and, (O Esteemed Beloved,) persist in prostration and keep drawing near (to Us more and more).
t2: No indeed; do thou not obey him, and bow thyself, and draw nigh.
t3: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).

ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
en: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory.
t1: Surely, We sent down this (Holy Qur’an) during the Night of Destiny.
t2: Behold, We sent it down on the Night of Power;
t3: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
en: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is?
t1: And what have you made out what the Night of Destiny is?
t2: And what shall teach thee what is the Night of Power?
t3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!

ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
en: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.
t1: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months (in merit, blessings, reward and recompense).
t2: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months;
t3: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
en: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter.
t1: The angels and the Spirit of Peace (Gabriel) descend by their Lord’s command during this (night) with decrees concerning all matters (of blessings and bounties).
t2: in it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, upon every command.
t3: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.

ar: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
en: It is all peace until the break of dawn.
t1: This (night) is (absolute) peace and security till daybreak.
t2: Peace it is, till the rising of dawn.
t3: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.

ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
en: The disbelievers from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist ˹from disbelief˺ until the clear proof came to them:
t1: The disbelievers from amongst the People of the Book and the idolaters would not desist (from disbelief) until clear proof came to them.
t2: The unbelievers of the People of the Book and the idolaters would never leave off; till the Clear Sign came to them,
t3: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,

ar: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
en: a messenger from Allah, reciting scrolls of ˹utmost˺ purity,
t1: That (proof) is the (last) Messenger from Allah, who recites (to them) holy pages (of the Glorious Qur’an),
t2: a Messenger from God, reciting pages purified,
t3: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages

ar: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
en: containing upright commandments.
t1: In which are (written) correct and firm commandments.
t2: therein true Books.
t3: Containing correct scriptures.

ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
en: It was not until this clear proof came to the People of the Book that they became divided ˹about his prophethood˺—
t1: These People of the Book did not dissent amongst themselves (with regard to believing in the Prophethood and Messengership of the Last Messenger and recognizing his holy status), until after the clear proof (of the Prophethood of Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him]) had come to them. (Then, they broke up: some of them accepted belief in him whilst others became deniers and disbelievers out of jealousy,)
t2: And they scattered not, those that were given the Book, excepting after the Clear Sign came to them.
t3: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.

ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
en: even though they were only commanded to worship Allah ˹alone˺ with sincere devotion to Him in all uprightness, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. That is the upright Way.
t1: Whereas they were commanded to worship only Allah, making their Din (faith and devotion) sincerely His (dissociating from every falsehood) to establish Prayer and to pay Zakat (the Alms-due) regularly. And this is the straight and firm Din (Religion).
t2: They were commanded only to serve God, making the religion His sincerely, men of pure faith, and to perform the prayer, and pay the alms -- that is the religion of the True.
t3: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
en: Indeed, those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there forever. They are the worst of ˹all˺ beings.
t1: Indeed, those who disbelieve from amongst the People of the Book and the polytheists (all) will be (abiding) in the Fire of Hell. They are its permanent dwellers. It is they who are the worst of the creation.
t2: The unbelievers of the People of the Book and the idolaters shall be in the Fire of Gehenna, therein dwelling forever; those are the worst of creatures.
t3: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
en: Indeed, those who believe and do good—they are the best of ˹all˺ beings.
t1: Indeed, those who believe and keep doing pious actions, it is they who are the best of the creation.
t2: But those who believe, and do righteous deeds, those are the best of creatures;
t3: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.

ar: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
en: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is ˹only˺ for those in awe of their Lord.
t1: Their reward is the Gardens of eternal living in the presence of their Lord, with streams flowing under them. They will live in them forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This (status) is meant for the one who fears his Lord.
t2: their recompense is with their Lord-Gardens of Eden, underneath which rivers flow, therein dwelling for ever and ever. God is well-pleased with them, and they are well-pleased with Him; that is for him who fears his Lord.
t3: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.

ar: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
en: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking,
t1: When the earth will be violently shaken with a high-scale quake,
t2: When earth is shaken with a mighty shaking
t3: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake

ar: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
en: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents,
t1: And when the earth will throw out (all) her burdens,
t2: and earth brings forth her burdens,
t3: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
en: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—
t1: And man (bewildered and baffled) will say: ‘What has happened to her?’
t2: and Man says., ’What ails her?’
t3: And man saith: What aileth her ?

ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
en: on that Day the earth will recount everything,
t1: On that Day, she will herself bring to light her experiences,
t2: upon that day she shall tell her tidings
t3: That day she will relate her chronicles,

ar: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
en: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺.
t1: For your Lord will have made subservient to her (the symbolic language of) sharp signals.
t2: for that her Lord has inspired her.
t3: Because thy Lord inspireth her.

ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
en: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds.
t1: On that Day, people will form up in different groups, (in diverse conditions,) so that they may be shown their works.
t2: Upon that day men shall issue in scatterings to see their works,
t3: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.

ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
en: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.
t1: Then he who will have done even an atom’s weight of good will see it.
t2: and whoso has done an atom’s weight of good shall see it,
t3: And whoso doeth good an atom’s weight will see it then,

ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
en: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
t1: And he who will have done even an atom’s weight of evil will (also) see it.
t2: and whoso has done an atom’s weight of evil shall see it.
t3: And whoso doeth ill an atom’s weight will see it then.

ar: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
en: ’ By the galloping, panting horses,
t1: By the charging horses that gallop (in the battlefield) and pant,
t2: By the snorting chargers,
t3: By the snorting courses,

ar: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
en: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺,
t1: And those that produce sparks striking their hoofs on rocks,
t2: by the strikers of fire,
t3: Striking sparks of fire

ar: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
en: launching raids at dawn,
t1: Then they attack (the enemy) at dawn,
t2: by the dawn-raiders
t3: And scouring to the raid at dawn,

ar: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
en: stirring up ˹clouds of˺ dust,
t1: And then raise clouds of dust from the point (of attack),
t2: blazing a trail of dust,
t3: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,

ar: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
en: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines!
t1: And then simultaneously pierce into (the enemy) ranks,
t2: cleaving there with a host!
t3: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
en: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—
t1: Indeed, man is most ungrateful to his Lord,
t2: Surely Man is ungrateful to his Lord,
t3: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
en: and they certainly attest to this—
t1: And verily, he is himself a witness to this ingratitude.
t2: and surely he is a witness against that!
t3: And lo! he is a witness unto that;

ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
en: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains.
t1: And indeed, he is quite stubborn in his love of wealth.
t2: Surely he is passionate in his love for good things.
t3: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.

ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
en: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out,
t1: But does he not know when those (dead) in the graves will be raised,
t2: Knows he not that when that which is in the tombs is over-thrown,
t3: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth

ar: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
en: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—
t1: And secrets which are in hearts will be disclosed?
t2: and that which is in the breasts is brought out --
t3: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
en: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day.
t1: Indeed, their Lord will be Well Aware of their (deeds) on that Day.
t2: surely on that day their Lord shall be aware of them!
t3: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.

ar: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
en: The Striking Disaster!
t1: The high-scale jolt rocking (the whole universe of the heavens and the earth) and thunder!
t2: The Clatterer!
t3: The Calamity!

ar: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
en: What is the Striking Disaster?
t1: And what is that high-scale jolt rocking (everything) and that thunder?
t2: What is the Clatterer?
t3: What is the Calamity ?

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
en: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is?
t1: And what have you made out what the high-scale jolt and thunder implies?
t2: And what shall teach thee what is the Clatterer?
t3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!

ar: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
en: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths,
t1: (It implies) the Day of Resurrection when (the whole of) mankind will become like scattered moths,
t2: The day that men shall be like scattered moths,
t3: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths

ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
en: and the mountains will be like carded wool.
t1: And the mountains will be like multicoloured carded wool.
t2: and the mountains shall be like plucked wool-tufts.
t3: And the mountains will become as carded wool.

ar: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
en: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺,
t1: So he whose scales of deeds in the balance will be heavy,
t2: Then he whose deeds weigh heavy in the Balance
t3: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),

ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
en: they will be in a life of bliss.
t1: He will be in luxury and delight.
t2: shall inherit a pleasing life,
t3: He will live a pleasant life.

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
en: And as for those whose scale is light,
t1: But as for him whose scales of deeds in the balance will be light,
t2: but he whose deeds weigh light in the Balance
t3: But as for him whose scales are light,

ar: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
en: their home will be the abyss.
t1: His abode will be Hawiya (a pit in Hell)!
t2: shall plunge in the womb of the Pit.
t3: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
en: And what will make you realize what that is?
t1: And what have you made out what that (Hawiya) is?
t2: And what shall teach thee what is the Pit?
t3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -

ar: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
en: ˹It is˺ a scorching Fire.
t1: It is (an extremely deep pit of) the fiercely Blazing Fire (of Hell).
t2: A blazing Fire!
t3: Raging Fire.

ar: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
en: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺,
t1: Your greed for massive wealth and the superiority complex has made you negligent (of the Hereafter),
t2: Gross rivalry diverts you,
t3: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you

ar: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
en: until you end up in ˹your˺ graves.
t1: Until you go down to the graves.
t2: even till you visit the tombs.
t3: Until ye come to the graves.

ar: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: But no! You will soon come to know.
t1: No indeed! You will soon learn (this reality that wealth and riches will avail you nothing).
t2: No indeed; but soon you shall know.
t3: Nay, but ye will come to know!

ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: Again, no! You will soon come to know.
t1: Again (you are warned.) No! Never! You will soon learn about (your end).
t2: Again, no indeed; but soon you shall know.
t3: Nay, but ye will come to know!

ar: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
en: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺.
t1: Yes indeed! Would that you knew with the knowledge of certitude (the consequence of greed for wealth and riches and your negligence! Then, lost in the worldly pleasures, you would never forget the Hereafter like this).
t2: No indeed; did you know with the knowledge of certainty,
t3: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!

ar: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
en: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire.
t1: (Consequent on your greed) you will surely see Hell.
t2: you shall surely see Hell;
t3: For ye will behold hell-fire.

ar: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
en: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
t1: Then you will certainly see it with the eye of certitude.
t2: Again, you shall surely see it with the eye of certainty
t3: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.

ar: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
en: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures.
t1: Then on that Day, you will certainly be questioned about the bounties (given to you by Allah and the way you consumed them).
t2: then you shall be questioned that day concerning true bliss.
t3: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.

ar: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
en: By the ˹passage of˺ time!
t1: By the passing time (whose rotation bears witness to the affairs of mankind). Or By the Prayer of declining day (‘Asr, for this Prayer is the middle of all Prayers). Or By the declining time of the day, (when the sun, after shining for the whole day, presents the sight of its setting). Or By the holy era of the Prophethood of Muhammad (blessings and peace be upon him), the sole objective and the most coveted achievement of all ages historic as well as pre-historic, and of all times to come.
t2: By the afternoon!
t3: By the declining day,

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
en: Surely humanity is in ˹grave˺ loss,
t1: Indeed, man is at a loss (for he is losing his valuable lifetime),
t2: Surely Man is in the way of loss,
t3: Lo! man is a state of loss,

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
en: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance.
t1: Except for those who believe and do good deeds and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to patience (in the face of hardships and afflictions that are faced whilst preaching the Din [Religion] of truth).
t2: save those who believe, and do righteous deeds, and counsel each other unto the truth, and counsel each other to be steadfast.
t3: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.

ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
en: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer,
t1: Woe to everyone who slanders (face to face) and finds fault (in absence)!
t2: Woe unto every backbiter, slanderer,
t3: Woe unto every slandering traducer,

ar: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
en: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺,
t1: (Woe to him) who accumulates wealth and keeps counting it!
t2: who has gathered riches and counted them over
t3: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.

ar: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
en: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal!
t1: He thinks that his riches will keep him alive forever.
t2: thinking his riches have made him immortal!
t3: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.

ar: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
en: Not at all! Such a person will certainly be tossed into the Crusher.
t1: By no means! He will certainly be cast into al-Hutama (the crushing up Fire).
t2: No indeed; he shall be thrust into the Crusher;
t3: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.

ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
en: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?
t1: And what will make you understand what al-Hutama (the crushing up Fire) is?
t2: and what shall teach thee what is the Crusher;
t3: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!

ar: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
en: ˹It is˺ Allah’s kindled Fire,
t1: (It) is a Fire kindled by Allah.
t2: The Fire of God kindled
t3: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,

ar: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
en: which rages over the hearts.
t1: That will rise over the hearts (with its torture).
t2: roaring over the hearts
t3: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).

ar: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
en: It will be sealed over them,
t1: Indeed, that (Fire) will be closed upon them all around,
t2: covered down upon them,
t3: Lo! it is closed in on them

ar: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
en: ˹tightly secured˺ with long braces.
t1: In towering columns (of fierce flames and they will not find any way to escape).
t2: in columns outstretched.
t3: In outstretched columns.

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
en: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant?
t1: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with those who had elephants?
t2: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with the Men of the Elephant?
t3: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant ?

ar: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
en: Did He not frustrate their scheme?
t1: Did He not thwart their crafty designs?
t2: Did He not make their guile to go astray?
t3: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,

ar: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
en: For He sent against them flocks of birds,
t1: And He sent on to them (ambient) swarms of birds,
t2: And He loosed upon them birds in flights,
t3: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,

ar: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
en: that pelted them with stones of baked clay,
t1: Which pelted them with stone-hard slugs.
t2: hurling against them stones of baked clay
t3: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,

ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
en: leaving them like chewed up straw.
t1: Then (Allah made them perish) like chewed-up chaff.
t2: and He made them like green blades devoured.
t3: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle) ?

ar: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
en: ˹At least˺ for ˹the favour of˺ making Quraysh habitually secure—
t1: To awake drive amongst the Quraysh,
t2: For the composing of Koraish,
t3: For the taming of Qureysh.

ar: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
en: secure in their trading caravan ˹to Yemen˺ in the winter and ˹Syria˺ in the summer—
t1: They were acclimatized to the summer and winter (commercial) trips.
t2: their composing for the winter and summer caravan!
t3: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.

ar: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
en: let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House,
t1: So they should worship the Lord of this (Sacred) House (Ka‘ba, to give Him thanks),
t2: So let them serve the Lord of this House
t3: So let them worship the Lord of this House,

ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
en: Who has fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear.
t1: Who has fed them in hunger (i.e., provided them sustenance in starving conditions) and secured them from fear (of foes i.e., blessed them with secure and peaceful life).
t2: who has fed them against hunger and secured them from fear.
t3: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
en: Have you seen the one who denies the ˹final˺ Judgment?
t1: Have you seen him who denies the Din (Religion)?
t2: Hast thou seen him who cries lies to the Doom?
t3: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion ?

ar: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
en: That is the one who repulses the orphan,
t1: So he is the one who pushes away the orphan (i.e., rejects the needs of the orphans and deprives them of their right),
t2: That is he who repulses the orphan
t3: That is he who repelleth the orphan,

ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
en: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
t1: And does not promote the cause of feeding the poor (i.e., does not strive to end the economic exploitation of the poor and the needy).
t2: and urges not the feeding of the needy.
t3: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.

ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
en: So woe to those ˹hypocrites˺ who pray
t1: So woe to those worshippers,
t2: So woe to those that pray
t3: Ah, woe unto worshippers

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
en: yet are unmindful of their prayers;
t1: Who are unaware of (the spirit of) their Prayers (i.e., they are mindful only of the rights of Allah, but are heedless of the rights of fellow human beings),
t2: and are heedless of their prayers,
t3: Who are heedless of their prayer;

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
en: those who ˹only˺ show off,
t1: Who show off (their worship, for they only render a formal service to the Creator and are inconsiderate to the oppressed humanity),
t2: to those who make display
t3: Who would be seen (at worship)

ar: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
en: and refuse to give ˹even the simplest˺ aid.
t1: And who refuse to lend a worthless small object of use even on demand!
t2: and refuse charity.
t3: Yet refuse small kindnesses!

ar: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
en: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness.
t1: Indeed, We have bestowed on you an infinite abundance (every kind of superiority, bliss and bounty).*
t2: Surely We have given thee abundance;
t3: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;

ar: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
en: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺.
t1: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice (a token of gratitude).
t2: so pray unto thy Lord and sacrifice.
t3: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.

ar: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
en: Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺.
t1: Indeed, your enemy will remain childless and his race will be cut off.
t2: Surely he that hates thee, he is the one cut off.
t3: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.

ar: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O you disbelievers!
t1: Say: ‘O disbelievers!
t2: Say: ’O unbelievers,
t3: Say: O disbelievers!

ar: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
en: I do not worship what you worship,
t1: I do not worship those (idols) that you worship.
t2: I serve not what you serve
t3: I worship not that which ye worship;

ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
en: nor do you worship what I worship.
t1: Nor do you worship (the Lord) Whom I worship.
t2: and you are not serving what I serve,
t3: Nor worship ye that which I worship.

ar: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
en: I will never worship what you worship,
t1: And I shall never worship those (idols) that you worship.
t2: nor am I serving what you have served,
t3: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.

ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
en: nor will you ever worship what I worship.
t1: Nor will you (ever) worship (the Lord) Whom I worship.
t2: neither are you serving what I serve
t3: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

ar: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
en: You have your way, and I have my Way.”
t1: (So) you have your din (religion), and I have my Din (Religion).’
t2: To you your religion, and to me my religion!’
t3: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.

ar: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
en: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺,
t1: When there comes Allah’s help and victory,
t2: When comes the help of God, and victory,
t3: When Allah’s succour and the triumph cometh

ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
en: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds,
t1: And you see people joining Allah’s Din (Religion) in droves,
t2: and thou seest men entering God’s religion in throngs,
t3: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,

ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
en: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
t1: Then glorify Allah’s praise (in gratitude), exalting Him, and beg Him (humbly) for pardon. Surely, He is Ever-Relenting and Oft-Returning (with evermore compassion).
t2: then proclaim the praise of thy Lord, and seek His forgiveness; for He turns again unto men.
t3: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.

ar: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
en: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish!
t1: Perished be the two hands of Abu Lahab and be he perished himself (he has pointed his finger to Our Beloved)!
t2: Perish the hands of Abu Lahab, and perish he!
t3: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.

ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
en: Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him.
t1: Neither His (inherited) wealth nor his earned riches have given him any benefit.
t2: His wealth avails him not, neither what he has earned;
t3: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.

ar: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ
en: He will burn in a flaming Fire,
t1: Soon he will tumble into the Flaming Fire,
t2: he shall roast at a flaming fire
t3: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,

ar: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
en: and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling,
t1: And his (damned, wretched) wife (too) who carries (on her head) the burden of (thorny) twigs (and spreads them in the way of Our Beloved, to injure the holy soles of his feet).
t2: and his wife, the carrier of the firewood,
t3: And his wife, the wood-carrier,

ar: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
en: around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre.
t1: Around her neck will be (the same) palm-fibre rope (she uses to bind the bunch of thorny twigs).
t2: upon her neck a rope of palm-fibre.
t3: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is Allah—One ˹and Indivisible˺;
t1: (O Esteemed Messenger!) Proclaim: ‘He is Allah, Who is the One.
t2: Say: ’He is God, One,
t3: Say: He is Allah, the One!

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
en: Allah—the Sustainer ˹needed by all˺.
t1: Allah is the Transcendent of all, the Protector and Far-Superior to all.
t2: God, the Everlasting Refuge,
t3: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!

ar: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
en: He has never had offspring, nor was He born.
t1: He has not begotten any, nor is He begotten.
t2: who has not begotten, and has not been begotten,
t3: He begetteth not nor was begotten.

ar: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
en: And there is none comparable to Him.”
t1: Nor is there anyone equal to Him.’
t2: and equal to Him is not any one.’
t3: And there is none comparable unto Him.

ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak
t1: Beseech: ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak (or Who brought the universe into existence with an explosion extremely fast),
t2: Say: ’I take refuge with the Lord of the Daybreak
t3: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak

ar: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
en: from the evil of whatever He has created,
t1: From the evil influence (and harmfulness) of everything that He has created,
t2: from the evil of what He has created,
t3: From the evil of that which He created;

ar: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
en: and from the evil of the night when it grows dark,
t1: And (in particular) from the evil of the murky night when (its) darkness prevails,
t2: from the evil of darkness when it gathers,
t3: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,

ar: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
en: and from the evil of those ˹witches casting spells by˺ blowing onto knots,
t1: And from the evil of those women (and men) who practise magic on knots by blowing,
t2: from the evil of the women who blow on knots,
t3: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,

ar: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
en: and from the evil of an envier when they envy.”
t1: And from the mischief of every envious person when he envies.’
t2: from the evil of an envier when he envies.’
t3: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.

ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
en: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind,
t1: Beseech: ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of (the whole of) mankind,
t2: Say: ’I take refuge with the Lord of men,
t3: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

ar: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
en: the Master of humankind,
t1: Who is the King of (all) mankind,
t2: the King of men,
t3: The King of mankind,

ar: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
en: the God of humankind,
t1: Who is the God of the (whole) human race,
t2: the God of men,
t3: The God of mankind,

ar: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
en: from the evil of the lurking whisperer—
t1: From the evil of the slinking whisperer (Satan) who hides himself withdrawing (from the influence of Allah’s remembrance),
t2: from the evil of the slinking whisperer
t3: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,

ar: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
en: who whispers into the hearts of humankind—
t1: Who whispers into the hearts of mankind,
t2: who whispers in the breasts of men
t3: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,

ar: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
en: from among jinn and humankind.”
t1: Whether he (the whispering Satan) comes from the jinn or mankind.’
t2: of jinn and men.’
t3: Of the jinn and of mankind.
